jobs.excerpt: Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow.
jobs.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

  • Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Roon, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins

  • Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development

  • Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

About the Role

HARMAN's Software Experiences Business Unit (SEBU) builds software products that connect people to music. Our portfolio includes Roon, the leading music library management and playback platform for audiophiles, alongside new music products currently in development.

In this role you will help our product teams understand the people we build for. You will run competitive and user research across music discovery, streaming, and short-form content, sit inside the day-to-day work of a product team, and bring back the language, habits, and unmet needs of a younger audience in a form the team can act on.

This is a paid internship, and you will work as a member of the team rather than an observer. Length of the internship is dependent on when your new hire onboarding happens, but a typical program is 12-weeks. You will join standups and reviews, own your own research threads, and present what you learn directly to the people making product decisions.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Work as an embedded member of the team: join standups, design and product marketing discussions and product reviews, and contribute ideas as a working member of the group.

  • Track and analyze competitors and adjacent products to identify feature gaps, emerging trends, and unmet needs in the category.

  • Maintain a competitive tracker the team can use week-to-week, covering feature releases, notable launches, and shifts in how competitors position themselves.

  • Recruit and interview users in the 16 to 25 age range, with support from the product and marketing teams, to surface authentic language, listening habits, and unmet needs around music discovery and sharing.

  • Support structured usability and concept testing on new features and prototypes: help run sessions, capture qualitative and quantitative feedback, and turn it into concrete recommendations the team can act on within a development sprint.

  • Investigate how the target audience responds to curation and algorithmic recommendation, and feed what you find into feed and curation discussions.

  • Study visual and interaction trends across music, social, and related apps, and share what you find so our product and design teams stay current with what feels credible to a Gen Z audience.

  • Listen to public conversation about products in our category across Reddit, Discord, TikTok comments, and app store reviews, and flag the themes worth the team’s attention.

  • Support user feedback programs alongside the community and R&D teams: help draft survey questions, track incoming feedback and bug reports, and keep a running log of recurring themes.

  • Keep the research repository usable: tag and organize interview notes, clips, and findings so the team can still find them after the internship ends.

  • Summarize findings regularly into short internal documents the team can act on week to week, and deliver a final write-up and presentation pulling together the full 12 weeks of insight.

  • Own one self-directed project: define a question about the product with your manager, run the research, and present your recommendation to the team.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

  • Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program or higher at an accredited institution having completed your Sophomore year or later, taking at least one class in the semester/quarter before participation in the internship program, and returning to school for at least one semester upon completion of the internship program

  • Must have a cumulative 3.0 GPA

  • Preferred degree program in business, marketing, design, human-computer interaction, communications, music business, or a related field.

  • Genuine curiosity about consumer products and how people find, share, and talk about music.

  • Strong written communication: able to turn messy notes into a short, clear document that someone else can act on without a walkthrough.

  • Comfort talking to people you do not know, running an interview, and asking the follow-up question rather than accepting the first answer.

  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several research threads at once with light supervision in a remote environment.

  • Comfortable working with survey results and simple data sets, and willing to report what the findings actually show, including when they are inconvenient.

  • Hands-on familiarity, as a user, with the platforms where music culture happens, including TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, and the major streaming services.

  • Discretion with confidential product, partner, and roadmap information.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Prior internship, coursework, or project experience in user research, product management, marketing, or design.

  • Practical exposure to research methods such as interviews, surveys, or usability testing.

  • Experience building an audience or creating content on a social platform, or moderating an online community.

  • Working knowledge of tools such as Figma, Notion, and survey or analytics platforms.

  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of using them to work faster and better: synthesizing interview notes, drafting research summaries, and speeding up desk research.

  • A personal stake in music: musician, DJ, playlist curator, writer, or active participant in a scene.

Things To Know

  • This role allows for remote work and a candidate can be located anywhere in the United States.

  • This position allows for up to 20 hours per week, constituting a Part-Time Internship. Flexibility for more working hours is at the discretion and ability of the business unit.

  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment (post-offer).

What You Can Expect

  • Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)

  • Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs

  • Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Pay Transparency

Freshman: $19.00

Sophomore: $21.00

Junior: $23.00

Senior: $24.00

Master: $28.00

Dependent on the internship offered, pay is based on factors, including without limitation, the applicant's level of education and business need.

Benefits

HARMAN is interested in your health and wellbeing and offers benefits designed to support your wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your relationship with HARMAN, and may include paid sick leave and medical benefits.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

  • Passion for continuous learning and staying current with evolving security threats and technologies

  • We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)

jobs.description:
Job Title: Technical Lead, Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) Projects
Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time (client working days only; no client holidays)
Location: Remote, United States (Eastern Time schedule)
Employment Type: W-2, full time, 40 hours per week
Pay Rate: $60-$80/hr (W-2)
Engagement Type: Contract, 15 months beginning December 1, 2026, with a possible extension of up to one additional year
Final Interview: Client interview by phone or in person

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring a Technical Lead on behalf of the client, a state government agency, to support its Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) program. Under the direction of the state IT Manager, the Technical Lead performs technical lead and backup technical lead duties on two MMIS projects, and on other MMIS projects, programs and systems as assigned:

  • Pharmacy benefit services: replacement of the state's pharmacy benefit services solution.
  • Interoperability, phase 2: prior authorization processes and health data exchange APIs under the CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization final rule (CMS-0057-F).

The Technical Lead is the project team's technical authority and the link between the project team, the state's health and human services departments, the state's central IT agency and the implementation vendors: leading technical design, build, test and deployment activities, overseeing data migration and interfaces, and keeping the quality of the technical solution high.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the assigned technical lead and a member of the project team, take part in project meetings and stay current with the project vision.
  • Coordinate with the state's health access, children and families, human services and digital services organizations and other stakeholders to resolve problems and questions, and report back to the project team.
  • Lead technical design and technology build, test and deployment activities, and provide technical support.
  • Oversee data migration and the implementation of interfaces between existing solutions and the new systems being implemented.
  • Support Agile and hybrid development methods and give input on the team's Agile and hybrid practices.
  • Keep the project team informed of technical risk, complexity and sizing for the ideas it identifies, and work with the project owner on technically feasible options that meet the project's needs and priorities.
  • Support infrastructure and platform decisions.
  • Oversee a healthy release management process and maintain the overall quality of technical solutions.
  • See that vendor code is reviewed and accepted, and identify, prioritize and communicate technical debt and risks.
  • Coach the project team on technical concepts to support decisions, and coach other technical resources on the state and vendor teams.
  • Answer technical questions through technical sprints, research, evaluations and prototypes.
  • Take part in vendor evaluation panels, evaluate vendor markets to help the state acquire IT modules, and work with the project owner, project manager and procurement lead to monitor vendor performance after award.
  • Coordinate with software vendors to investigate application issues and deliver effective resolutions, and work with the vendor to review and produce system documentation and training materials.
  • Recommend system modifications that improve efficiency and reduce operating costs.
  • Take part in team retrospectives, research industry trends and best practices, and unblock issues as they arise.
  • Provide weekly status: planned tasks accomplished, tasks incomplete or behind schedule with reasons, and tasks planned for the next two weeks.

Requirements

Required:

  • Considerable support, development and implementation experience, with a deep understanding of the underlying technologies, business processes and support processes, and the ability to work with a broad range of stakeholders across lifecycle phases.
  • Experience serving as technical lead on large system implementations delivered with vendors, including technical design, build, test and deployment.
  • Experience overseeing data migration and the implementation of interfaces between existing and new systems.
  • Working experience with Agile and hybrid delivery methods.
  • Experience reviewing and accepting vendor code, managing releases and managing technical debt.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical team members and coach other technical staff.
  • Current annual cybersecurity awareness training certificate (a copy is submitted to the client with your resume), or the ability to complete it before submission; the client's annual compliance training must also be completed and kept current during the engagement.
  • Three professional references, submitted with the application, who can speak to your technical lead work.
  • Available full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time, for the full 15-month engagement beginning December 1, 2026.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States; work cannot be performed from outside the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099).
  • Must pass a national criminal background check, sign the client's acceptable use and confidentiality terms, work only on client-provided systems, disclose any conflict of interest and any planned use of AI tools in the work, and not use AI meeting assistants in client meetings.

Preferred:

  • Technical lead experience on state Medicaid systems, such as MMIS or Medicaid Enterprise Systems modules, pharmacy benefit systems, or interoperability and prior authorization APIs.
  • Experience working with a state central IT agency alongside program departments.
  • Experience evaluating vendors and IT modules in public sector procurements.

How to Apply

Please send your resume, three professional references and copies of your certificates (any certifications listed on your resume and your current cybersecurity awareness training certificate) to with "Technical Lead, MMIS" in the subject line. For each reference, include the name, title, organization, email address, phone number and the work the reference can speak to.

Customer Solutions Product Owner



Role Overview


We are seeking a Customer Solutions Product Owner to support the delivery of high-impact digital experiences across our Employee Benefits platform. This role partners closely with the Product Manager, Product Owners, and cross-functional teams to translate strategic business and customer needs into actionable work items.

Key Responsibilities

Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution

  • Own the breakdown of the epics into features and document clearly and timely for refinement and PI planning
  • Partner with process and business analysts to have clear, concise user stories and acceptance criteria documented and aligned to features and priorities
  • Lead and/or participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and daily execution support
  • Partner with the team to clarify requirements and remove blockers
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities within the team's Agile processes

Product Delivery Support

  • Collaborate with Agile Product Managers and senior Product Owners to execute against the product roadmap
  • Ensure delivered features meet defined acceptance criteria and business expectations
  • Assist in coordinating dependencies and aligning work across teams

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Business Alignment

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and business partners to ensure shared understanding of requirements
  • Communicate effectively and confidently with stakeholders on progress, risks/challenges, and delivery outcomes
  • Leverage customer feedback, analytics, and stakeholder input to inform backlog priorities

Qualifications


Required

  • 3+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, or digital product delivery
  • Strong experience in the Agile/Scrum environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to break down complex problems into clear, actionable work items
  • Ability to manage stakeholders with high degree of professionalism
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • High degree of curiosity and intrinsic motivation

Preferred

  • Experience supporting digital products or customer-facing platforms
  • Familiarity with backlog management tools (e.g Jira, Rally)
  • Basic understanding of analytics and customer experience principles
  • Interest in building a career in Product Management

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers well-defined, ready-to-build features and user stories that enable smooth sprint execution
  • Builds strong working relationships with Agile teams and stakeholders
  • Demonstrates growing ability to prioritize effectively and contribute to product decisions
  • Demonstrates competency and influence
  • Improves team velocity and reduces rework through clear requirements and collaboration

Key Attributes

  • Detail-oriented executor with strong follow-through
  • Collaborative team player who learns quickly and adapts to change
  • Customer-focused thinker with curiosity about digital experiences
  • Proactive effective communicator who asks questions and surfaces risks early

The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. $100,000 - $150,000

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. We are looking for a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer to join our team leading all aspects of quality for a range of product segments throughout the life of the product.   • Lead and facilitate problem-solving and root cause analysis activities to address quality issues with manufacturers.
  • Establish and maintain supplier performance metrics and scorecards to track and supervise supplier quality performance.

  • Show leadership skills, lead multi-functional teams and get results.

  • Certificate of IPC-A-600, IPC-A-610, IPC-6012 etc. IPC standard.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

jobs.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


Are you a sales-minded, ambitious self-starter with a creative and entrepreneurial edge? As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at FICO, you'll play a strategic role in our continued growth — uncovering high-value opportunities through compelling storytelling and meaningful engagement with the market's next premier customers. You'll prospect and nurture across multiple channels, build relationships with decision-makers at multiple levels of an organization, and collaborate cross-functionally to build a healthy, high-quality pipeline. Surrounded by smart, driven teammates, you'll sharpen your skills, expand your knowledge — including how to put AI tools to work in your day-to-day — and prepare for rapid career advancement in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.


What You'll Contribute

  • Build and continuously deepen your knowledge of FICO's platform, solutions, and competitive positioning — using customer success stories and AI-powered tools to sharpen your messaging — so you can educate the market, share thought leadership, position FICO's value proposition with a consultative approach, and handle objections with confidence.
  • Research target accounts and industries, using AI-assisted research tools to understand prospects' business drivers, pain points, and priorities, and apply that insight to identify and pursue high-value opportunities — net new and expansion — within your ideal customer profile.
  • Build and execute a territory strategy in coordination with your assigned Key Account Managers (KAMs), balancing proactive outbound prospecting — cold calls, email, LinkedIn, and other digital channels — with timely, disciplined follow-up on inbound leads to sustain a healthy, high-quality pipeline.
  • Execute a consistent, multi-channel outreach cadence, qualifying opportunities against FICO's Platform Capabilities to advance the right opportunities and identify clear next steps.
  • Build relationships across multiple levels and departments within prospect organizations, and cultivate a network of internal FICO resources — sales, marketing, and solution experts — to support and accelerate the sales process.
  • Partner closely with your assigned KAMs and cross-functional teams, sharing well-researched, actionable insights on prospect needs and contributing to shared account-based outreach and lead pursuit strategies — with particular focus on accounts and territory KAMs aren't currently reaching.
  • Work with Field Marketing to refine messaging and lead-generation strategies, sharing feedback on campaign performance to continuously improve sales development program effectiveness.
  • Bring a resourceful, adaptable approach to prospecting: test new angles when something isn't working, and use AI tools as a thinking partner to problem-solve and sharpen your approach in real time.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect data and market insights in Salesforce to support campaign optimization, pipeline reporting, and sales development effectiveness.
  • Actively seek out and apply feedback and coaching, and participate in ongoing training to deepen product knowledge, understand buyer personas, and improve outreach effectiveness.
  • Take ownership of your results: consistently meet and aim to exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual goals for qualified pipeline generation, exercising resilience and self-motivation to overcome obstacles in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

What We're Seeking


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience operating in a commercial/business environment.
  • Relevant experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or Inside Sales in a technology-driven environment.
  • Experience selling or prospecting into enterprise software, or a strong understanding of how large, complex organizations operate.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or a similar CRM, plus tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and Microsoft Office, and comfort learning AI-powered sales and research tools.
  • Strong ability to build relationships quickly and across multiple levels of an organization — via phone, email, and digital channels.
  • A detail-oriented, motivated self-starter who thrives in fast-changing, high-growth environments.
  • A critical thinker who uses data to inform decisions, adapts approach when something isn't working, and continuously improves performance.
  • A collaborative, coachable team member who seeks out feedback, performs well individually and as part of a high-performing team, and contributes to shared success.
  • Fluent English speaking skills, proficiency in additional languages is highly desirable.

Our Offer To You


  • An inclusive culture strongly reflects our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits, and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

​

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Your role involves ensuring compliance with CRA legislation, supporting the delivery of superior assessment and certification services, and meeting commercial targets while prioritising client satisfaction.

Votre rôle

Digital Services France (DSF) crée une nouvelle Direction nommée Direction Digital, Data et IA (DDIA), en charge de porter la stratégie, le portfolio d'offres, les opérations mutualisées et la performance économique des activités Digital, Data et IA de DSF (à l’exception des activités Microsoft portées par la Direction Expertime). Cette direction est composée d’environ 330 salariés en France, au Maroc et à l’Ile Maurice.

Dans le cadre de cette création, nous recrutons le/la directeur(ice) de cette direction, rattaché au directeur de Digital Services France et membre du CODIR de DSF. Dans un marché en tension mais porté par l'accélération de l'IA agentique, vous avez pour mission de redynamiser la stratégie DDIA, de structurer une gouvernance claire et lisible, et de porter le retour à une croissance profitable et durable de ce périmètre.

Missions principales

Stratégie, portfolio et gouvernance :

  • Définir et faire évoluer la stratégie DDIA (axes de développement, choix de partenaires stratégiques) en cohérence avec la stratégie globale de DSF ;
  • Structurer le portfolio d'offres Digital, Data et IA (Data/IA, Confiance et numérique responsable, Expérience Client/Employé/Opérationnelle, produits digitaux), garantir une déclinaison homogène des offres (dont les produits digitaux) sur l'ensemble du territoire, en lien avec les Régions et les Agences Conseil & Expertise et piloter une vision consolidée. Structurer et clarifier la gouvernance de la direction DDIA, à l'image des dispositifs existants pour les activités Cloud et Microsoft.

Pilotage économique :

  • Porter la responsabilité primaire du P&L des activités DDIA (chiffre d'affaires par offre, marge nationale) ;
  • Définir le budget et dimensionner la workforce interne/externe en fonction des ambitions de développement en collaboration avec les Régions;
  • Piloter l'équation de performance globale en coordination avec les P&L régionaux dont les Régions de DSF sont garantes

Management et animation des équipes :

  • Piloter les Départements Portfolio, Avant-Vente, Opérations Mutualisées et Live Intelligence, ainsi que les activités du Directeur Technique IA et du Directeur Influence IA
  • Animer un lien fonctionnel fort avec les Directeurs Conseil & Expertise en région et la Direction La Fabrique, afin qu'ils contribuent au cycle de vie du portfolio et à la diffusion des innovations ;
  • Manager les Responsables de départements de la Direction DDIA

Alignement commercial et delivery :

  • Assurer l'alignement de nos capacités et savoir-faire en termes de delivery avec nos offres, en coordination avec la Direction Performance & Optimisation;
  • Assurer et accompagner la bonne diffusion commerciale de nos offres en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale Nationale ;
  • Renforcer l'orchestration territoriale de la stratégie DDIA avec les Régions et les équipes commerciales (grands comptes / ETI et PME)

Compétences et transformation IA :

  • Porter, avec le Directeur Technique IA et le Directeur Influence IA, l'accélération de la transformation IA en interne comme en externe.
  • Structurer et industrialiser, via l'IA Academy, l'upskilling/reskilling des collaborateurs à l'ère de l'IA ;

Votre profil

Vous êtes

Formation et expérience : Diplôme supérieur (Bac+5, école d'ingénieur ou de commerce) avec une expérience confirmée de direction dans le secteur des ESN, sur les activités Digital, Data et/ou IA impliquant le management d’un P&L, d’une stratégie d’offre et d’équipes pluridisciplinaires d’au moins 300 salariés ainsi que la conduite de projet(s) de transformation.

Compétences requises :

Domaine

Compétences attendues

Expertise métier

Connaissance approfondie du marché Digital, Data, IA ; culture des offres et du portfolio d'une ESN

Leadership

Capacité à fédérer un collectif transverse, à porter une vision stratégique et à accompagner le changement

Pilotage économique

Maîtrise de la gestion de P&L, du budget et des indicateurs de performance

Vision stratégique

Capacité à anticiper les évolutions technologiques et de marché, notamment liées à l'IA générative et agentique

Communication

Excellentes compétences relationnelles, capacité à convaincre en interne (CODIR, Régions) et en externe (partenaires, clients)

Entité

Orange Business est un intégrateur réseau et numérique qui comprend toute la chaîne de valeur du monde digital, permettant à nos clients de se concentrer sur les initiatives stratégiques qui font avancer leur business.

Chaque jour, vous collaborerez avec une équipe dédiée à la livraison de solutions globales cohérentes et durables, peu importe où nos clients opèrent.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, ou encore l'IoT et le digital workspace.

Entité de rattachement

Plus de 4 000 experts répartis dans toute la France accompagnent des entreprises et institutions publiques dans leur transformation numérique. jobs.description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Qualidade (QA)Sêniorpara compor um time altamente técnico, com foco em desenvolvimento. Você atuará em projetos estratégicos.

Sua missão é garantir que cada entrega chegue à produção com qualidade e previsibilidade. Isso significa estruturar e evoluir a automação de testes, reduzir regressões e ser referência técnica de qualidade para o time.


  • Desenhar, implementar e manter suítes de testes automatizados de UI, API e regressão.
  • Definir a estratégia de testes da squad, equilibrando a pirâmide de testes (unit, integration, E2E).
  • Integrar os testes ao pipeline de CI/CD, com execução automática a cada Pull Request e deploy.
  • Analisar requisitos e histórias com PO e devs, definindo critérios de aceite testáveis (BDD/Gherkin quando fizer sentido).
  • Validar correções e melhorias em ambiente de sustentação, com foco em evitar regressões em produção.
  • Investigar incidentes junto ao time, reproduzir bugs e documentá-los com evidências claras.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade (cobertura automatizada, taxa de defeitos escapados, flaky tests, tempo de execução).
  • Atuar como referência técnica: revisar código de testes, orientar QAs menos experientes e disseminar boas práticas.

  • Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Quality Assurance, com atuação comprovada em nível sênior.
  • Vivência prática em automação de testes Web com pelo menos um framework de mercado: Cypress, Playwright ou Selenium WebDriver.
  • Automação de testes de API REST (Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Karate ou similar).
  • Programação para automação em JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Python.
  • Integração de testes em pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI ou Jenkins).
  • Domínio de Git e fluxo de trabalho com Pull Requests.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de teste (particionamento, valor-limite, testes exploratórios, regressão) e da pirâmide de testes.
  • Experiência em times ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).
  • SQL para validação e preparação de massa de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Testes de performance e carga (k6, JMeter ou Gatling).
  • Automação de testes mobile (Appium, Detox ou Maestro).
  • Contract testing (Pact) e testes em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Experiência em times de sustentação, com SLA e gestão de incidentes.
  • Observabilidade aplicada a qualidade (logs, Datadog, Grafana, New Relic).
  • Uso de IA aplicada a testes (geração de casos, self-healing de seletores, análise de falhas).
  • Noções de testes de segurança (OWASP) e acessibilidade (WCAG).
  • Certificações como ISTQB/CTFL ou CTAL.

Competências comportamentais

  • Senso de dono da qualidade: atua na prevenção de defeitos, não só na detecção.
  • Comunicação clara: traduz riscos técnicos para PO, devs e cliente.
  • Priorização sob pressão: sabe decidir o que testar primeiro em demandas urgentes de sustentação.
  • Colaboração: trabalha lado a lado com o time e compartilha conhecimento.
  • Aprendizado contínuo: acompanha novas ferramentas e práticas de qualidade.

Department of Marketing, Management, and Health Care Administration | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)

Introduction to Business and Management (BMGT 110):

An introduction to the fundamental concepts of business management and leadership. The objective is to understand the interrelated dynamics of business, society, and the economy. Discussion covers business principles and practices in the context of everyday business events and human affairs and from a historical perspective.


*Once hired, you may be asked to teach a variety of courses within the program based on your qualifications, experience, and departmental needs.

At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower. Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success.

Why Teach with UMGC?

  • Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback—no unpaid course-building required.
  • True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you.

Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship.

Classroom Engagement & Presence

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱 RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support.
jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

ROLE OVERVIEW:
RYZE Superfoods is rapidly expanding across retail, DTC, Amazon, and TikTok Shop. We are seeking a hands-on demand planning leader to own forecasting, lead our Demand Planning Manager, build scalable automated/AI-driven planning infrastructure, and drive alignment across Sales, Marketing, and S&OP.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

Responsibilities will include:


Demand planning across all channels

  • Build and maintain the consensus plan for retail, DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and marketplaces, by SKU and month over a rolling 18 months, in units and dollars.
  • Lead channel-level forecasting to support 30,000+ retail doors while DTC and digital channels scale in parallel
  • Bring every forecast input into that plan with a named owner and a due date each cycle. That includes the items that fall between teams today: gifts, merchandise, kits and limited-time offers.
  • Reconcile the plan to Finance's revenue plan every cycle, so a demand gap shows up as a dollar gap.

Committed demand and upside, kept apart

  • Run the plan in two columns: committed and upside. Every retail initiative carries a confidence level, reviewed weekly with Sales, and new distribution moves to committed when the retailer confirms it.
  • Work with supply planning so long-lead purchases and production are sized to the committed column, and the upside is held as an option with suppliers.
  • Model upside and downside scenarios and show what each does to inventory and cash before the company commits.

Forecast accuracy and bias

  • Own forecast accuracy as a measurable output, not a reporting exercise
  • Measure accuracy and bias by channel, retailer and SKU at one, two and three months of lag, and publish the results weekly. Current targets are 70% at three months, 80% at two, 90% at one and 95% in-month.
  • Change the plan when sell-through misses. Set the triggers that force a revision, apply them in the same cycle, and record the reason.
  • Log the driver behind every material forecast change so the next cycle learns from it.

Retail and launch forecasting

  • Forecast sell-in from sell-through: POS, weeks of supply, door counts and velocity by account, using retailer portals, distributor data and syndicated data.
  • Build launch and ramp curves for new retailers and new items from comparable launches, and re-base them within the first weeks of real sales.
  • Size promotions, endcaps and displays from measured lift, and take the pull-forward out of the months that follow.

DTC and digital forecasting

  • Forecast the subscription business from its drivers: new customers, retention and rebill rates, and gift and add-on attachment, with Growth and Data owning the assumptions alongside you.
  • Own the Amazon and TikTok Shop forecasts with the channel leads, including promotional events.

Team and tools

  • Lead our Demand Planning Manager and any future demand planning hires
  • Work actively in our planning platform and partner with our data and systems teams to build automated reporting, forecast workflows and channel-level visibility
  • Be an early adopter and driver of AI tools within the planning function we are actively building this capability and want someone who leans into it

S&OP and cross-functional influence

  • Run the demand review in the monthly S&OP cycle and hold every input owner to the calendar.
  • Challenge promotional plans, launch assumptions and growth targets that the data does not support, with Sales, Marketing and the executive team.
  • Work with New Product Launch and Marketing so that no launch or promotion reaches the calendar without a demand plan behind it.
  • Hand supply planning a plan it can execute. Production schedules, inventory targets and the rolling forecasts we send co-manufacturers and suppliers all start from your number.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS


  • CPG background required. You have worked in consumer packaged goods and understand how demand planning functions inside a multi-channel brand.
  • Channel expansion experience. You have been part of a brand scaling aggressively adding doors, launching new channels, managing the forecast complexity that comes with growth. You know how launch assumptions go wrong and how fast to correct them.
  • Retail forecasting depth. You know the difference between a load-in and a sell-through rate, and you forecast from POS. You have worked with brokers, distributors and retailer replenishment teams.
  • Fluent in DTC and marketplaces. You can forecast a subscription business from acquisition and retention, and you understand how Amazon and social commerce behave around promotions.
  • Hands-on and managing. You have led a small team before but you are still doing the work. You are not a manager who delegates and reviews—you are in the data and in the tools alongside your team.
  • Comfortable with software and data. You pick up new tools quickly and are not waiting for a report to tell you what is happening. Experience working with data or BI teams to build what you need is a plus.
  • Curious about AI. We are pushing AI adoption across the company and want someone who is excited to build, not just use. You do not need to be an engineer, you need to be willing to explore.
  • Clear communicator. You can translate a complex forecast into a clean story for leadership and you are willing to have a hard conversation when the numbers do not support the plan.
  • 8+ years in demand planning or forecasting within CPG
  • Has owned the consensus demand plan for a multi-channel consumer brand, with reported accuracy and bias
  • Has managed at least one direct report in a planning function while still carrying forecasts personally
  • Retail forecasting for national accounts such as Target, Walmart, Kroger or club, using POS and syndicated data (Circana, SPINS or Nielsen)
  • DTC and marketplace forecasting; subscription experience is a plus
  • New-item and new-distribution forecasting through rapid door expansion
  • Has run the demand review in a monthly S&OP cycle and reconciled the plan with Finance
  • Has worked in a planning system and with data teams; NetSuite, Snowflake or SQL experience is a plus

Job Summary

Quality Management Specialist

Aptive Resources is seeking a Quality Management Specialist to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Research and Development (ORD) Cooperative Studies Program (CSP) under the Field Enterprise Research Support Services (FERSS) contract. Sponsored by the Palo Alto VA Medical Center (VAMC), this role coordinates the planning, execution, and tracking of activities required for CSP’s six Epidemiology Centers (ECs) to achieve ISO 9001:2026 Quality Management System (QMS) certification, ensuring a structured, clause-aligned implementation across centers.

This position requires strong knowledge of ISO 9001 principles, QMS structures, and controlled document governance, combined with the project management and facilitation skills needed to align work across distributed teams. The selected candidate will work closely with EC Directors, Quality Assurance leads, document governance teams, ISO subject matter experts (SMEs), and CSP Central Office.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), 100% remote position.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive ISO 9001:2026 implementation plan, organized by phase (Gap Assessment, QMS Development, Rollout, Internal Audit, and Certification), based on direction from EC Directors.
  • Coordinate clause-specific planning for all actionable ISO 9001 requirements, including Context of the Organization, Leadership, Planning, Support, Operation, Performance Evaluation, and Improvement.
  • Support identification of processes across the six ECs suitable for unified evaluation, and manage milestones and communication around development of unified EC processes for external review and certification scope.
  • Facilitate cross-center gap analysis workshops and consolidate results into a clause-specific gap assessment.
  • Support resource needs assessments, including staffing, SME input, and certification body contracting mechanisms.
  • Map existing EC QMS components to ISO 9001 clauses and identify elements to adopt, adapt, or abandon.
  • Support integration of clause-aligned documentation processes across centers, including controlled document lifecycles and compliance with global versus local documentation requirements.
  • Monitor implementation progress against the project plan, identify schedule risks and quality gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain progress dashboards and milestone tracking to provide transparent visibility into implementation status.
  • Prepare monthly written progress summaries for CSP leadership.
  • Facilitate cross-center collaboration and knowledge sharing among EC Directors, Quality Assurance leads, document governance teams, ISO SMEs, and CSP Central Office.
  • Apply risk management and change management practices to support adoption of new QMS processes across distributed teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in public health, epidemiology, life or biomedical sciences, health administration, business or management, quality management, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in quality management, QMS implementation, or project management within a complex or regulated organization.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ISO 9001 principles (ISO 9001:2015 and/or the 2026 revision), including leadership, context of the organization, risk-based thinking, document control, and audit requirements.
  • Knowledge of QMS structures and controlled document lifecycles, including document governance practices.
  • Experience with process mapping and workflow optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and manage project plans, schedules, milestones, and risks across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong facilitation, written, and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing progress reports for leadership audiences.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or above) in a scientific, public health, or related field.
  • Direct experience leading or supporting an organization through ISO 9001 certification, including multi-site or unified certification scope.
  • Familiarity with quality management systems in research organizations, especially epidemiologic or clinical research environments.
  • Knowledge of regulatory alignment for research QMS, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP), federal requirements, and VA policies.
  • ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification, or an ASQ quality certification (e.g., CQA, CMQ/OE).
  • Project management, process improvement, or change management certifications (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt, Prosci Change Management).
  • Experience working in a federal or VA research environment; familiarity with the VA Cooperative Studies Program is a plus.
  • Experience with change management and stakeholder engagement across geographically distributed teams.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

jobs.title: Workers' Compensation Adjustor
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the Eastern Time Zone of the U.S. Preference will be given to candidates located in New Jersey; however, remote candidates throughout the Eastern Time Zone are encouraged to apply.

As a Workers’ Compensation Adjuster, you will manage a caseload of workers’ compensation claims from initial investigation through resolution. You'll play a key role in ensuring injured employees receive appropriate medical care and benefits while collaborating with employers, medical providers, nurse case managers, and legal partners. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in workers’ compensation claims handling, litigation management, and return-to-work strategies while utilizing modern claims technology and AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Duties and Responsibilities
  • Investigates, evaluates, and resolves assigned Workers’ Compensation claims of a more complex or litigated nature in a timely manner in accordance with legal statutes, policy provisions, and company guidelines.
  • Evaluate claimant eligibility; communicate with attending physician, employer and injured worker.
  • Work with both the claimant and their physician to medically manage the claim, from initial medical treatment to reviewing and evaluating ongoing treatment and related information.
  • Work directly with employers to facilitate a return to work, either on a full-time or modified duty basis.
  • Confirm coverage and applicable insurance policy or coverage document and statutory requirements.
  • Identify potential for third party recovery, including subrogation, Second Injury Fund or other fund involvement (when applicable) and excess or reinsurance reimbursement. Pursue the process of reimbursement and complete posting of recovery to the claim file, where appropriate.
  • Identify potential for disability or pension credits or offsets and apply same where appropriate.
  • Ensure timely denial or payment of benefits in accordance with jurisdictional requirements.
  • Establish claim reserve levels by estimating the potential exposure of each assigned claim, establish appropriate reserves with documented rationale, maintain and adjust reserves over the life of the claim to reflect changes in exposure.
  • Establish compensability status through case investigation and evaluation and application of jurisdictional statutes and laws.
  • Manage diary in accordance with Best Practices and complete tasks to ensure that cases move to the best financial outcome and timely resolution.
  • Where litigation is filed, evaluate exposure and work with defense counsel to establish strong defenses, prepare litigation plan of action, set legal reserve and manage litigation over life of claim.
  • Close all files as appropriate in a timely and complete manner.
  • Maintain closing ratio as directed by management team.
  • Oversee and coordinate medical treatment for injured employees and provide information to treating physicians regarding employees’ medical history, health issues, and job requirements; provide direction to assigned nurse case manager where applicable.
  • Complete PARs (payment authorization request) when applicable.
  • Comply with all excess and reinsurance reporting requirements; manage self-insured retention reporting.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma required.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 2 years of experience handling workers’ compensation claims.
  • Experience managing claims investigations, compensability determinations, and benefit administration.
  • Litigation and/or subrogation experience preferred.
  • Workers’ compensation designations, certifications, or industry training are a plus.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $18.45 - $23.55 hourly, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.excerpt: Hi, we are ecobee.  ecobee introduced the world’s first smart Wi-Fi thermostat to help millions of consumers save money, conserve energy, and bring home automation into their lives.
jobs.description:
Hi, we are ecobee.

ecobee introduced the world’s first smart Wi-Fi thermostat to help millions of consumers save money, conserve energy, and bring home automation into their lives. That was just the beginning. We continue our pursuit to create technology that brings peace of mind into the home and allows people to focus on the moments that matter most. We take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment, all while being part of the exciting, connected home revolution.

In 2021, ecobee became a subsidiary of Generac Power Systems. Generac introduced the first affordable backup generator and later created the category of automatic home standby generator. The company is committed to sustainable, cleaner energy products poised to revolutionize the 21st century electrical grid. Together, we take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment.

Why we love to do what we do:

We’re helping build the world of tomorrow with solutions that improve everyday life while making a positive impact on the planet. Our products and services work in harmony to provide comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind for millions of homes and businesses. While we’re proud of what we’ve done so far, there’s still a lot we can do—and you can be part of it.

Join our extraordinary team.

We're a rapidly growing global tech company headquartered in Canada, in the heart of downtown Toronto, with an office in Leeds, UK, and remote ecopeeps in the US. We get to work with some of North America and UK's leading professionals. Our colleagues are proud to bring their authentic selves to work, confident that what we do is grounded in a greater purpose. We’re always looking for curious, talented, and passionate people to join our team.


Who You Will Be Joining
The Senior Energy Sales Manager reports to the Senior Director, Energy and leads growth across ecobee’s portfolio of energy hardware and energy services solutions in North America. The role develops and expands relationships with energy providers, implementation contractors, aggregators, virtual power plant operators, and other energy industry stakeholders. It brings integrated smart home, grid services, and energy management solutions to market; structures complex commercial agreements; and builds trusted relationships that drive long-term revenue, margin, and strategic growth.


How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Develops and executes sales strategies that deliver revenue, margin, and growth targets, supported by a strong pipeline of hardware and recurring energy services opportunities.
  • Leads opportunities from prospecting and qualification through business case development, proposal, pricing, contract execution, and program launch.
  • Maintains disciplined CRM data, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and pipeline reporting to support accurate revenue projections and mitigate deal risk through extended utility procurement cycles.
  • Structures and negotiates complex, high-value hardware, software, and services agreements, including new program launches, renewals, and multi-year strategic partnerships.
  • Identifies and develops integrated hardware and services opportunities across capacity and flexibility programs, virtual power plants, home energy management, carbon and sustainability offerings, and emerging distributed energy resource programs.
  • Builds trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across utilities, energy providers, implementation contractors, aggregators, virtual power plant operators, and other strategic energy partners.
  • Represents ecobee at industry conferences, customer events, and stakeholder forums and brings market insights and customer feedback into strategic planning.
  • Collaborates across marketing, finance, operations, legal, regulatory, and other go-to-market sales channels to maximize partner and customer value and advance ecobee’s long-term energy growth strategy.

What You’ll Bring to the Table:
We've built the following list as a guideline for some of the skills and interests of our development team - but we strive to build our team with members from a diverse background and skill set, so if any combination of these apply to you, we would love to chat!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Energy Management, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
  • Eight or more years of experience in energy, utilities, clean technology, distributed energy resources, demand-side management, grid services, or a related industry and demonstrated success in consultative enterprise sales, strategic accounts, or business development involving complex hardware, software, SaaS, or services solutions.
  • Experience developing sales strategies and structuring and negotiating high-value commercial agreements and multi-year partnerships through extended procurement cycles.
  • Strong knowledge of utility business models, regulatory environments, and energy program structures.
  • Ability to apply a rigorous, consultative enterprise selling framework, build business cases and pricing strategies, maintain pipeline visibility and forecast accuracy, and influence executive stakeholders.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% for customer meetings, industry events, and on-site deal development.

Good to Have:

  • MBA or advanced degree.
  • Experience with virtual power plants, demand response & energy efficiency programs, distributed energy resources, retail energy programs, grid services, or home energy management technologies.
  • Established network within the North American utility and energy services ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with wholesale electricity markets, DER aggregation, carbon markets, and home energy management technologies.

Just so you know:The hired candidate will be required to complete a background check.


What happens after you apply:

Application review. It will happen by an actual person in Talent Acquisition.

We get upwards of 100+ applications for some roles, it can take a few days, but every applicant can expect a note regarding their application status.


Interview Process:

  • A 30-minute phone call with a member in Talent Acquisition.
  • A first round 60-minute virtual interview with the hiring manager and a team member – expect behavioural and situational questions.
  • The final interview will be a 60-minute case study round with a panel of cross functional leaders.

Generac is committed to fair and equity compensation practices. The salary range for this remote role is $134,200 - $164,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate's relevant work experience, skills, certifications and geographic location. This position includes a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision plans; life, long-term disability, flexible, spending and health savings accounts, accrued paid time off, eight paid holidays in 401(k) retirement benefits.

Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Date de démarrage

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld édite plusieurs SaaS B2C par abonnement, dont certains s'appuient sur l'intelligence artificielle, utilisés chaque année par des millions de personnes dans le monde. Notre acquisition amène énormément de trafic sur nos produits : le prochain levier de croissance, c'est de transformer davantage de visiteur(se)s en client(e)s, puis de faire en sorte que nos abonné(e)s tirent pleinement parti de leur abonnement.

C'est tout l'enjeu du poste de Product Growth Ops : ta mission est de transformer nos visiteur(se)s en client(e)s et de maximiser leur engagement dans la durée, avec un impact direct sur le chiffre d'affaires et la rentabilité de nos SaaS.

Tu interviens sur trois leviers : reconvertir les visiteur(se)s et inscrit(e)s qui n'ont pas finalisé leur parcours (re-marketing), construire et opérer le CRM qui unifie la connaissance de nos client(e)s B2C, et maximiser l'engagement de nos utilisateur(rice)s, avant comme après l'achat, pour réduire leur time-to-value et augmenter leur lifetime value.

Tu es le/la premier(e) Product Growth Ops de DotWorld : tu es pleinement lead sur la manière de conduire les campagnes, le choix des outils et la définition des indicateurs de succès. Ta réussite se mesure à l'impact de tes actions sur les conversions et le revenu - ici, ce sont les résultats qui comptent, pas le temps passé.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoins l'organisation Produit, sous la responsabilité de Jérémy RICHARD, notre CPO, qui sera ton manager direct.

Le poste est rattaché au Produit car la grande majorité de tes initiatives se construisent avec les Product Managers de chaque SaaS. Tu travailles aussi en lien étroit avec l'équipe Acquisition et le département Data : un rôle transverse, à la jonction du produit, du marketing et de la donnée.

💻 Tes responsabilités

Re-marketing & conversion

  • Concevoir et piloter les campagnes de re-marketing (emailing, retargeting) pour reconvertir les visiteur(se)s et inscrit(e)s n'ayant pas finalisé leur parcours d'achat

  • Construire les audiences et le ciblage en coordination avec l'équipe Acquisition, pour des campagnes cohérentes sur l'ensemble du funnel

  • Mesurer la performance de chaque campagne (délivrabilité, conversion, revenu) et itérer rapidement

CRM unifié

  • Mettre en place et piloter un CRM unifié des client(e)s et prospects B2C de l'ensemble de nos SaaS, référence unique pour toutes les équipes

  • Structurer le modèle de données client, garantir sa fiabilité et construire des segmentations exploitables, avec le département Data

  • Mettre la donnée CRM au service des campagnes, du produit et de l'acquisition (audiences, triggers, personnalisation)

Engagement, adoption & rétention

  • Amener chaque utilisateur(rice) à la valeur le plus vite possible et réengager les abonné(e)s qui n'utilisent plus le produit

  • Concevoir et automatiser les campagnes lifecycle tout au long du cycle de vie utilisateur (in-app, emails, newsletters)

  • Mener des études et interviews utilisateur(rice)s pour comprendre pourquoi certain(e)s ne reviennent pas, et transformer ces insights en recommandations concrètes pour les équipes Produit

  • Suivre l'activation, l'engagement et la rétention, et partager des insights actionnables

Growth machine

  • Outiller, automatiser et documenter les mécaniques growth pour qu'elles passent à l'échelle sur l'ensemble de nos SaaS

  • Faire le pont entre Produit, Acquisition et Data pour que la machine tourne sans friction

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • Environ 5 ans d'expérience en growth, CRM / lifecycle marketing ou marketing automation

  • Des résultats prouvés et chiffrés : tu sais relier tes campagnes à leur impact sur la conversion et le revenu

  • Une expérience en B2C à fort volume est indispensable, idéalement sur des SaaS par abonnement

Compétences techniques

  • Culture d'expérimentation : conception et lecture de tests, décisions fondées sur la donnée

  • Usage autonome et quotidien des outils d'IA (analyse, rédaction, automatisation, création de segments et de contenus)

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Ownership de bout en bout : de la conception d'une campagne à la mesure de son impact

  • Hands-on, autonome et orienté(e) résultats

  • Aisance dans la gestion de nombreuses parties prenantes

  • Exigence qualité et souci du détail sur chaque message envoyé aux utilisateur(rice)s

  • Curiosité pour les utilisateur(rice)s : tu aimes comprendre leurs comportements et leurs besoins

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais courant (B2 minimum) - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement

✨ Les avantages du poste

  • Un rôle transverse et central, au cœur de la Growth machine de plusieurs SaaS B2C

  • Un impact direct et mesurable sur le revenu, à l'échelle de millions d'utilisateur(rice)s

  • Le premier poste de Product Growth Ops chez DotWorld : tu choisis les outils, les méthodes et les KPI

  • Une forte autonomie et une vraie liberté de décision sur tes campagnes

🔥 Les défis du poste

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance, Matteo - 1h

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence

Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ?

Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

  • Execute product-level marketing plans for core and supplemental literacy products, including Magnetic Literacy and Phonics for Reading, in partnership with the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing and product marketing peers, so launches and campaigns stay on schedule

  • Working knowledge of K–12 literacy instruction, such as foundational skills, phonics, and comprehension, and how districts review and adopt curriculum

Energy Markets Consultant/Senior Energy Markets Consultant

Location: US Remote or ICF Office Hybrid (Reston, VA)


About ICF

ICF helps clients navigate the rapidly evolving energy landscape through market analysis, forecasting, transaction support, strategic advisory services, and regulatory expertise. Our clients include power plant developers, utilities, infrastructure investors, lenders, private equity firms, technology companies, government agencies, and other stakeholders shaping the future of the energy industry. ICF’s Power Markets team supports investment decisions, asset development, mergers and acquisitions, resource planning, and policy evaluation across major U.S. power markets and regions, including CAISO, WECC, ERCOT, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, SPP, and SERC.


About the Role

ICF is seeking an Energy Markets Consultant/Senior Energy Markets Consultant to join our growing Power Markets practice. In this role, you will work with leading energy industry participants to evaluate investment opportunities, forecast market outcomes, assess risks, and develop strategies in an increasingly complex energy environment.

You will contribute to projects involving power market forecasting, asset valuation, transmission and interconnection analysis, renewable energy development, battery energy storage systems (BESS), resource adequacy, data center load growth, and energy transition initiatives. Working alongside experienced industry professionals, you will gain exposure to a broad range of technical, financial, and strategic issues affecting U.S. electricity markets while developing expertise that directly informs major investment and business decisions.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Perform quantitative, economic, and technical analyses of U.S. power markets using commercial market models, proprietary tools, and large datasets.
  • Develop long-term forecasts of energy, capacity, ancillary services, and renewable energy market outcomes.
  • Evaluate renewable energy, battery storage, conventional generation, transmission, and emerging energy investments.
  • Analyze market fundamentals, including load growth, fuel prices, transmission congestion, generation retirements, policy changes, and new resource additions.
  • Support interconnection and transmission analyses, including assessments of queue activity, network upgrade costs, congestion impacts, and project economics.
  • Assist with asset valuations, project financing analyses, acquisition due diligence, and M&A support engagements.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to enhance ICF’s proprietary forecasting methodologies, databases, and analytical tools.
  • Prepare client presentations, technical reports, and market insights that effectively communicate complex findings to technical, nontechnical, and executive audiences.
  • Support business development initiatives through market research, proposal preparation, conference participation, and thought leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Economics, Finance, Operations Research, Mathematics, Energy Systems, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, and 2–8+ years of relevant experience in U.S. power markets.
  • Experience with power market simulation and forecasting tools such as PROMOD®, PLEXOS®, Aurora®, PSLF®, or similar platforms.
  • Project management and/or consulting experience.
  • Experience communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of market design, transmission systems, resource adequacy, and generation economics.
  • Experience supporting renewable energy, battery storage, transmission, utility, or infrastructure investment projects.
  • Knowledge of asset valuation, project finance, M&A due diligence, or investment analysis.
  • Experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, generative AI, and AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to improve market analysis, research, forecasting, data processing, automation, and client deliverables.
  • Interest in emerging topics, including energy transition, data center load growth, electrification, battery storage, transmission expansion, and grid modernization.
  • Experience using Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or other advanced analytical tools.

Professional Skills

  • Strong attention to detail, initiative, and commitment to client service.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a desire to continuously learn about energy markets and emerging technologies.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 


Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.


Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 


However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at .
