jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose: moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Proposal and Contract Manager to join our team. As a Senior Proposal and Contract Manager, you will manage the full proposal and contract process for clinical research clients, turning Requests for Proposal (RFPs) into client-ready budgets and contracts that set the foundation for successful studies. This client-facing position plays a key role in proposal accuracy, contract negotiation, and client satisfaction. It requires consistent management of proposal and contract processes from RFP receipt through client signature. You'll collaborate with Operations, Project Management, Legal, Business Development, and Finance teams, work with subject matter experts (SMEs), and follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) to deliver high-quality work.


Responsibilities include overall accountability for the end-to-end RFP process and the negotiation and management of client contracts, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence client outcomes.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic proposals, sound budgeting, and effective client negotiations. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Proposal and Contract Manager can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.


Key Responsibilities

  • Hold overall accountability for the full RFP process, from receiving and analyzing RFP documentation, including study protocols or synopses, through to delivery, identifying and mitigating risks along the way.
  • Ensure the appropriate SMEs are assigned to and notified of each RFP and coordinate key strategic and operational areas throughout proposal preparation.
  • Prepare and modify strategic proposals and budgets in response to RFPs and revisions, based on SME feedback and proposal management input, ensuring alignment with client specifications, communications, and internal assumptions.
  • Manage the overall contract process for specific or varied accounts, coordinating Operations, Project Management, Legal Business Development, and Finance to prepare, review, and negotiate contracts in line with departmental SOPs and work instructions.
  • Develop account-specific contract standards, including budget presentation, payment terms, and standard contract language, and build contract strategies and plans for delivery and client signature.
  • Lead and facilitate client meetings to negotiate costs and terms by targeted client signature dates, providing formatted client grids that clearly explain the rationale for cost changes.
  • Amend project budgets in partnership with project and functional teams, using internal tools and reports to update client budgets.
  • Draft contract documents from Parexel templates, and identify and manage contractual issues that require finance, tax, or other stakeholder input, applying lessons learned to new contracts.
  • Obtain third-party quotes as needed and independently map client bid-grids to the pricing tool, keeping mapping references up to date.
  • Keep documents, files, and data current in the appropriate systems for metrics and key performance indicator (KPI) reporting, while meeting internal and external deadlines.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor for less experienced team members, aid colleagues as workload allows, and take part in process improvement initiatives, tool refreshes, and change champion activities.

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in proposal development, contract negotiation, and budgeting.
  • A strong understanding of clinical study operations across different regions of the world, ideally gained through industry experience.
  • The ability to collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and escalate difficult situations appropriately.
  • A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and a sense of urgency.
  • Comfort working with pricing tools, Salesforce, and data systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Life Science, Business, or Languages, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4-6 years of previous experience in project support, finance, contracting, or proposals in a Contract Research Organization (CRO) or similar environment.
  • Broad experience in proposals and contract management, including contractual terms, pricing structures, pricing tools, and data systems such as Salesforce.
  • Standard knowledge of managing client contract processes and accounts, including reporting.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of cash flow and revenue recognition.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of relevant software, including Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook, and databases.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to work irregular and/or extended hours as needed to meet client proposal deadlines.
  • Fluent in written and oral English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA
  • Experience with multinational and multicultural companies

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.


If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

jobs.excerpt: Company Description Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance (COP QA) Manager to lead our team responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving Outside Plant (OSP) project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.


The ideal candidate will provide leadership, technical oversight, and operational direction to a team of QA specialists responsible for ensuring closeout packages are complete, accurate, and compliant with company specifications, customer requirements, and established quality standards.


This role requires a strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction, fiber optic testing, construction documentation, quality assurance processes, and team leadership. The manager will be responsible for driving review consistency, maintaining productivity and quality standards, identifying recurring deficiencies, and implementing corrective actions to improve the overall closeout process.


A critical component of this position is collaboration with OSP Project Managers (PMs) to communicate quality deficiencies, provide training and guidance, and improve the accuracy and completeness of initial package submissions.


The manager will also be responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports to track team performance, package review progress, quality trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Lead, manage, and develop the OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance team responsible for reviewing and validating completed OSP project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.
  • Oversee daily QA operations, including workload distribution, review prioritization, resource allocation, and adherence to established turnaround times.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, productivity targets, and quality standards for QA team members.
  • Monitor individual and team performance to ensure consistent, accurate, and timely completion of closeout package reviews.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, mentoring, and ongoing training to QA specialists to promote accountability, consistency, and professional development.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex package deficiencies, technical discrepancies, and operational challenges.

Closeout Package Quality Assurance

  • Oversee the comprehensive review of OSP closeout packages to ensure all required documentation, testing results, construction records, and supporting materials meet company specifications and customer requirements.
  • Ensure the team validates the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of submitted documentation, including as-built drawings, fiber assignments, splice records, test results, network inventory records, and other required closeout deliverables.
  • Direct the review and validation of fiber optic test results, including OTDR, insertion loss, optical power meter, Fiber Inspection Probe (FIP), Chromatic Dispersion (CD), and Polarization Mode Dispersion (PMD) data, as applicable.

Reporting, Metrics & Performance Management

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly reports detailing QA team performance, closeout package review activity, quality metrics, and operational trends.

  • Total closeout packages received, reviewed, approved, and rejected.

  • Package review turnaround times and aging.
  • Outstanding packages, backlog volume, and review status.
  • Rejection reasons, deficiency categories, and recurring quality issues.

  • Rework volume and repeat rejection rates.

  • Implement quality control measures to ensure consistent application of internal specifications and customer requirements.
  • Perform periodic audits of completed QA reviews to verify reviewer accuracy, process compliance, and documentation quality.
  • Analyze rejection trends and root causes to develop corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve documentation standards, submission processes, and overall closeout package quality.
  • Ensure QA records, review histories, and supporting documentation are maintained in accordance with company standards and audit requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on increasing first-pass acceptance rates, reducing review cycle times, and improving customer delivery readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing operational workflows, or supervising quality assurance activities.
  • Strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction processes, including fiber placement, splicing, testing, network documentation, and project closeout requirements.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience reviewing or analyzing fiber optic test results, including OTDR, OLTS, FIP, CD, and PMD, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and validate OSP construction drawings, as-built documentation, splice diagrams, fiber assignments, and network records.
  • Experience reviewing technical documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established specifications.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify recurring quality issues, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain operational reports, performance metrics, and KPI tracking.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and other business reporting and documentation tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide constructive feedback, facilitate training, and collaborate effectively with Project Managers and cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to hold team members accountable for performance, quality standards, and established procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with EXFO FastReporter, EXFO ConnectorMax, Viavi FiberCable2 Suite, Viavi FiberChekPRO, Anritsu NetWorks, and similar fiber optic test analysis platforms.

Key Performance Expectations

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Product Owner is a senior product leader who serves as the product lead for a large, cross-functional patient experience initiative to reimagine how new patients are onboarded, from identification and scheduling through the early visits and the transition to ongoing care. Guided by the principle that earlier information enables earlier care, the role turns the vision into a prioritized product roadmap that improves patient engagement, provider preparedness, care continuity, and clinical documentation quality, accelerating clinical and financial value.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Lead Product Owner partners with executive sponsors, business and clinical leaders, and workstream leads to deliver an initial MVP launch while continuing to advance the broader vision. The role helps keep shared documentation aligned with product decisions, guides technical and business decisions across engineering, data, design, and operations, and mentors Product Owners who support the initiative.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and integrated roadmap for the patient journey, sequencing the initial MVP and the fully reimagined journey across its stages, from identification through scheduling, initial visits, and the transition to ongoing care.
  • Translate journey design into epics, requirements, and complex user stories for capabilities such as care planning in the electronic medical record, pre-visit reporting, earlier records retrieval and gap identification, chart-prep triggers, upstream capture of critical patient information, forms and portal engagement, and earlier diagnostic screening workflows.
  • Prioritize across workstreams, making key decisions on value trade-offs, MVP scope, release sequencing, and dependencies, and drive resolution of open decisions such as patient identification criteria, clinical approvals, and opportunities to use technology to reduce provider administrative burden.
  • Partner with clinical operations, center and provider leadership, sales and growth, patient engagement, analytics, IT, compliance, engineering, and design to define role-based responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths, so every journey stage has accountable owners and closed-loop handoffs.
  • Establish and monitor shared success measures with analytics partners, such as time to first visit, pre-visit records capture, forms completion, task completion, timely documentation, and risk adjustment accuracy, and use them to drive continuous optimization.
  • Lead launch readiness and post-launch support for the MVP, including workflow validation with frontline teams, training and job aids, FAQs, decision and issue logs, escalation paths, hypercare, and ongoing refinement of the implementation roadmap.
  • Support the investment and value case for the journey, ensure regulatory alignment, and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to executive sponsors and senior leadership forums.

  • Proven ability to define and deliver product roadmaps using Agile methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, and leading agile ceremonies.
  • Strong understanding of value-based care models, clinical workflows, and healthcare regulations.
  • Demonstrated success using data, user research, and clinical insights to guide product decisions, improve outcomes, and track key KPIs (e.g., roadmap delivery, feature adoption, NPS, care gap closure).

jobs.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics


Labcorp is seeking a remote-based Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics to join our team!


Responsibilities:

Pricing & Demand Modeling

  • Lead price elasticity, demand forecasting, and scenario modeling to inform pricing, promotional, subscription, bundling, margin, and portfolio decisions.
  • Evaluate pricing opportunities and risks by balancing consumer demand, competitive dynamics, and business objectives.
  • Establish pricing frameworks and governance that support profitable, data-driven decision making.

Customer Economics & Growth Performance

  • Develop customer lifetime value (LTV), cohort, and retention frameworks.
  • Analyze customer, transaction, and product performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, average order value (AOV), and long-term customer value.
  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Product, and Merchandising leaders to align growth strategies with financial outcomes.

Experimentation, Measurement & Performance Insights

  • Partner on testing and experimentation strategies for pricing, promotions, subscriptions, bundles, and customer offers.
  • Establish measurement methodologies and success metrics that quantify initiative performance and business impact.
  • Develop executive reporting and performance insights that provide visibility into pricing effectiveness, customer economics, and growth initiatives.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that enable continuous optimization and informed decision making.

Competitive & Market Intelligence

  • Lead competitive intelligence efforts across pricing, product assortment, promotions, industry trends, and competitors.
  • Monitor consumer and market trends to identify opportunities, risks, and shifts in competitive positioning.
  • Translate market intelligence into strategic insights that inform portfolio, pricing, and growth strategies.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to scale competitive intelligence, identify emerging trends, and enhance predictive insights.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or Mathematics.
  • 7 or more years of experience in pricing analytics, revenue management, customer economics, commercial analytics or business intelligence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA).

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, consumer health, or other highly regulated industries where pricing decisions must balance customer value, compliance, and business objectives.
  • Demonstrated success building pricing and analytics management capabilities from the ground up, including frameworks, governance, tools, and measurement approaches.
  • Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, pricing decisions, competitive intelligence, and business performance.
  • Strong quantitative skills — comfort building pricing models, running elasticity analysis, and translating data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer (DTC), ecommerce, marketplace, retail, and/or consumer-focused digital health businesses.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based products, membership programs, or recurring revenue businesses.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining pricing optimization, price elasticity, demand forecasting, customer lifetime value, and scenario-planning models.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience translating large datasets into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience pricing products sold directly to consumers (as opposed to purely B2B or payer-negotiated pricing)
  • Track record of partnering cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Merchandising, and Finance
  • Advanced Excel/modeling skills; experience with pricing or BI tools (e.g., SQL, Looker, Tableau)
  • Excellent communication skills — able to present pricing recommendations to executives and translate strategy into simple, actionable guidance for go-to-market teams


About the Role

Labcorp OnDemand is a DTC consumer testing business growing rapidly within the expanding consumer health market.

As Director, Consumer Pricing & Analytics, you will play a foundational role in developing the models and insights that inform pricing decisions for direct-to-consumer diagnostic products in a market shaped by payer dynamics, out-of-pocket consumer spend, regulatory considerations, and competitive lab/testing offerings.

You'll build the pricing frameworks and governance that let the business grow profitably while staying accessible to the consumers we serve. This role is directly responsible for tying pricing decisions to business outcomes — including revenue growth targets, margin goals, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV) improvement, and subscription growth.

The ideal candidate brings experience from a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, retail, and/or digital health consumer business and has a proven track record of translating complex data into actionable commercial recommendations.

This role is remote-based in the US.

Acid Recovery Application Engineer(chemical process engineer)

Location:Rochester, NY (Remote Work Potential)
Travel: Approximately 20-30%

Join a Global Leader in Process Systems Engineering

GMM Pfaudler is a leading supplier of highly engineered equipment and process systems serving the chemical, pharmaceutical, energy, and industrial markets. Our Systems Group designs and delivers custom process solutions including Acid Recovery, Evaporation, Distillation, Reactor, and Wiped Film Evaporation (WFE) systems for customers around the world.

GMM Pfaudler designs and builds Acid Recovery process systems which, through evaporation and distillation process steps, purify spent/waste acid from various chemical processes enabling customers to re-use the acids to reduce operating costs. As part of our strategic growth, we are expanding our Acid Recovery business in the United States. This role offers a unique opportunity to become a technical leader in a specialized and growing technology area while working closely with our global Acid Recovery Center of Excellence in Hofheim, Germany.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Chemical Process Engineer to support business development through the sale of Acid Recovery Systems throughout North America.

This role combines process engineering, customer engagement, and commercial sales. You will work directly with customers to understand their process requirements, develop preliminary process designs to meet customer needs, prepare project costs estimates and proposals, and negotiate contracts to secure new business.

The ideal candidate enjoys working directly with customers to understand their process needs, solving complex process challenges and transforming process data into practical, commercial-scale solutions, and securing contracts.

What You'll Do

Process Design & Application Engineering

  • Develop preliminary process designs for acid recovery systems based on customer requirements, pilot testing data, and historical system performance.
  • Collaborate with pilot test engineers to develop and execute testing programs and then utilize pilot plant and laboratory data to scale processes to commercial production systems.
  • Perform engineering calculations and complete mass and energy balances for system equipment sizing and select instrumentation necessary for process monitoring and control.

Customer & Sales Support

  • Review customer inquiries and identify technical and commercial requirements.
  • Serve as the customer’s technical resource throughout the sales cycle.
  • Present process solutions and system recommendations to customers.
  • Travel to customer sites to support business development through technical discussions, proposal reviews, and contract negotiations.

Proposal Development

  • Utilize in-house cost data and vendor quotations to develop system cost estimates.
  • Prepare budgetary and firm-price proposals that present GMM Pfaudler solutions and their technical and commercial value to customers.

Project Support

  • Review customer purchase orders and ensure alignment with proposal scope.
  • Support project handoff activities with project execution teams.
  • Provide technical guidance during early project execution phases.
  • Participate in post-project reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry with sufficient system design/engineering experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of strong chemical process engineering experience; 8 – 15 years experience preferred.
  • Experience designing chemical process systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20-30%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with evaporation and distillation systems.
  • Customer-facing technical sales experience.
  • Additional skills which are not required but considered a plus for a candidate
    • Acid recovery systems design or operation experience
    • Experience conducting or utilizing pilot plant testing.
    • Aspen Plus, Aspen Exchanger Design, or similar process simulation and equipment sizing software.

Why Join GMM Pfaudler?

  • Unique opportunity to become a U.S.-based expert in Acid Recovery technology.
  • Exposure to diverse process applications across chemical and industrial markets.
  • Direct interaction with customers and leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Flexible work arrangements including remote work potential.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Job Description Summary

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA)

(Field Based)

Primary Location: Southeast United States

Drive clinical trials forward where it matters most - at the site level and with patients at the center. As a Senior CRA at Novartis, you will manage trusted site relationships and perform on-site and remote monitoring activities to support the initiation, conduct, and timely completion of Phase I – IV trials in compliance with International Council for Harmonization / Good Clinical Practices (ICH/GCP), local regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring procedures. Serving as a key point of contact for investigational sites, you will proactively manage site performance, recruitment, quality, risks, and issue resolution to ensure sustainable trial execution and high-quality data delivery. Assigned to complex trials and/or less experienced sites, you may also act as a Subject Matter Expert, support audit and inspection readiness activities, ensure timely implementation of corrective actions, and collaborate with local and global cross-functional teams to drive process improvements that help bring innovative therapies to patients faster.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 80% travel.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead assigned sites as the primary point of contact throughout study delivery
  • Build strong relationships to ensure site performance, quality, and milestone achievement
  • Manage Phase I to Phase IV trials per monitoring plans and company procedures
  • Conduct site initiation visits and deliver ongoing training for site personnel
  • Perform remote and on-site monitoring to ensure compliance and patient safety
  • Maintain accurate documentation and update all clinical systems in a timely manner
  • Identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate concerns as needed
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive efficient study execution
  • Support timely data query resolution and ensure data accuracy
  • Act as a subject matter expert across study activities when required

Essential Requirements

  • Minimum of three years of clinical site monitoring experience
  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in science, healthcare, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of clinical research and drug development processes
  • Knowledge of ICH/GCP and 21 CFR regulatory requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
  • Strong site management, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken, Spanish highly desired
  • Ability to drive and travel extensively, up to 80%, in a company vehicle

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience in multiple therapeutic areas and Veeva Vault CTMS is a plus

JOB SUMMARY:

AI engineering org at One Call is leading a major transformation on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. In short, this org is leading a lot of green field opportunities, and we are looking for like-minded leaders who are excited about building 0->1 products.

Our AI engineering team is at the heart of delivering scalable, intelligent, AI-powered solutions that transform the very core of workers' compensation experience. We are seeking a Principal AI Engineer to join the team and help build the next generation of agentic AI services that will improve patient outcomes. You will take product specifications and turn them into production-ready, scalable AI services, working with LLM for orchestration, multi-agent coordination, and RAG-based systems. You will ship production services that directly impact adjusters, patients, and internal operations.

  • Translate product specifications into AI service architectures – decompose business intent into agent workflows, data source integrations, and scalable service designs.

  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
  • Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
  • Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:

  • Buid automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates.

  • Relevance and precision/recall
  • Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  • Cost tracking and efficiency
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, security ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems

The Role

Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.

As Moderna expands its U.S. seasonal respiratory vaccine portfolio, we are seeking a strategic, transformational commercial leader to shape the future of regional account management, build high-performing teams, and accelerate vaccine adoption across complex healthcare systems. You will lead the evolution from broad, COVID-19-focused coverage to sophisticated, portfolio-based customer engagement, translating national commercial strategy into regional execution across COVID-19, influenza, RSV, and future launches. Through exceptional people leadership, strategic customer partnerships, and disciplined execution, you will connect enterprise-level access decisions with meaningful site-level activation and sustained portfolio growth.

This remote, field-based leadership opportunity will place you at the center of Moderna's evolving U.S. commercial model, with responsibility for leading Regional Account Managers (RAMs) across a defined U.S. region. You will drive strategic engagement with prioritized integrated delivery networks (IDNs), health systems, physician and provider networks, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), government and public-health customers, and relevant retail partners.

Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop a high-performing regional account management team: Recruit, assess, onboard, coach, and retain exceptional Regional Account Managers, building the capabilities required for a more sophisticated, portfolio-focused commercial organization. Establish clear performance expectations and individualized development plans spanning strategic account planning, consultative selling, competitive positioning, contracting, customer engagement, and vaccine pull-through.
  • Translate national portfolio strategy into regional commercial impact: Develop and execute a disciplined regional account management strategy aligned with nationally established portfolio priorities and go-to-market objectives across COVID-19, influenza, RSV, and future launches. Adapt execution to distinct customer decision-makers, contracting calendars, competitive dynamics, and seasonal vaccine requirements while operating within established national strategy, contracting authorities, and compliance guardrails.
  • Build sophisticated, insight-driven strategic account plans: Lead the development, prioritization, and execution quality of comprehensive regional account plans informed by customer segmentation, portfolio opportunities, stakeholder mapping, purchasing behaviors, competitive intelligence, and account-specific objectives. Establish measurable milestones, clear accountability, and execution pathways that translate strategic opportunities into sustainable customer adoption.
  • Establish trusted partnerships with senior healthcare decision-makers: Build executive-level relationships across prioritized IDNs, health systems, provider networks, FQHCs, government and public-health organizations, and relevant retail partners. Represent Moderna in senior customer and public-health forums, strengthen the portfolio-level value proposition, and serve as a regional escalation and coordination leader for complex opportunities, ensuring clear ownership between Regional and National Account Management and functional partners.
  • Connect enterprise-level access to site-level vaccine adoption: Lead regional strategies that translate Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) arrangements, enterprise purchasing decisions, and health-system access opportunities into organizational opt-in, operational readiness, site-level activation, and sustained vaccine ordering and pull-through. Guide your team in navigating the interconnected clinical, economic, formulary, purchasing, and operational processes that influence adoption across complex healthcare systems.
  • Provide leadership across complex contracting and access pathways: Oversee account-level contracting readiness, escalation, and compliant execution in partnership with National Account Management, Market Access, Legal, Finance, and other authorized decision-makers. Equip RAMs to navigate GPO arrangements, health-system opt-in processes, formulary requirements, purchasing pathways, and implementation challenges while maintaining rigorous adherence to delegated contracting authorities and compliance requirements.
  • Develop engagement strategies across the complete healthcare stakeholder ecosystem: Coach your team to engage pharmacy leadership, population health, infectious disease, quality, ambulatory care, employee health, high-volume clinics, and other influential health-system stakeholders. Strengthen the team's ability to navigate clinical, economic, operational, and purchasing decision processes, bringing in Medical Affairs colleagues appropriately to support compliant scientific engagement.
  • Build a high-performance, change-ready leadership culture: Establish an environment defined by accountability, strong field coaching, capability assessment, performance calibration, and continuous improvement. Reinforce manager-led coaching practices and consistently evaluate both the quality of strategic customer engagement and the delivery of measurable business outcomes, supporting the team through evolving commercial priorities and operating models.
  • Shape the future of regional account management capabilities: Partner closely with Field Enablement & Capabilities to translate enterprise standards into consistent hiring criteria, onboarding experiences, training adoption, coaching frameworks, and readiness assessments. Identify critical capability gaps and develop targeted interventions that prepare RAMs for increasingly complex portfolio-based engagement, competitive positioning, and customer activation.
  • Turn customer and market intelligence into strategic advantage: Systematically synthesize insights from regional field engagement, customer decision-making, competitive activity, purchasing behavior, and evolving healthcare market dynamics. Translate these insights into sharper account prioritization, portfolio positioning, regional resource deployment, national commercial planning, and continuous refinement of Moderna's go-to-market model.
  • Drive performance through advanced analytics and digital tools: Leverage CRM platforms, strategic account planning tools, field analytics, and established leading and lagging performance indicators to assess target-account coverage, stakeholder engagement, account-plan progression, contract activation, ordering patterns, customer adoption, and regional business results. Identify data-quality gaps, challenge assumptions, and adjust resource deployment and engagement strategies based on actionable insights. Explore opportunities to apply digital innovation, including emerging Generative AI-enabled tools where approved, to enhance account insights, coaching effectiveness, and commercial productivity.
  • Establish a balanced approach to commercial performance management: Monitor regional outcomes, including vaccine volume, market share, and customer adoption, alongside leading indicators such as priority-account engagement, decision-maker coverage, strategic account-plan progress, and implementation milestones. Use these measures to strengthen execution discipline, identify barriers early, and drive consistent improvement in both near-term results and long-term account development.
  • Orchestrate seamless cross-functional commercial execution: Work collaboratively with National Account Management, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Market Access, Public Affairs, Commercial Excellence, Distribution, Customer Service, and approved external channel partners to deliver coordinated customer engagement. Clarify account ownership, functional responsibilities, escalation pathways, and execution priorities while maintaining appropriate boundaries between promotional activity and scientific exchange.
  • Lead transformational change across the regional commercial model: Guide your team through a multi-year evolution from broad, COVID-19-oriented coverage toward targeted, sophisticated, portfolio-based account engagement. Champion new deployment approaches, strengthen team readiness, preserve customer continuity, and clarify ownership across regional and national teams. Capture learnings from commercial pilots and emerging go-to-market channels to support scalable improvements across the organization.
  • Strengthen regional execution through customer activation and operational excellence: Connect regional account strategies with practical implementation requirements across health systems, provider networks, public-health customers, and relevant retail partners. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve implementation barriers, strengthen contracting-to-activation processes, and ensure customer decisions translate into consistent site-level adoption and sustained vaccine access.
  • Champion integrity, accountability, and compliant customer engagement: Ensure all regional account management activities comply with Moderna policies and applicable healthcare laws and regulations. Maintain appropriate separation between promotional and scientific exchange, ensure adherence to approved product labeling, and reinforce disciplined decision-making within established contracting authorities and organizational compliance standards.

This role will own strategy, execution, and optimization across email, SMS, push, in-app, voice, paid search, paid social, display, and emerging digital channels. The ideal candidate blends strong marketing fundamentals with analytical rigor and practical use of AI to improve personalization, segmentation, creative velocity, and operational efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with sales, client development, product, analytics, data science, engineering, and compliance to deliver measurable impact while maintaining a high bar for patient experience, privacy, and brand integrity. This is a globally distributed team. You will work closely with US-based leadership and peers and should be comfortable with regular evening availability to support real-time collaboration across time zones.

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to improve martech infrastructure, conversion tracking, event instrumentation, data quality, and campaign orchestration across the patient journey.

  • Ensure responsible use of AI and patient data in partnership with legal and compliance teams, with attention to privacy, consent, bias mitigation, explainability, and healthcare marketing requirements. Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure AI tools and patient data are used responsibly, with attention to privacy, consent, and bias mitigation. You will have guardrails and support, not sole ownership of this domain.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends, platform changes, privacy shifts, healthcare engagement best practices, and emerging AI capabilities; translate relevant developments into pragmatic pilots and scaled programs.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience working with or within US-based companies, including comfort navigating US business culture, cross-timezone collaboration, and US consumer marketing standards.
  • Demonstrated success managing omnichannel campaigns across owned and paid channels, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI, automation, predictive analytics, or generative AI tools to marketing workflows, audience strategy, experimentation, or content operations.
  • Strong AI aptitude, including curiosity, sound judgment, and practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, content development, campaign optimization, analysis, and day-to-day marketing workflows.
  • Strong analytical and technical skills, including expertise in SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar tools.
  • Experience with digital advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, paid social, display, and retargeting platforms.
  • Deep understanding of segmentation, funnel analysis, attribution, incrementality measurement, and test design.
  • Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-starter with a strong work ethic and a track record of delivering results while working with distributed or remote teams.
  • Comfortable with regular evening availability to collaborate with US-based team members and leadership in real time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, pharmacy, or another regulated consumer industry.
  • Experience partnering with data science, product, and engineering teams to bring new measurement, modeling, or personalization capabilities into production.

jobs.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Role

S&P Dow Jones Indices is seeking a commercially minded Associate Director, Multi-Asset Product Management to join our Multi-Asset Product Management team in New York.


This role will support the development and growth of S&P DJI's multi-asset index franchise across a broad range of index-linked investment solutions, including defined outcome, risk-controlled, asset allocation, retirement, insurance, structured product, and derivatives-based strategies.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in multi-asset product management or investment solutions, experience supporting product development initiatives, and a solid understanding of systematic investment strategies. While familiarity with options and derivatives is valuable, success in this role will be driven by the ability to manage products across their lifecycle, understand client needs, and translate investment concepts into commercially relevant solutions.


This role requires close partnership with clients, Sales, Research & Design, Index Governance, Marketing, Technology, and other stakeholders. The successful candidate will combine technical knowledge, commercial awareness, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively across a global matrixed organization.


The Team

The Multi-Asset Product Management team at S&P Dow Jones Indices is responsible for setting product strategy, driving product development, and managing the long-term commercial success of a global suite of multi-asset indices.


The team develops solutions for a broad range of client segments, including banks, asset managers, ETF issuers, insurance companies, wealth platforms, and institutional investors. The product suite includes strategies focused on index-linked insurance products, structured products, derivatives overlays, volatility control, retirement solutions, asset allocation, and other systematic multi-asset strategies.


The team has a global mandate and works closely with regional commercial teams and clients to identify market opportunities, launch innovative index solutions, and support adoption of S&P DJI’s multi-asset capabilities.


Responsibilities and Impact

  • Support the research, development, and launch of systematic multi-asset indices and investment solutions, including asset allocation, risk-controlled, target outcome, insurance-related, and derivatives-based strategies, partnering with Research & Design and Index Governance to establish transparent, rules-based methodologies.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Product Management, Research & Design, Index Governance, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Technology to drive product outcomes without direct management authority.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in client meetings, product pitches, trainings, and conferences, translating complex index strategies into clear commercial narratives and client solutions.
  • Contribute to thought leadership and product positioning through presentations, white papers, client materials, market commentary, and internal and external product messaging.
  • Monitor market trends, client needs, and the competitive landscape — including QIS desks, investment banks, exchanges, structured product platforms, ETF issuers, and insurance providers — to identify new product opportunities and inform product strategy.
  • Support the lifecycle management of the existing multi-asset index suite, tracking product performance, commercial traction, and market relevance to identify opportunities for enhancements and repositioning.

What’s In It For You

  • The opportunity to contribute to product strategy and innovation for a sophisticated and commercially important global index product suite.
  • Direct involvement in developing multi-asset index solutions used across ETFs, retirement products, insurance solutions, structured products, and institutional investment applications.
  • Regular interaction with clients, commercial teams, quantitative researchers, index governance stakeholders, and product leaders across S&P Dow Jones Indices.
  • The opportunity to build deep expertise across multi-asset and systematic investment strategies while contributing to an area of growing client demand.
  • A role combining product development, investment expertise, client engagement, and commercial execution.

Compensation/Benefits Information (US Applicants Only)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $104-435 – $170,1470. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits.


What We’re Looking For

We are looking for an experienced product management or investment professional with a strong understanding of multi-asset investment solutions and experience supporting product development, strategy, and commercialization.


The successful candidate will possess knowledge of systematic investment approaches, including asset allocation, target outcome, risk-controlled, retirement, insurance, and derivatives-linked strategies, and will be comfortable operating at the intersection of product development, client engagement, and commercial execution.


Experience supporting investment solutions designed to address client objectives such as income generation, risk management, volatility control, capital preservation, participation enhancement, and retirement outcomes is highly desirable. Familiarity with options and derivatives-based approaches is beneficial but is not required to have been a primary area of specialization.


This individual should be comfortable discussing methodology and investment concepts with quantitative stakeholders while also articulating the commercial value proposition to clients and sales teams.


Basic Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, index strategy, investment solutions, asset management, or related financial services roles, with demonstrable exposure to multi-asset investment strategies.
  • Quantitative background with an understanding of index construction, portfolio design, and multi-asset investment strategies, including asset allocation, retirement, target outcome, risk-controlled, insurance-linked, and derivatives-based approaches.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Research & Design, Sales, Governance, Marketing, Operations, and Technology, and to drive outcomes collaboratively.
  • Commercial mindset with demonstrated experience supporting product adoption, client engagement, and revenue growth for investment, index, or multi-asset solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or Computer Science.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting or developing multi-asset index solutions, including target outcome, risk-controlled, retirement, insurance-linked, volatility-controlled, or derivatives-linked strategies.
  • Familiarity with index methodology governance, launch lifecycle, and operational considerations for investable indices.
  • Advanced degree and/or professional credentials (e.g., CFA, CAIA) and/or programming skills (Python, R, or MATLAB).
  • Experience building models, backtests, simulations, risk analytics, or index strategy prototypes.
  • Experience presenting at client meetings, conferences, webinars, or sales training forums.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive landscape across QIS desks, investment banks, exchanges, index providers, ETF issuers, and structured product platforms.
  • Experience mentoring or developing junior product management professionals.

Right to Work Requirements: This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States.

About S&P Global Dow Jones Indices

At S&P Dow Jones Indices, we provide iconic and innovative index solutions backed by unparalleled expertise across the asset-class spectrum. By bringing transparency to the global capital markets, we empower investors everywhere to make decisions with conviction. We’re the largest global resource for index-based concepts, data and research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500® and the Dow Jones Industrial Average®. More assets are invested in products based upon our indices than any other index provider in the world. With over USD 7.4 trillion in passively managed assets linked to our indices and over USD 11.3 trillion benchmarked to our indices, our solutions are widely considered indispensable in tracking market performance, evaluating portfolios and developing investment strategies.

S&P Dow Jones Indices is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today. For more information, visit .

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

  • Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

  • Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit:

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Come join Baker Tilly's Development Advisory (DA) team as a Project Manager working on our Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship compliance team. You will be a part of our larger Development Advisory team, which provides a variety of services including, but not limited to, energy and infrastructure advisory and project development support, economic development and capital planning support, and federal grant advisory with potential clients such as Tribes and Tribal Organizations, municipalities, non-profits, and other for-profit entities.


This position plays an integral part in Baker Tilly's services tied to the Inflation Reduction Act ("IRA") of 2022. We are seeking a professional with hands-on experience navigating California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR) compliance and prevailing wage regulations, including the operational requirements associated with certified payroll, apprenticeship compliance, and construction labor standards. This experience will be critical in supporting clients with federal Prevailing Wage and Apprenticeship (PWA) requirements under the IRA.


As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, Baker Tilly offers upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.


You will enjoy this role if:

  • You enjoy being in a project manager role helping internal and external stakeholders meet their collective goals.
  • You have an interest in energy incentives, construction labor compliance or the Inflation Reduction Act ("IRA") of 2022.
  • You have experience navigating prevailing wage regulations, including California DIR compliance requirements, and enjoy helping clients manage complex labor compliance obligations.
  • You crave an opportunity to work with a team of professionals that will challenge you mentally and provide an opportunity for tremendous growth.
  • You want to be part of a firm that is invested in your success by providing the resources and support to continually sharpen your project management and consulting skills and build your career now, for tomorrow.

What you will do:

  • Lead prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance efforts for projects seeking IRA credits.
  • Leverage experience with California DIR prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance requirements to support clients in meeting applicable federal PWA requirements under the IRA.
  • Oversee and review prevailing wage compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, wage classifications, apprenticeship participation, and related labor compliance reporting.
  • Identify potential compliance gaps and advise clients and contractors on corrective actions related to prevailing wage, apprenticeship utilization, and documentation requirements.
  • Facilitate client and contractor meetings, train stakeholders to utilize our compliance program, respond to questions and direct to appropriate team members, and provide direct assistance to project stakeholders.
  • Advise internal and external clients on meeting specific requirements related to prevailing wage and apprenticeship throughout the construction process.
  • Utilize your interpersonal communication skills to build and manage strong relationships with Baker Tilly colleagues and our clients.
  • Assist team leaders by documenting and analyzing processes, internal controls, and workflow to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support project staff in day-to-day service delivery.
  • Learn and grow from direct on-the-job coaching and mentoring along with participating in firmwide learning and development programs.
  • Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 4-year degree
  • 5 years of professional experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, supply chain, engineering, construction management or a related field.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of progressive related consulting experience, including at least one (1) year serving as a project manager.
  • Hands-on experience with California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR) compliance, including prevailing wage requirements, certified payroll reporting, apprenticeship standards, and construction labor compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply prevailing wage and apprenticeship regulations, with an understanding of how state-level DIR compliance experience translates to federal PWA requirements under the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA).
  • Experience reviewing certified payroll records, identifying wage classification discrepancies, monitoring apprenticeship participation, and supporting compliance audits or reporting requirements.
  • Familiarity with federal prevailing wage requirements, including the Davis-Bacon Act and related labor standards, preferred.
  • Demonstrated management, analytical, organizational, interpersonal, project management, and communication skills, along with highly developed Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel).
  • Ability to provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning to stay current regarding applicable strategies, see the "big picture" as well as the details, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of duties.
  • Experience within the construction industry or construction labor compliance.

The pay range for this position is $66,000 to $182,200.   • Collaborate with device modeling and PDK teams to assess model accuracy, identify model or design-rule gaps, and provide circuit-level feedback supporting cryogenic and advanced PDK development and validation.

jobs.excerpt: Metricool is a social media management tool that helps freelancers, agencies, and marketing teams stay on top of their daily work.
jobs.description:
Metricool is a social media management tool that helps freelancers, agencies, and marketing teams stay on top of their daily work. Behind every calendar, report, and post, there’s someone juggling deadlines and trying to make sense of their numbers—and our job is to make that work clearer and calmer.

As a Graphic Designer on our Content team, you’ll report to the Content Team Manager and work closely with the people leading Social, YouTube, Lead Magnets, and Emails. Your mission will be to bring design into the process from the very start. You’ll join at the brief, propose formats, push back when something doesn’t add up, and review performance data to see what actually worked. When a format proves itself, you’ll turn it into a reusable template for the rest of the team.

You’ll work 100% remotely as part of an international team publishing in four languages, where good design means clear hierarchy, clean data, and visuals that earn attention without shouting.

Your day-to-day

The design team shares this work and splits it by project:

  • Design for social across four markets.You’ll create static posts and carousels for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and Pinterest in English, Spanish, German and French, adapting to each platform and market. The copy comes from the Social team, so you don’t need to speak all four languages.

  • Make thumbnails that earn the click. You’ll design YouTube thumbnails and run A/B tests on key videos to learn what resonates with our audience.

  • Turn complex data into clear layouts. You’ll design industry reports, templates, and guides so readers can grasp the numbers at a glance.

  • Design the landing pages for our resources.You’ll design the pages behind our resource downloads, focusing on clarity and visual flow.

  • Maintain and evolve our design system. Alongside the rest of the design team, you’ll update Content’s templates, components, and usage rules.

  • Iterate based on results. You’ll review how your pieces perform with each channel lead and adjust your approach based on real numbers.

What we’re looking for

  • Design that starts with a "why".Before opening Figma, you ask what the piece is meant to achieve. You can explain the reasoning behind your layout and typography choices, and your portfolio reflects that.

  • An eye on performance. You look at clicks, saves, and downloads, draw your own conclusions, and apply them to your next piece. Experience running A/B tests or design experiments is a plus.

  • 3+ years in digital and social design.You understand how different platforms behave and have designed social posts, thumbnails, and landing pages.

  • Strong editorial and data skills. You’ve laid out multi-page documents like reports and know how to use typography, hierarchy, and charts to make information easy to scan.

  • Fluency in Figma. Components, auto layout, and shared libraries are part of your daily workflow.

  • Systems thinking. You’ve built and documented design systems that non-designers can use without breaking brand consistency. Experience with AI-assisted design workflows is a plus.

  • Versatility.A YouTube thumbnail, an Instagram carousel, and a 40-page report each require a different approach, and you adapt easily between them. Motion design basics are a bonus.

  • Comfort with open briefs. You don’t need every detail locked down before starting. You propose ideas, iterate quickly, and speak up when a brief feels off.

  • Openness to feedback. You see feedback as a way to make the work better. You share early drafts, welcome other points of view and give your own with care.

  • Organization and autonomy.You can juggle multiple channels and markets at once while keeping your files and process clean.

  • Spanish and advanced English. German or French is a big plus.

What your first months will look like

  • Month 1: You’ll get familiar with our brand identity, our design system, and the reasoning behind it, along with each channel’s goals and market nuances. You’ll start designing social posts and thumbnails with regular team reviews.

  • Month 3: You’ll own social posts and thumbnails across all four markets, lay out your first report and landing page, and start suggesting improvements based on performance data.

  • Month 12:You’ll co-own the design system with the design team, with recurring formats documented and running smoothly across Social and our AI workflows. You’ll be running thumbnail and landing page tests, hitting launch timelines reliably, and shaping format decisions with every channel lead.

Why you’ll love working at Metricool

  • 100% Remote:Work from home with the equipment you need to do your job comfortably.

  • Flexible Schedule: We trust you to organize your own day around your life, staying available during core hours to collaborate with the team.

  • Health Insurance:Comprehensive coverage so you can work with peace of mind.

  • Language Lessons: Support to learn or improve a language and connect more easily with teammates across markets.

  • Learning Platform:Full access to Udemy courses so you can keep exploring whatever sparks your curiosity.

  • The Epic Weekend: Once a year, the whole company meets in person to disconnect, catch up, and celebrate the work we’ve done together.

  • Salary: €26,000 – €35,000 gross per year, under the Spanish collective agreement for consulting, IT, and market and public opinion research companies (Convenio colectivo de empresas de consultoría, tecnologías de la información y estudios de mercado y de la opinión pública).

  • Room to grow:We’re scaling fast, and if you take ownership of your work, you’ll have plenty of space to shape your role.

The Process

  • 30-minute call with Sofía, People & Culture Specialist, to chat about your background, how we work, and your English level.

  • Portfolio review with Ana, Content Team Manager, and Andrea, Graphic Designer, to walk through your projects and how you make design decisions.

If you want to design work that helps thousands of social media professionals every day, send us your CV and portfolio.
