jobs.title: Head of Workforce Strategy & Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: Job Description Summary GE HealthCare is helping to build a world where healthcare has no limits.
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare is helping to build a world where healthcare has no limits. To get there, the way we work will be as important as what we make. This role is part of a larger transformation at GE HealthCare to redesign our end-to-end HR operating model. AI is changing how work gets done, and we need a leader who will design how our work, our organization and our workforce change with it, and who will guide our business and our people through that shift.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer and serving on the Chief People Officer’s leadership team, you will build and lead a new team responsible for workforce strategy and planning, people analytics (workforce and talent intelligence), and the design of work and organizations. This is a newly created role and one of the most important hires for the future of our People & Culture function.

Your team will own strategy, policy and program design. This includes setting the enterprise workforce strategy, building people analytics capabilities that drive insight across the organization, and creating the methods and frameworks for successful work redesign and organization design. Business and functional leaders own business outcomes. You bring the workforce and organization strategy, intelligence and design that help them deliver. You will work with business-aligned teams to apply the enterprise strategy to their unique businesses and put that work into practice, making sure they have the tools, guidance and skills to bring it to life.

Job Description

Key areas of scope

  • Workforce strategy and planning. The enterprise workforce strategy and plan; demand and supply of skills and capacity; planning for people and AI capacity together; the mix of employees, contractors and outside partners; location and footprint; workforce cost and value.
  • People analytics (workforce and talent intelligence). Workforce and talent analytics; external talent market insight; predictive signals; scenario models; and tools that help leaders make workforce decisions.
  • Work redesign and organization design. Organization and operating model design; role architecture; spans and layers; work simplification and productivity; and the redesign of work done by people and AI together.

Your first-year priorities

  • Workforce data foundation. Define the workforce data and infrastructure requirements needed to inform workforce strategy and planning over the next 12 to 24 months.
  • Enterprise workforce plan. Build the enterprise workforce strategy and plan for 2028 to 2029.
  • Playbook for the business. Create the playbook business teams use to apply the workforce plan to their own areas of the business.
  • People analytics and AI insight. Provide strategic direction as we build our digital infrastructure and AI-enabled insight into workforce capabilities, partnering with P&C technology, which builds and runs these tools.
  • Work redesign at scale. Build on our proven work redesign pilots, expand the capability across the company, and create the tools and frameworks to transform work at scale. Work redesign is the single biggest area of future value for People & Culture.

Key responsibilities

Work redesign and organization design

  • Make work redesign a core company capability, building on our existing pilots and growing it across businesses and functions.
  • Lead work redesign with a clear method: start with the outcome, understand how work really happens, design the future flow of work, then decide which tasks and decisions sit with people and which sit with technology.
  • Build the tools and frameworks to redesign work at scale, including a common list of tasks and roles, a library of proven ways for people and AI to work together, a standard for redesigned roles, and a method to measure the workforce impact of each redesign.
  • Set principles for organization and operating model design, role architecture, and spans and layers that adapt as AI changes how teams are structured.
  • Define clear roles and accountabilities across people and technology, including decision rights, where human judgment is required, quality standards and escalation paths, so teams can move quickly and people remain accountable for results.
  • Partner with technology teams on the governance of AI agents, adding a regular review of how they affect roles and the workforce.

Workforce strategy and planning

  • Turn business priorities into clear workforce goals, and own the enterprise workforce strategy and plan.
  • Plan for human and AI capacity together, modeling demand and supply of skills under different scenarios.
  • Set clear guidance on when to build, buy, borrow or automate: when to develop people, hire, use contractors or partners, or use AI and automation.
  • Protect the expertise the company needs, and strengthen pathways for early-career colleagues to build judgment as routine work changes.
  • Give leaders scenarios on location and footprint, and on workforce choices when we acquire businesses.
  • Build a clear view of workforce economics, including the full cost of the workforce, how capacity freed by automation is used, and whether expected value is actually realized.

People analytics (workforce and talent intelligence)

  • Lead people analytics, bringing together trusted people, skills, workload and performance data with business plans, colleague listening, and external talent market and competitor insight.
  • Define the data, measures and calculation rules that P&C technology needs to build workforce data and AI tools, and set how that data is governed, with strong privacy, security and responsible use.
  • Turn complex evidence into clear, decision-ready recommendations for the Chief People Officer, executives and business teams. Explain choices and uncertainty plainly, without overstating precision.
  • Move from looking back to looking ahead: build predictive signals that tell leaders when to act, and scenario models that show the trade-offs of each choice.

Influence and capability building

  • Build the capability of business-aligned teams to apply workforce strategy, planning and work redesign, through playbooks, tools, coaching and training.
  • Make clear who decides what on workforce and organization changes, and how decisions with effects beyond one business are escalated.
  • Partner closely with the Talent, Capability & Change team, Total Rewards, P&C technology, Finance and business unit leaders.
  • Be a trusted advisor to the Chief People Officer and senior leaders on how AI will change work and the workforce, and what to do about it.

How success will be measured

We will track early signals, such as readiness, decision speed and how quickly capacity moves to higher-value work, and connect them to lasting results that matter to the business, including:

  • Capability readiness. The workforce capabilities we need for our highest-priority work are in place before gaps slow us down.
  • Workforce value. Work, roles, structure and automation are designed so capacity shifts toward the highest-value work.
  • Faster, better decisions. Trusted workforce data and clear trade-offs lead to faster, better people and organization decisions.

Basic qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in workforce strategy, workforce planning, organization design, people analytics or HR strategy, in a company or as a consultant.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise-wide workforce planning or work redesign in a large, global organization.
  • Experience using data and analytics to shape senior leaders’ decisions about the workforce and the organization.
  • A track record of building new teams and capabilities, and of leading through influence with senior executives.

Preferred qualifications

  • HR leadership experience in a large, global company. Strategy consulting experience will also be considered.
  • Hands-on experience redesigning work and roles for AI and automation, at scale.
  • Experience building a people analytics or workforce intelligence function, including predictive models and scenario planning.
  • Experience with workforce economics and close partnership with Finance.
  • Master’s degree or MBA.

What will make you successful

  • You design for the future, not the past. You can picture how work should look and build the path to get there.
  • You are a builder. You are comfortable starting with a blank page and creating a team, methods and tools.
  • You make complex ideas simple, without hiding how much work it takes to put them in place.
  • You lead through influence. You get results through teams and leaders you do not manage.
  • You balance people and business needs. When trade-offs are needed, you keep business results first.

Work Schedule: Ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

The Field Operations Manager leads regional teams of Field Adjusters responsible for on-site damage appraisals, automotive mechanical inspections, repair authorization assessments, risk evaluations, and repair recommendations. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership and communication skills, experience in insurance, automotive dealership operations, and risk management, and the ability to build trusted dealer relationships, navigate escalations, and maintain high standards for accuracy and service quality.

The Work Itself

Field Operations & Claims Servicing

  • Lead multiple regional field teams responsible for timely, accurate Dealer Open Lot weather claim damage appraisals and F&I mechanical inspections and authorizations, ensuring consistent execution and responsiveness across geographies.
  • Maintain operational readiness for changing claim volumes, including weather-event surge capacity, territory coverage, workload balancing, and inspection resource deployment.

People Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop Field Supervisors while creating clear expectations for quality, service, accountability, technical proficiency, and team engagement.
  • Build the capabilities of field adjusters through coaching, calibration, training, knowledge sharing, and development opportunities strengthening the field organization.

Culture, Engagement & Organizational Leadership

  • Build an engaged, accountable field culture centered on dealer service, claim quality, sound judgment, and continuous improvement.
  • Represent Field Operations as a leadership voice, connecting strategy to frontline execution and ensuring supervisors and adjusters understand the why, expectations, and business outcomes behind organizational change.

Dealer & Customer Experience

  • Champion a culture of responsive, transparent, and consistent service for dealers and customers while balancing appropriate claim outcomes and policy requirements.
  • Serve as a management escalation point for complex or sensitive claims, bringing together the appropriate field, office, underwriting, and business partners to establish a clear path to resolution.

Quality, Controls & Financial Stewardship

  • Drive inspection and claim quality through file reviews, quality calibration, policy adherence, and consistent application of coverage and estimating standards.
  • Protect against claim leakage by using data, inspection findings, policy language, technical expertise, and appropriate controls to achieve fair, accurate, and defensible claim outcomes.

Supplier & Vendor Management

  • Oversee field inspection suppliers and vendor relationships, establishing clear expectations for service levels, inspection quality, cycle time, capacity, geographic coverage, and escalation management.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Partner closely with office claims teams, Underwriting, Loss Control, F&I, and other stakeholders to create a consistent and unified approach to dealer issues and claim resolution.
  • Use data, policy language, field observations, and stakeholder relationships to provide transparency into claim decisions, emerging dealer concerns, operational trends, and opportunities for improvement.

Strategy, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Translate Claims strategy into field execution by leading process improvements, technology adoption, workflow changes, and other initiatives that improve quality, efficiency, cycle time, and service.
  • Identify emerging trends and opportunities through field insight and operational data, to help the broader Claims organization.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Proficiency in reporting tools, data analysis, with ability to communicate well with Insurance Sr. Leadership.

jobs.description:
About Skylight

Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.

We’re at the forefront of a civic movement to reinvent how all levels of government serve families, patients, and many others in today’s digital world.

If you want to play a part in driving this critical movement forward, we’d love for you to join our growing team of public interest technologists.

The work we do matters.

About the job

At Skylight, software engineers design, implement, and maintain software systems to improve government services for users. This software is built to meet the needs of regular users of government services as well as Skylight’s partners in government.

A consulting software engineer focuses on advisory engagements where the deliverable is guidance, assessment, or technical strategy rather than delivering code.

Skylight has partnered with the U.S. Air Force across multiple legacy modernization efforts. The work spans modernization of legacy systems, new capability development in multi-vendor environments, iteration on established platforms, all inside an agile transformation and broader organizational change.

You’ll assess legacy systems, shape the technical strategy for modernizing them, and pair directly with government engineers to raise the bar on how software gets built. Expect to spend your time in architecture reviews, working sessions with vendors and Air Force teams, and hands-on demonstrations of modern, AI-assisted engineering practices.

What to know going in

Your first 30 days are about working with the Skylight team and government personnel, learning the client’s domain and organization, and enabling your government partners. Access to users varies from team to team, so you’ll need to get creative about how you reach them. The client is early- to mid-transformation, so expect organizational and operational change along the way.

This role is contingent on Skylight being awarded the underlying contract. If we’re not awarded the contract, we’ll let you know promptly and discuss whether there are other opportunities that fit.

What you’ll do

  • Assess legacy applications and their technical environments to identify technical debt, instability, and other opportunities for improvement, then design, document, and communicate solutions
  • Own the modernization strategy, technical direction, architectural decisions, and test strategy for the modernization, in collaboration with government engineers and partner vendors but accountable for the result
  • Advocate for and model lean-agile engineering practices such as API-first design, simple design, continuous integration, version control, and automated testing
  • Guide teams toward secure, compliant software that meets federal security standards and defends against common vulnerabilities
  • Pair with and coach government engineers so modern practices, including AI-assisted development, stick after you’ve moved on
  • Collaborate with product managers, researchers, and designers so technical recommendations serve user and mission needs

What we’re looking for

Basic qualifications

  • Ability to write clean, working, and reusable code
  • Understand the different pieces of software systems and how to fit them together, while keeping performance, reliability, and availability in mind
  • Familiar with how to build secure, compliant software and defend against common vulnerabilities
  • Experience evaluating existing systems and communicating technical findings and recommendations to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfort holding architectural decision rights on a multi-vendor engagement, and making the tradeoffs legible to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in agile software development
  • Interest in mentoring, coaching, and pairing with government partners so they can carry the work forward
  • Experience working on cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering, ops) in iterative delivery
  • A mindset and work approach that aligns with our core values

Nice-to-haves

  • Military or government experience
  • Experience leading legacy modernization efforts or reverse-engineering legacy applications where the code, the documentation, and stakeholder knowledge don't agree
  • Experience with web-based tech stacks (e.g., Java/React) and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience coaching other engineers on the failure modes of AI-assisted development
  • Experience delivering technology in government, regulated industries, or other public-benefit settings
  • A track record of staying aligned and accountable on remote teams

Don’t meet every qualification but think you can do the job? We’d still love to hear from you. If you’re excited about the role, apply. We consider candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences.

Other requirements

  • Some of our available roles are on federal contracts that require a degree or additional years of experience as a substitute.
  • All work must be conducted within the U.S., excluding U.S. territories.
  • This contract requires U.S. citizenship to be eligible for employment.
  • You must be able to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC), which requires a favorable background check.
  • You must complete a company background check successfully.

Logistics

Position type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Location

This is a fully remote position.

Travel

Expect occasional travel to Air Force bases across the U.S., quarterly at most.

Expected start date

November 2026

Care package

Salary

We want to give you the most competitive salary possible. After all, you deserve it! To that end, we use the results of our interview process to determine what salary is most appropriate given your current level of seniority. For a Software Engineer at Skylight, the current salary ranges are as follows:

  • Associate Software Engineer: $90,000–$125,000
  • Software Engineer I: $120,000–$140,000
  • Software Engineer II: $135,000–$160,000
  • Senior Software Engineer: $150,000–$185,000
  • Staff Software Engineer: $170,000–$203,000
  • Principal Software Engineer: $180,000–$230,000

Benefits

Your well-being is important to us, so we focus on supporting you in a variety of ways:

  • Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Dependent care FSA, healthcare FSA, health savings account
  • Dollar-for-dollar 401(k) match up to 10% of your salary with no vesting period
  • Flexible paid-time-off policy (generally around 25 days per year), plus 11 paid federal holidays
  • Up to 12 weeks paid-time-off for all eligible new birth, adoption, or foster parents
  • Performance rewards, including annual salary increase, annual performance bonus, spot bonuses, and stock options
  • Business development / sales bonuses
  • Referral bonuses
  • Annual $2000 allowance for professional development
  • Annual $750 allowance for tech-related purchases
  • Annual swag budget of $100 to display your Skylight pride with some merchandise (hoodies, hats, and more)
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • An environment that empowers you to unleash your superpowers for public good

Interview tips

Our process includes a preliminary screen, a skills interview, a behavioral interview, and a reverse interview where you meet your potential team — usually four conversations across two to three weeks. Here are some tips to help you prepare for a successful interview:

  • Visit our join page to learn more about how our interview process works.
  • Check out our Career Pathways framework to learn more about the different roles within Skylight and the skills needed to do them.
  • Browse our case studies to learn more about our work.

If you’d like to request reasonable accommodations during the application or interviewing process, please contact our recruiting team at .

Senior Demand Generation Manager

About the Role

Blackbaud unleashes the potential of the people and organizations who change the world. As the leading software provider exclusively dedicated to powering social impact, we help our customers move faster, work smarter, and achieve more.

As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you will own the strategy, execution, and optimization of integrated demand generation programs that create qualified pipeline and contribute to bookings across priority audiences and markets.

This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced demand generation marketer who can independently translate go-to-market priorities into sophisticated, multichannel buyer journeys. You will work closely with Sales and cross-functional Marketing partners, use performance data to identify opportunities and gaps, and continuously improve how Blackbaud creates, captures, and converts demand.

You will bring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, taking ownership of complex programs from initial audience and journey design through measurement, optimization, and scaled reuse.

What You’ll Do

  • Own integrated demand generation programs across email, digital, paid media, nurture, webinars, events, account-based marketing, and other channels, with clear accountability for pipeline and bookings outcomes.
  • Translate vertical strategy, audience priorities, approved messaging, and content strategy into connected buyer journeys across demand creation, capture, nurture, and conversion.
  • Develop sophisticated always-on and campaign-specific nurture strategies that address different buyer personas, stages, behaviors, and signals of intent.
  • Partner closely with Sales leaders and sellers to understand target accounts, territory priorities, market opportunities, opportunity quality, and conversion expectations.
  • Establish regular operating rhythms with Sales to evaluate engagement, pipeline development, opportunity quality, funnel progression, bookings contribution, and areas requiring intervention.
  • Use performance data and market signals to identify gaps and opportunities, recommend adjustments, and make informed decisions about audience, channel, program, and investment mix.
  • Design and execute structured experimentation across audience, messaging, offers, channels, sequences, personalization, and Sales follow-up, then scale approaches that measurably improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Field and Event Marketing to connect pre-event engagement, onsite experiences, and post-event follow-up into cohesive programs that accelerate buyer progression.
  • Work across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Industry Strategy, Field Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Sales to ensure programs operate as an integrated customer journey rather than disconnected activities.
  • Use approved product positioning, value propositions, claims, competitive insights, and launch materials from Product Marketing and adapt them appropriately for audiences and campaign execution.
  • Identify gaps in messaging, product proof, buyer insight, or campaign readiness and proactively partner with the appropriate teams to resolve them.
  • Leverage marketing automation, CRM data, intent and engagement signals, AI-enabled tools, and reporting to improve targeting, personalization, efficiency, and speed to market.
  • Develop reusable campaign frameworks, playbooks, testing approaches, reporting practices, and best practices that strengthen demand generation execution across the organization.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for demand generation, sharing insights and proven approaches with colleagues and helping elevate the quality of programs across the broader Marketing organization.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Qualified pipeline and bookings contribution.
  • Pipeline generated relative to program investment.
  • Conversion across priority buyer journeys, funnel stages, and target accounts.
  • Opportunity quality and progression in partnership with Sales.
  • Effectiveness of audience, channel, nurture, and account-based strategies.
  • Speed and quality of testing, learning, and optimization.
  • Successful scaling and reuse of high-performing demand generation programs and practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of B2B demand generation, growth marketing, integrated marketing, or related experience, with demonstrated ownership of programs tied to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success building and optimizing sophisticated multichannel demand generation programs across multiple stages of the buyer journey.
  • Strong experience partnering directly with Sales around target accounts, pipeline creation, opportunity quality, funnel conversion, and shared business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms, along with a strong understanding of lead and account lifecycle management, segmentation, nurture, and performance measurement.
  • Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to translate marketing, funnel, and pipeline data into actionable decisions.
  • Experience designing structured tests and using results to continuously improve audiences, offers, messaging, channels, sequencing, and conversion.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple complex programs and priorities while maintaining strong attention to execution and business outcomes.
  • Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, with the ability to bring Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Field Marketing, Marketing Operations, and other partners together around shared objectives.
  • Ability to translate broader go-to-market strategy and approved positioning into focused, relevant buyer experiences without losing strategic intent.
  • A track record of identifying opportunities for improvement and creating repeatable frameworks, processes, or programs that extend impact beyond an individual campaign.

jobs.excerpt: Overview Role Overview The Senior Employee Experience Partner (EEP) is the primary HR partner for managers and employees across a defined portfolio, owning the frontline employee experience end-to-end.
jobs.description:
Overview

Role Overview

The Senior Employee Experience Partner (EEP) is the primary HR partner for managers and employees across a defined portfolio, owning the frontline employee experience end-to-end. This role leads manager capability building and coaching, supports employees and managers through organizational change, owns employee relations and investigations from intake to resolution, and drives engagement action planning and follow-up. Operating within the Employee Experience function, the Senior EEP brings deep expertise in HR partnership, employee relations, and people-centered problem solving to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for every employee and manager they serve. This role is expected to exercise independent judgment, influence without authority, and take ownership of outcomes at a higher level of complexity and ambiguity than the EEP level.

Global Scope & Context

This role has broad global accountability, supporting employees, managers, and HR partners across multiple regions and time zones. The Senior EEP is expected to serve as a regional subject matter expert, adapting HR partnership and employee experience support across diverse cultural contexts, delivering consistency in how employees and managers are served regardless of location or time zone.

  • Lead or co-lead regional onboarding, compliance, or process rollouts in partnership with in-country HR and Legal teams based on location
  • Model cultural agility and guide team members in adapting support approaches across diverse global contexts

What you will do:

Employee & Manager Support

  • Serve as a senior point of contact for complex employee and manager inquiries requiring advanced judgment, policy interpretation, or cross-functional coordination
  • Advise managers on performance, conduct, attendance, and team dynamics issues with practical, policy-grounded guidance
  • Provide mentorship and real-time coaching to junior team members on case handling, communication, and escalation decisions
  • Act as an escalation point for sensitive or high-visibility requests proactively to mitigate risk
  • Communicate proactively with key stakeholders, building confidence in the Employee Experience function

Manager Capability Building & Coaching

  • Partner with managers to build people leadership capability through one-on-one coaching, real-time feedback, and targeted development conversations
  • Coach managers on performance conversations, conduct issues, team dynamics, and attendance management providing practical, policy-grounded guidance at the moment it is needed
  • Identify managers who need elevated support and proactively engage before issues escalate to formal ER or People Business Partner (PBP) intervention
  • Build manager confidence and consistency in applying company policies, values, and people practices through coaching, not just information sharing
  • Serve as the first HR call for any manager or employee seeking guidance, regardless of complexity or sensitivity, and ensure every manager leaves the conversation with clarity and a path forward

Employee Relations & Case Support

  • Independently manage moderately complex ER cases including performance management support, conduct investigations, interpersonal conflicts, and sensitive exits
  • Own all ER cases end-to-end from intake through investigation, resolution, and documentation EEP leadership or Legal only when the situation warrants it
  • Partner with benefits to support leave of absence administration ensuring communication to the manager and provide a supportive employee experience
  • Serve as a resource for junior team members on ER cases, providing guidance and reviewing approaches before action is taken
  • Recognize patterns in ER case volume or themes and proactively surface insights to EEP leadership and PBPs
  • Maintain rigorous, confidential case documentation and support preparation of materials for legal or leadership review when needed
  • Model and reinforce the highest standards of empathy, professionalism, and discretion in every employee interaction

Employee Experience During Change

  • Serve as the primary HR partner for employees and managers navigating organizational changes including restructures, leadership transitions, role eliminations, and team realignments
  • Provide proactive communication support, helping managers deliver change messages clearly, honestly, and with empathy for the employee experience
  • Identify employees at risk of disengagement during periods of uncertainty and intervene early with targeted support, resources, and connection to leadership
  • Partner with PBPs to ensure change plans account for the frontline employee experience, not just the organizational design or structural outcome
  • Support managers in maintaining team stability, morale, and performance continuity through transitions providing a consistent presence when leadership or structure is shifting
  • Recognize when change is creating systemic people risk disengagement, attrition signals, morale patterns and escalate insights to EEP leadership and PBPs

Engagement & Experience Leadership

  • Support employee engagement initiatives, ensuring programs are globally consistent, culturally relevant, and operationally sound
  • Partner with managers to translate engagement survey results into actionable team and site-level plans
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner on employee experience improvements, contributing ideas that go beyond execution to address root causes
  • Facilitate or co-facilitate manager training, listening sessions, review onboarding feedback to surface insights at scale
  • Mentor Partner I team members on engagement program delivery, helping them build ownership and confidence
  • Track program outcomes and report on impact, connecting engagement activities to broader organizational health metrics

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Support the onboarding and development of new team members, acting as a resource and role model for the Employee Experience function
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across the People Team and other key cross functional stakeholders (IT, Legal)
  • Represent Employee Experience in cross-functional project teams, workstreams, and strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to team retrospectives, playbook updates, RACI documents, and lessons-learned discussions to strengthen collective capability

What you bring:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • HR certification (e.g., PHR, SHRM-CP) preferred

Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in employee experience, employee relations, or HR partnership roles, with demonstrated focus on manager coaching, frontline employee support, and employee relations case management
  • Ability to synthesize observations, patterns, and data into a clear point of view and present it as a compelling recommendation not just a findings summary
  • Demonstrated experience supporting employees across in a global and matrixed environment
  • Track record of independently managing complex HR cases, ER investigations, and manager coaching
  • Ability to connect employee and manager dynamics to business context, team performance, and organizational outcomes
  • Consultative mindset skilled at asking the right questions to diagnose root cause, distinguish symptoms from systemic issues, and recommend solutions that address the underlying problem
  • Strong organizational awareness able to read dynamics, navigate complexity, and calibrate approach based on stakeholder, context, and risk
  • Experience supporting leave programs across multiple legislative frameworks (e.g., FMLA, statutory parental leave, country-specific entitlements)
  • Prior experience informally leading, mentoring, or coaching peers or junior team members

Skills & Competencies

  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills; confident advising leaders and adapting style across diverse global audiences
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning orientation actively seeks to understand organizational dynamics, people trends, and emerging HR practice beyond the scope of current assignments
  • Strong analytical capability able to work with HR data to identify trends, surface insights, and support decision-making
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational discipline, and ability to manage competing priorities without sacrificing quality
  • Mature judgment and discretion in handling sensitive, high-risk, or high-visibility situations
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and act ahead of issues
  • Ability to influence without authority across functions, geographies, and seniority levels
  • Comfortable operating independently in ambiguous situations with limited supervision

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Has taken ownership of a defined portfolio of employee and manager cases, managing complex ER, coaching, and change scenarios independently
  • Is recognized by key stakeholders as a credible, reliable escalation point and thought partner
  • Is actively supporting and adding value to the team and team quality and cohesion
  • Demonstrates clear command of regional compliance requirements for the supported geographies
  • Has established trusted relationships across PBPs, managers and employees in the supported portfolio, People Operations, and cross functional people functions.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

jobs.description:
#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

As a Threat Researcher, you will work at the intersection of cybersecurity research, threat hunting, and detection engineering. You will study real-world attacker behavior across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity telemetry, then turn those insights into practical detection logic, hunt content, tooling, and recommendations that improve customer protection.


This role partners closely with Security Services, Threat Intelligence, Product Management, and engineering teams. The goal is to rapidly understand emerging threats, identify where we can improve coverage, and deliver detections and guidance that are useful, reliable, and actionable at operational scale.


You should be comfortable moving through ambiguous investigations: forming hypotheses, hunting across large datasets, validating signals, writing detections in code or rule frameworks, documenting findings, and helping services teams respond to new and active threats.

What You’ll Do

  • Research emerging threats, adversary techniques, and attack trends relevant to Arctic Wolf customers.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & LLM Applications to support the development, integration, and deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) capabilities within the IRIS platform.

Location: Remote role;

  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.

In this role, you will:

  • Focus on building large language model (LLM) applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and intelligent analytics solutions supporting defense and intelligence missions.
  • Have hands-on experience with Python, generative AI frameworks, and cloud-based development environments, along with an interest in delivering secure, reliable AI solutions for mission-critical applications.
  • Be responsible for research in simulation of human intelligence processes by machines including learning, reasoning, and self-correction.
  • Design advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms to solve critical business challenges.

What you'll do:

  • Develop, test, and integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into the IRIS platform, including large language model (LLM) features, generative AI pipelines, and intelligent analytics modules aligned to customer requirements.
  • Contribute to sprint-based development cycles under IRIS Agile and Scrum practices, participating in daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint demos, and Big Room Planning sessions.
  • Implement and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, vector database integrations, and semantic search features supporting IRIS decision-support workflows for defense and intelligence customers.
  • Build and support evaluation frameworks and quality assurance pipelines to ensure reliable, accurate, and secure AI-generated outputs in mission-critical environments.
  • Assist with AI and ML model deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization in cloud environments including AWS GovCloud IL5 and FedRAMP-compliant infrastructure, including CI/CD pipeline integration.
  • Collaborate with IRIS Platform and Enablement and ServiceNow/EPMP engineering teams to ensure AI feature compatibility and seamless integration across IRIS modules.
  • Document model configurations, prompt engineering techniques, RAG architectures, and AI workflows; maintain technical documentation aligned to IRIS release standards.
  • Support Cyber and Intelligence Sector IRAD technical execution under the direction of senior engineers; contribute to prototype development, TRL advancement, and milestone reporting.
  • Apply responsible AI principles including bias detection, hallucination mitigation, and human-in-the-loop review workflows to production AI features serving government customers.
  • Provide technical support during customer demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and platform on-boarding activities as needed.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or a Master's degree with relevant project or research experience.
    • An additional 4 years of experience will be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, including experience developing or integrating LLM-based solutions (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent) in a professional or academic setting.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Python and experience with at least one AI/ML development framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques, vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, pgvector, or equivalent), or embedding models.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms — AWS or Microsoft Azure — and deploying or supporting AI/ML models in cloud environments.
  • Experience with version control (Git), Agile/Scrum development practices, and collaborative DevSecOps workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently within established guidelines and contribute to team objectives.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear technical documentation.
  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.

Preferred requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher; TS/SCI eligibility preferred.
  • Prior experience on the IRIS platform or other DoD analytics, decision-support, or intelligence community platforms (ODIN, Maven, C2IE, OMEGA, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience with prompt engineering techniques including few-shot learning, chain-of-thought prompting, or structured output generation.
  • Experience with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, or LLM tool-use capabilities.
  • Familiarity with model fine-tuning methods including LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF, or similar parameter-efficient techniques.
  • Experience with MLOps practices including model monitoring, A/B testing, or LLM evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with geospatial data formats (GeoJSON, KML) and visualization libraries (Plotly, D3.js) for operational analytics applications.
  • Exposure to information operations, cognitive warfare, influence analysis, or Combatant Command analytical environments.
  • Relevant certifications: AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Azure AI Engineer, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, or DeepLearning.AI.

Target Salary Range

NCRT enables VA facility supply chain personnel to request and coordinate critical medical supplies during emergencies. Both applications support essential supply chain operations across VA medical centers.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Summary


We are adding a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Analyst to our team. This is a remote position based in the US; sponsorship is not available for this role.


The primary responsibilities of this role include:

  • Directs the interpretation of protocols, budget documents, and Medicare coverage analysis into a structure within the clinical trial management system.
  • Ensures the structure provides the procedures that must be performed in the clinic and serves as the inventory of procedures to be priced in the budget and contracting function of the organization.
  • Works with the Research Protocol Educator and Budget Analyst to ensure the structure design is consistent with the protocol and budget requirements along with the procedures that will be performed in the clinic.
  • Responsible for structure set-up in the clinical trial management system involving corrections and updates.
  • Serves as the system expert to the clinical trial management system.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's Degree highly preferred; work experience may be substituted for education.
  • 3+ years' clinical research-related experience
  • 2 years' related work experience in protocol review, budget and/or MCA completion
  • A Research Certification such as ACRP or CCRP is highly preferred.


About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

jobs.excerpt: Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow.
jobs.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

  • Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Roon, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins

  • Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development

  • Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

About the Role

HARMAN's Software Experiences Business Unit (SEBU) builds software products that connect people to music. Our portfolio includes Roon, the leading music library management and playback platform for audiophiles, alongside new music products currently in development.

In this role you will help our product teams understand the people we build for. You will run competitive and user research across music discovery, streaming, and short-form content, sit inside the day-to-day work of a product team, and bring back the language, habits, and unmet needs of a younger audience in a form the team can act on.

This is a paid internship, and you will work as a member of the team rather than an observer. Length of the internship is dependent on when your new hire onboarding happens, but a typical program is 12-weeks. You will join standups and reviews, own your own research threads, and present what you learn directly to the people making product decisions.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Work as an embedded member of the team: join standups, design and product marketing discussions and product reviews, and contribute ideas as a working member of the group.

  • Track and analyze competitors and adjacent products to identify feature gaps, emerging trends, and unmet needs in the category.

  • Maintain a competitive tracker the team can use week-to-week, covering feature releases, notable launches, and shifts in how competitors position themselves.

  • Recruit and interview users in the 16 to 25 age range, with support from the product and marketing teams, to surface authentic language, listening habits, and unmet needs around music discovery and sharing.

  • Support structured usability and concept testing on new features and prototypes: help run sessions, capture qualitative and quantitative feedback, and turn it into concrete recommendations the team can act on within a development sprint.

  • Investigate how the target audience responds to curation and algorithmic recommendation, and feed what you find into feed and curation discussions.

  • Study visual and interaction trends across music, social, and related apps, and share what you find so our product and design teams stay current with what feels credible to a Gen Z audience.

  • Listen to public conversation about products in our category across Reddit, Discord, TikTok comments, and app store reviews, and flag the themes worth the team’s attention.

  • Support user feedback programs alongside the community and R&D teams: help draft survey questions, track incoming feedback and bug reports, and keep a running log of recurring themes.

  • Keep the research repository usable: tag and organize interview notes, clips, and findings so the team can still find them after the internship ends.

  • Summarize findings regularly into short internal documents the team can act on week to week, and deliver a final write-up and presentation pulling together the full 12 weeks of insight.

  • Own one self-directed project: define a question about the product with your manager, run the research, and present your recommendation to the team.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

  • Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program or higher at an accredited institution having completed your Sophomore year or later, taking at least one class in the semester/quarter before participation in the internship program, and returning to school for at least one semester upon completion of the internship program

  • Must have a cumulative 3.0 GPA

  • Preferred degree program in business, marketing, design, human-computer interaction, communications, music business, or a related field.

  • Genuine curiosity about consumer products and how people find, share, and talk about music.

  • Strong written communication: able to turn messy notes into a short, clear document that someone else can act on without a walkthrough.

  • Comfort talking to people you do not know, running an interview, and asking the follow-up question rather than accepting the first answer.

  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several research threads at once with light supervision in a remote environment.

  • Comfortable working with survey results and simple data sets, and willing to report what the findings actually show, including when they are inconvenient.

  • Hands-on familiarity, as a user, with the platforms where music culture happens, including TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, and the major streaming services.

  • Discretion with confidential product, partner, and roadmap information.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Prior internship, coursework, or project experience in user research, product management, marketing, or design.

  • Practical exposure to research methods such as interviews, surveys, or usability testing.

  • Experience building an audience or creating content on a social platform, or moderating an online community.

  • Working knowledge of tools such as Figma, Notion, and survey or analytics platforms.

  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of using them to work faster and better: synthesizing interview notes, drafting research summaries, and speeding up desk research.

  • A personal stake in music: musician, DJ, playlist curator, writer, or active participant in a scene.

Things To Know

  • This role allows for remote work and a candidate can be located anywhere in the United States.

  • This position allows for up to 20 hours per week, constituting a Part-Time Internship. Flexibility for more working hours is at the discretion and ability of the business unit.

  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment (post-offer).

What You Can Expect

  • Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)

  • Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs

  • Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Pay Transparency

Freshman: $19.00

Sophomore: $21.00

Junior: $23.00

Senior: $24.00

Master: $28.00

Dependent on the internship offered, pay is based on factors, including without limitation, the applicant's level of education and business need.

Benefits

HARMAN is interested in your health and wellbeing and offers benefits designed to support your wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your relationship with HARMAN, and may include paid sick leave and medical benefits.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

As an Industry Technical Consultant, you will provide practical technical leadership on customer projects, from early scoping through to system handover. You will define and plan pre-commissioning activities for open- and closed-loop cooling systems, including TCS loops, and provide consulting for on-site work such as flushing, cleaning, passivation, filling, and initial fluid conditioning. The role requires the ability to connect mechanical systems knowledge, water chemistry, materials compatibility, and heat transfer performance, while translating that expertise into clear recommendations for customers, field sales teams, account managers, and engineering stakeholders.

  • Pre-commissioning of closed loops, including mechanical completion checks, pressure testing, flushing and cleaning, passivation, filling, and fluid quality verification prior to handover

  • Hands-on industry experience with both open- and closed-loop cooling processes, including cooling towers, chilled water, and secondary or process cooling loops
  • TCS and direct-to-chip liquid cooling, including cold plates, cooling distribution units, secondary loops, fluid quality requirements, and interfaces with wider facility infrastructure

  • 50% or more overnight travel is required
  • Includes benefits package and company car

  • Demonstrable technical expertise in the pre-commissioning or commissioning of closed-loop systems, mechanical systems, process engineering, HVAC, industrial cooling, or data center infrastructure
  • Hands-on industry experience in both open- and closed-loop cooling processes
  • Ability to apply core mechanical and technical principles across piping systems, equipment, materials compatibility, fluid selection, heat transfer, and water chemistry
  • Ability to scope, plan, and supervise project work on site, coordinating with contractors and customers to deliver to schedule and specification

Proficient in professional written and spoken English

jobs.description:
The DIRECTV Digital Services Team is seeking a customer-first, innovative, and results-driven leader to transform how we serve our customers through agentic AI and intuitive self-service experiences. The Director, Product Management will lead a team responsible for product strategy, roadmaps, and delivery of subscription management capabilities across DIRECTV’s digital, AI-powered chat, and automated voice service and support channels - making it easier for customers to manage their service and enjoy the entertainment they love.

 

This leader will advance our vision of 100% self-service by delivering connected, personalized experiences that resolve customer needs across channels for all subscription management related needs. Everything from changing an entertainment subscription plan, adding or removing channel or package add-ons, to retention-related capabilities will be managed by the candidate who takes on this dynamic role. Partnering with leaders across Customer Care, Technology, Finance, Billing, and Marketing, the Director and their team will translate customer insights and business priorities into a coordinated product roadmap, guide execution, and measure outcomes that improve customer experience, increase self-service adoption, and drive operational efficiency.

 

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and performance of subscription management capabilities within DIRECTV’s AI-powered self-service experiences across web, virtual assistance, and automated voice channels.
  • Lead, develop, and recruit a high-performing team of product managers, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and opportunities for growth.
  • Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, and technology providers to deliver and scale AI agents that support thousands of customer conversations each day.
  • Guide the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of AI-powered customer journeys, using prompting, conversational design, and platform capabilities to deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for generative and agentic AI to resolve customer needs, complete service tasks, and provide seamless transitions to live support with relevant customer context.
  • Establish performance goals and use customer feedback, digital analytics, and conversation insights to improve self-service adoption, containment, resolution, customer satisfaction, and cost to serve.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, competitive insights, and operational performance into product strategies and prioritized investment opportunities.
  • Develop business cases, secure funding, and track results against expected customer and financial benefits.
  • Manage product roadmaps, balancing customer value, business impact, delivery capacity, dependencies, and operational risk.
  • Guide the development of clear epics, capabilities, and acceptance criteria that align delivery teams on expected outcomes.
  • Partner with Customer Experience, User Experience, Customer Care, and internal and external technology teams to deliver intuitive, accessible, and connected customer experiences.
  • Establish expectations for AI quality, accuracy, reliability, and responsible use, partnering with Technology, Security, Legal, and operational teams on evaluation, monitoring, and appropriate safeguards.
  • Use analytics and customer insights to identify experience gaps and production issues, quantify their impact, and prioritize resolution.
  • Move effectively between strategy and execution, removing obstacles and providing hands-on support when needed to advance delivery and cross-functional alignment.

 

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • 5 – 7 years required, 7+ years desired of digital product management experience across web, conversational AI, automated voice, mobile applications, or other digital service channels.
  • 2+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing product teams.
  • 2+ years of experience delivering customer-facing generative AI solutions, including practical experience with prompting, conversational design, and AI performance evaluation.
  • Experience and working knowledge of subscription plan management and related capabilities utilized across entertainment and/or telco related industries.
  • Understanding of how AI agents use knowledge sources, customer context, and system integrations to resolve inquiries and complete tasks.
  • Experience identifying and addressing AI quality issues, including inaccurate responses, hallucinations, unsuccessful task completion, and ineffective handoffs.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy, customer insights, and performance data into prioritized product initiatives with measurable results.
  • Experience developing business cases using financial analysis, competitive insights, and forecasts to support investment decisions.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence cross-functional partners and present recommendations to executives.
  • A solid technical foundation and the ability to work effectively with engineering and architecture teams on software, web technologies, APIs, and system integrations.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and complex initiatives in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements.
  • Experience with agile product delivery and roadmap management tools such as Jira or Jira Align.
  • Experience using digital analytics and business intelligence tools such as Google Analytics, Power BI, or Quantum Metric to assess performance and identify opportunities.
  • Working knowledge of voice-of-the-customer platforms such as Qualtrics or Medallia.

 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience owning the full product lifecycle, from discovery and business case development through launch, optimization, and retirement.
  • Experience with enterprise conversational AI platforms and customer service or contact center technologies.
  • Deep understanding of subscription management frameworks, cancelation flows, retention tactics, and offers management capabilities utilized to upsell or save customers across their lifecycle.

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Security команди шукаємо Middle IAM Engineer.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • видача й відкликання доступів за заявками в Jira Service Management з перевіркою апрувів;

  • ведення онбордингу й офбордингу: стандартні доступи новачкам, повне відкликання при звільненні;

  • прийняття сервісів «на баланс»: аудит сервісу, ревʼю токенів і ключів, ресет пароля і 2FA, перенесення облікових даних у 1Password;

  • підтримка реєстру сервісів, ролей і доступів у Jira Assets;

  • проведення регулярного перегляду доступів з керівниками й прибирання зайвого;

  • адміністрування груп Google Workspace і доступів через SSO;

  • підготовка щомісячної статистики видачі доступів; підміна колеги в команді.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • 2+ роки досвіду в адмініструванні доступів, IT-адмініструванні або Service Desk L2 з фокусом на облікові записи;

  • практичне адміністрування Google Workspace: користувачі, групи, OU, SSO-застосунки;

  • розуміння SSO (SAML/OIDC), MFA, принципу найменших привілеїв і рольової моделі (RBAC);

  • досвід процесів прийому, переведення і звільнення співробітників (joiner/mover/leaver) та перегляду доступів;

  • робота із системою заявок з апрувами (Jira Service Management або аналог);

  • адміністрування менеджера паролів (1Password, Bitwarden тощо);

  • базові скрипти або робота з API (Python, Bash, Apps Script) для вивантажень і звірок;

  • акуратність, документування дій, готовність відмовити без апруву.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід з Jira Assets (CMDB);

  • досвід Cloudflare Zero Trust (Access, WARP);

  • AWS IAM / IAM Identity Center, Kubernetes RBAC;

  • IdP: Okta, Entra ID, Keycloak або Casdoor; SCIM-провіжининг;

  • HiBob або інша HR-система як джерело даних про співробітників;

  • аудит PCI DSS / ISO 27001 у частині доступів;

  • домени й DNS (реєстратори, Cloudflare).

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉
