jobs.title: Head of Growth
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT AGELESSRX Our mission is radical life extension.
jobs.description:
ABOUT AGELESSRX
Our mission is radical life extension. We’re here to beat death.

At AgelessRx, we’re building the infrastructure to accelerate breakthroughs in longevity and fundamentally change how people approach their health. At the center is a profitable, high-eight-figure telehealth business serving tens of thousands of paying members who want to improve their energy, sleep, strength, hormonal health, and overall quality of life.

We’re building something much bigger than a telehealth company. By helping people achieve their health goals, we’re also creating something researchers rarely have access to: real-world data from people using real interventions, tracked over time, with opportunities to participate in future clinical research.

We’ve intentionally built capabilities that many companies outsource, including our own decentralized clinical trial platform, an in-house clinical network, and an AI-native technology stack. Our research includes PEARL, a clinical trial studying rapamycin, and we’ve been recognized as an XPRIZE Healthspan finalist.

We think big. Growing from eight to nine figures in revenue is an important milestone, but it’s not the end goal. We believe healthcare will look fundamentally different in five years, and we intend to help drive that transformation.

We keep our team small by design. We look for people who take ownership, move quickly, embrace AI, pay attention to the details, and aren’t afraid to tackle difficult problems. You’ll have the autonomy, tools, and opportunity to make a meaningful impact without layers of bureaucracy. We’re building a team of people who want to do the work, not just oversee it.

OVERVIEW

We're looking for a hands-on Head of Growth to lead and scale our growth engine across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You'll own growth performance, bringing together paid media, lifecycle marketing, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and analytics to drive sustainable revenue growth and improve customer acquisition economics.

This is a role for someone who knows how to build strategy but is equally comfortable getting into the details. You'll set priorities, challenge assumptions, evaluate performance, and work directly with channel owners and agency partners to turn insights into action. When something isn't working, you'll know how to diagnose the problem and drive a solution.

We're not looking for someone who simply manages a team or oversees an agency. We want a growth leader who has personally built, tested, and optimized acquisition channels, understands the economics behind scaling a DTC business, and can create the systems and accountability needed to deliver results.

You'll work closely with our growth PM, lifecycle team, analyst, and agency partners across Google, Meta, and affiliates, leveraging our AI-native platform to rapidly build, test, and optimize customer experiences.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Revenue Growth: Drive growth across new customer acquisition, retention, and revenue per customer, targeting 3%+ month-over-month growth in monthly cash collected.
  • Growth Economics: Own CAC, LTV, payback periods, and marginal ROI, ensuring investments are allocated toward the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Customer Funnel Performance: Optimize the end-to-end customer journey, including offers, pricing, landing pages, checkout, post-purchase cross-sell, and retention.
  • Channel Strategy & Investment: Set channel-level performance targets, manage growth budget allocation, and identify opportunities to test and scale new acquisition channels.
  • Experimentation: Build and lead a high-velocity testing program across channels, customer segments, offers, messaging, and conversion funnels.
  • New Product Growth: Develop and execute GTM business cases for new products, audiences and channels, including opportunity sizing, financial scenarios, positioning, channel strategy, resourcing, launch execution and performance evaluation.
  • Growth Operations: Establish the systems, reporting, and operating rhythms that keep growth teams and partners aligned, accountable, and focused on measurable outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Growth Strategy & Performance

  • Develop and execute a growth strategy that connects acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue expansion.
  • Establish growth priorities, performance targets, budget guardrails, and clear expectations for CAC, LTV, payback, and ROI.
  • Evaluate channel performance and make informed decisions about where to invest, optimize, scale, or pull back.
  • Identify and test new growth opportunities across channels, partnerships, customer segments, and products.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting, growth models, budget allocation, and investment decisions.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications for leadership.

Hands-On Channel & Funnel Optimization

  • Work directly with channel owners, growth PMs, and agency partners to establish weekly priorities and drive execution.
  • Regularly audit paid media accounts and growth channels, including account structure, bidding strategies, attribution, reporting, and optimization practices.
  • Investigate performance changes, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities to improve channel efficiency and conversion.
  • Bring forward and execute new growth initiatives rather than relying solely on ideas generated by agencies or team members.
  • Optimize the customer journey from acquisition through eligibility, checkout, onboarding, renewal, winback and cross-sell, measuring how funnel improvements affect conversion, retention and customer economics.
  • Ensure consistent positioning, messaging, and value propositions throughout the customer journey.

Experimentation, Analytics & Growth Economics

  • Own the growth experimentation roadmap, prioritizing tests based on potential revenue impact and business value.
  • Partner with the growth PM and cross-functional teams to execute experiments across offers, pricing, messaging, customer segments, and conversion funnels.
  • Establish clear hypotheses, success metrics, measurement approaches, and decision criteria for major experiments.
  • Reconcile platform attribution, first-party conversion data, MMM/MTA and incrementality tests to establish reliable performance measures and guide channel investment, experimentation and scaling decisions.
  • Use performance insights to continuously improve acquisition efficiency, conversion, retention, and customer lifetime value.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Lead growth as an integrated function, aligning paid media, lifecycle, CRO, analytics, and agency partners around shared goals.
  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm through weekly priorities, performance reviews, experimentation updates, and clear accountability.
  • Hold internal teams, agencies, and vendors accountable for execution, performance, and results.
  • Identify and remove blockers, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and improve how growth initiatives move from idea to execution.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, Content, Clinical, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to support growth initiatives.
  • Coach and develop team members, strengthen team performance, and help build the growth organization as business needs evolve.
  • Foster a high-ownership, analytical, AI-native culture focused on continuous improvement and measurable outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated success driving revenue growth and scaling customer acquisition in a high-growth, consumer-focused business.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with paid acquisition, particularly Google and Meta, including the ability to audit accounts, diagnose performance issues, and guide optimization decisions.
  • Strong understanding of growth economics, including CAC, LTV, payback periods, marginal ROI, and budget allocation.
  • Experience leading experimentation across acquisition, conversion funnels, pricing, offers, and customer lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, performance measurement, forecasting, and conversion optimization.
  • Ability to independently investigate performance data, identify root causes, and translate insights into actionable decisions.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, agencies, and external partners to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities, lean teams, and limited bureaucracy.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, experimentation, and execution.
  • A high degree of ownership, sound judgment, and willingness to stay close to the work.

jobs.title: Director, Field Enablement & Capabilities
jobs.excerpt: The Role Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine.
jobs.description:
The Role

Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.

Moderna’s U.S. Infectious Disease business is entering an exciting new phase of growth, with an expanding portfolio and an opportunity to transform how our field teams engage customers. As we evolve from product-focused selling to strategic, portfolio-based customer engagement, you will shape the capabilities, tools, and learning experiences that enable our U.S. Account Management organization to succeed in an increasingly complex and competitive healthcare environment.

In this highly hands-on individual contributor role, you will own the strategy and execution of U.S. field enablement, translating commercial priorities into impactful training, product readiness, coaching, communications, and measurable capability development. Reporting to the Vice President of US Marketing, Infectious Disease, with a dotted-line relationship to the Head of Enterprise Talent and Capability, you will work closely with Account Management leadership, cross-functional partners, training operations, and external vendors to build a scalable, future-ready field organization.

Here's What You'll Do

Shape the future of field enablement and commercial capability development

  • Own and execute an integrated, scalable U.S. field enablement strategy and capability development roadmap, aligning learning priorities with commercial strategy, portfolio evolution, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and upcoming product launches.
  • Translate business priorities into practical learning experiences, field tools, coaching approaches, and coordinated communications that enable consistent, high-quality execution across the Account Management organization.
  • Strengthen field capabilities across strategic account planning, portfolio-based selling, customer engagement, competitive selling, and healthcare ecosystem navigation, supporting the transition from product-focused interactions to broader, customer-centric portfolio discussions.
  • Partner with Account Management leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to integrate capability development into broader commercial priorities, ensuring the field understands evolving expectations, available resources, and ways of working.
  • Leverage field feedback, leadership insights, capability assessments, learner data, and commercial performance indicators to identify development gaps, measure effectiveness, and continuously refine enablement investments.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Talent and Capability to leverage existing learning programs, platforms, and resources, creating a consistent, coordinated learner experience across Moderna.

Drive product knowledge, launch readiness, and field certification

  • Lead the product knowledge training strategy and establish readiness standards for both new hires and experienced Account Managers, ensuring alignment with the broader field enablement roadmap.
  • Define audience- and role-specific learning requirements across onboarding, product launches, label changes, product updates, annual refreshers, and field certification or readiness assessments, as appropriate.
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, and Compliance to ensure product training is scientifically accurate, current, compliant, aligned with approved content, and responsive to evolving commercial priorities.
  • Build structured learning pathways that equip Account Managers with the product knowledge, competitive understanding, and portfolio expertise required to engage customers confidently and effectively.

Own learning design, content strategy, and capability deployment

  • Serve as the primary U.S. owner of field enablement curriculum, content, and readiness, defining learning objectives, designing curricula, developing or overseeing training materials, and managing external learning vendors as needed.
  • Own and continuously optimize the overall learning portfolio, ensuring training programs, curricula, individual modules, and standalone learning resources are structured, accessible, and aligned with specific business needs and target audiences.
  • Establish clear relationships between learning programs, curriculum pathways, and training requirements, providing stakeholders with direction on where new or updated content belongs and how existing learning opportunities can be leveraged.
  • Act as the central point of contact for cross-functional learning requests, gathering content updates, maintaining visibility into ongoing initiatives, and ensuring learning investments are coordinated rather than duplicated.
  • Partner with training operations to ensure effective execution of LMS administration, learning assignments and tracking, scheduling, curriculum maintenance, certification records, and related operational activities, while retaining strategic ownership of learning design and field readiness.
  • Apply adult learning theory, behavioral science, and skills-based development principles to create engaging blended learning experiences, incorporating digital learning platforms, interactive practice, and practical reinforcement approaches.
  • Explore opportunities to leverage Generative AI and emerging digital learning technologies to enhance content development, personalize learning experiences, accelerate knowledge access, and strengthen field capability development, within Moderna's approved technology and compliance frameworks.
  • Collaborate with Account Management leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver impactful training, skills-practice workshops, and capability-building sessions at national sales meetings and other major commercial meetings.

Elevate commercial selling effectiveness and leadership coaching

  • Develop practical, skills-based programs that strengthen consultative selling, strategic account planning, effective questioning, objection handling, negotiation, competitive differentiation, and messaging effectiveness during customer engagements.
  • Build capabilities that enable Account Managers to navigate increasingly complex healthcare ecosystems, understand customer priorities, and communicate the value of Moderna's expanding infectious disease portfolio.
  • Equip Account Management leaders with actionable coaching tools, structured reinforcement approaches, and field performance insights to embed new skills, sustain learning adoption, and drive measurable behavior change.
  • Partner with field leadership to connect training investments to day-to-day execution, reinforcing consistent customer engagement practices and continuous commercial capability improvement.

Enable digital tools, analytics, and data-driven field execution

  • Collaborate with Commercial Operations, Analytics, and relevant business partners to strengthen field proficiency in CRM systems, customer targeting and profiling, data literacy, and other commercial execution resources.
  • Enable Account Managers to translate customer insights, account data, and available commercial intelligence into more effective account planning, prioritization, and customer engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate digital innovation, including appropriate Generative AI-enabled tools, into learning experiences and field workflows to improve knowledge accessibility, productivity, and execution effectiveness.

Champion compliant, high-quality field enablement

  • Ensure all learning content, field resources, communications, and enablement activities adhere to Moderna policies and applicable healthcare laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.
  • Maintain strong partnerships with Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to support appropriate content review, approval, and deployment.
  • Balance strategic ownership with hands-on execution, leveraging training operations and external vendors for administration, deployment, and delivery while maintaining accountability for the quality, consistency, and business impact of U.S. field enablement.

The key Moderna Mindsets you’ll need to succeed in the role:

  • “We act with dynamic range, driving strategy and execution at the same time at every step.” You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on ownership, translating an evolving U.S. commercial strategy into practical field capabilities, relevant learning experiences, and measurable improvements in execution.
  • “We obsess over learning. We don’t have to be the smartest we have to learn the fastest.” You will foster a culture of continuous learning, using field insights, learner feedback, emerging technologies, and performance data to rapidly evolve capabilities and help our Account Management organization stay ahead of changing customer expectations and competitive dynamics.

Here's What You'll Need (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sales enablement, commercial training, sales leadership, strategic account management, commercial excellence, or a related commercial function within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines or healthcare
  • Demonstrated experience translating business strategy into field training, capability development, and practical execution tools.
  • Experience developing commercial and/or product training for field-based teams.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and project management skills, with the ability to drive work independently in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience managing external vendors or training partners.

Here's What You'll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience in vaccines, infectious disease
  • Strong understanding of strategic account management and consultative selling, including stakeholder mapping, account planning, competitive selling, negotiation, and customer influence.
  • Experience designing product and commercial training curricula, onboarding programs, readiness standards, and continuous learning approaches.
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning and behavior-change principles.
  • Experience supporting major launches, new-category entry, or significant commercial transformation.
  • Ability to translate complex scientific, commercial, and customer information into clear, practical field learning.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively as a hands-on individual contributor, prioritize across multiple competing needs, and deliver with limited dedicated resources.
  • Willingness to travel nationally based on field and business needs.

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $167,000.00 - $300,700.00(for positions that may be performed in California, the expected salary range is $234,825.00 - $270,175.00, which reflects the range permitted under California Labor Code requirements) . This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs.The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.


We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.


If you want to make a difference and join a team that is changing the future of medicine, we invite you to visit modernatx.com/careers to learn more about our current opportunities.


Equal Opportunities

Moderna is a place where everyone can grow. If you meet the Basic Qualifications for the role and you would be excited to contribute to our mission every day, please apply!

jobs.title: Sr. Database Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences.
jobs.description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.


Job Summary


As a Sr. Database Administrator at Candescent, you will serve as a senior technical authority for mission-critical database services that power customer-facing digital banking platforms. Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL is our primary and most strategically important database platform, and this role also provides advanced operational support across a smaller portfolio of Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, AlloyDB for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Informix technologies. You will own complex reliability, availability, security, recoverability, performance, and operational-readiness outcomes across production and staging environments.

This is an individual-contributor role with no direct managerial responsibilities. You will provide technical leadership during high-risk work and major incidents, establish operational standards, mentor less-experienced DBAs, and partner with Database Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, application teams, cloud infrastructure, security, and the Reliability Operations Center to ensure database technologies are production-ready and sustainably supported.


Key Responsibilities


  • Act as a senior technical authority for production and staging database platforms, with primary emphasis on PostgreSQL hosted on Google Cloud SQL and advanced support for Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, AlloyDB for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Informix environments.
  • Own technical direction for complex database operations, including architecture-informed configuration, reliability improvements, performance stabilization, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and operational risk reduction.
  • Establish and continuously improve standards for monitoring database health, availability, storage, connections, replication, query performance, errors, logs, jobs, and capacity trends; identify systemic risks before they affect customers.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and lead the database technical response during major incidents, readiness bridges, maintenance windows, and customer-impacting events; provide impact assessments, mitigation strategies, recovery guidance, executive-ready technical updates, and follow-through on corrective actions.
  • Lead rapid determination and validation of financial institution, customer, tenant, and service impact during production incidents, degradation, failover, and recovery activities.
  • Drive advanced troubleshooting, service restoration, and operational root-cause analysis across database, operating-system, application, network, and cloud-service boundaries; distinguish contributing factors from root causes and ensure corrective and preventive actions are technically sound.
  • Design, validate, and routinely test backup, point-in-time recovery where supported, restore, high-availability, replication, failover, and disaster-recovery capabilities; define recovery evidence and acceptance criteria for managed cloud and self-managed platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership for disaster recovery testing, production failover exercises, recoverability validation, and operational-readiness reviews; identify gaps and drive remediation to closure.
  • Plan, peer-review, and execute high-risk database maintenance, version upgrades, platform maintenance, configuration or parameter changes, and controlled production changes; ensure implementation, validation, rollback, and communication plans are complete.
  • Define and enforce database access standards covering users, roles, permissions, authentication, privileged access, service accounts, separation of duties, and periodic access reviews in accordance with least-privilege requirements.
  • Lead database security and compliance activities, including vulnerability remediation, audit evidence, encryption, logging, control validation, exception remediation, and technical consultation with Security and Risk teams.
  • Perform advanced workload analysis using query plans, statistics, indexes, locks, waits, connection utilization, maintenance behavior, database jobs, operating-system signals, and cloud metrics; implement or guide durable performance improvements.
  • Develop capacity models and recommend right-sizing for compute, storage, IOPS, memory, connections, replicas, clustering or high-availability configurations, and retention settings; connect recommendations to growth forecasts, resilience objectives, and cost considerations.
  • Own and improve runbooks, monitoring standards, recovery procedures, operational dashboards, escalation paths, configuration baselines, and support documentation; ensure documentation is accurate, tested, and usable under incident conditions.
  • Serve as a senior reviewer for production readiness of new and modified database services, platforms, migrations, and architectural changes, including monitoring, recoverability, documentation, ownership, escalation paths, disaster recovery, security, capacity, and incident-response readiness.
  • Design and implement automation for repeatable or high-risk DBA activities using SQL, shell scripting, Python, gcloud, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, or comparable tooling; promote testing, peer review, version control, and measurable reduction of manual effort.
  • Mentor junior-level DBAs through technical coaching, pairing, design and change reviews, incident debriefs, documentation feedback, and knowledge-sharing sessions; delegate technical work appropriately without assuming formal people-management responsibilities.
  • Raise the capability of the DBA function by identifying skill gaps, creating reusable guidance, leading technical learning sessions, and modeling sound judgment, ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Collaborate with Database Engineers and application teams while maintaining clear ownership boundaries between production database operations and database engineering or schema-development work; influence designs toward supportable, resilient production outcomes.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on database administration experience supporting business-critical production systems, including at least 3 years operating in a senior, lead, or technical-authority capacity for complex environments.
  • Expert-level PostgreSQL administration skills, including backup and recovery, high availability, replication, performance diagnostics, security, maintenance, upgrades, capacity management, incident response, and production troubleshooting; PostgreSQL remains the primary technical requirement for this role.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL in Google Cloud SQL, including instance architecture and configuration, private connectivity, IAM integration, observability, maintenance, backups, replicas, failover, recovery, availability constraints, and platform limits.
  • Advanced experience with Google Cloud observability capabilities such as Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, alerting, dashboards, and database insights, including the ability to define actionable signals, thresholds, service indicators, and escalation paths.
  • Proven ability to diagnose ambiguous, multi-layer production issues using database logs, system catalogs or dynamic management views, query plans, database statistics, job histories, operating-system signals, application behavior, and cloud platform metrics.
  • Demonstrated success leading the technical response to high-severity incidents, communicating risk and recovery options clearly, and translating findings into durable corrective actions.
  • Experience leading complex database changes through formal change management, technical peer review, deployment validation, rollback planning, risk assessment, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Linux and automation or scripting using SQL, Bash, Python, PowerShell, gcloud, or similar tools, with experience creating maintainable, version-controlled operational automation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to guide technical discussions, explain complex risks to non-specialists, and provide concise updates during high-severity production incidents.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor other technical professionals, provide constructive review feedback, influence without formal authority, and raise team standards through documentation and knowledge sharing.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound risk-based decisions, prioritize across competing operational needs, and collaborate effectively across engineering, infrastructure, security, support, and leadership teams.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience operating PostgreSQL at significant scale for high-volume SaaS, digital banking, payments, or other regulated workloads with stringent availability and recovery objectives.
  • Deep experience with PostgreSQL connection pooling, read replicas, logical and streaming replication, vacuum and maintenance behavior, major-version upgrades, cross-region recovery patterns, and performance engineering.
  • Experience designing and governing infrastructure-as-code and database automation using Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, or equivalent tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of two or more additional database technologies, preferably Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, AlloyDB for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Informix.
  • Experience with ITIL practices, incident command, problem management, service-level objectives, error budgets, resilience engineering, and regulated audit or compliance processes.
  • Experience supporting production environments subject to financial services and banking controls, including PCI DSS, SOC, FFIEC, or comparable regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Experience providing technical leadership for database migrations, cloud modernization, platform consolidation, disaster recovery, or major lifecycle initiatives.
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Database Engineer, PostgreSQL certification, or comparable advanced database certification is a plus.

Success in This Role


  • Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL and other supported database services consistently meet defined reliability, recovery, security, performance, and operational-readiness expectations.
  • Complex database risks are identified early, communicated clearly, and reduced through durable engineering, monitoring, maintenance, capacity planning, standards, and automation.
  • New and modified database services enter production only after material supportability, security, observability, recoverability, ownership, escalation, and incident-response risks are resolved or explicitly accepted.
  • Backup, restore, failover, and disaster-recovery capabilities are documented, tested against clear acceptance criteria, and repeatable by the broader DBA team.
  • Database migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives transition into production with clear support ownership, validated rollback and recovery options, complete runbooks, and stable post-cutover operations.
  • High-severity incidents are led with decisiveness and technical depth; customer impact is validated promptly, recovery options are evaluated accurately, and preventive improvements are implemented and tracked.
  • Junior and mid-level DBAs demonstrate measurable growth in troubleshooting, risk assessment, change quality, documentation, incident response, and independent ownership.
  • Operational processes become more standardized, automated, measurable, scalable, and resilient as the PostgreSQL estate grows and the broader database portfolio evolves.
  • Technical decisions, operational standards, and cross-functional partnerships reflect sound judgment and readiness for broader leadership responsibility without requiring formal managerial authority

jobs.excerpt: The Vice President, Corporate Controller leads CONMED’s global accounting, controllership, external reporting, financial controls, and accounting operations activities.
jobs.description:
The Vice President, Corporate Controller leads CONMED’s global accounting, controllership, external reporting, financial controls, and accounting operations activities. This role provides enterprise leadership across accounting policy, financial reporting, month-end and quarter-end close, SEC reporting support, SOX compliance, internal controls, governance, technical accounting, and global accounting operations. Serving as a key advisor to the CFO, Executive Leadership Team, Audit Committee, and business leaders, the role partners closely with Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Internal Audit, external auditors, and global business teams to ensure accurate financial reporting, strong controls, scalable accounting processes, and alignment with CONMED’s enterprise objectives.


Key Duties and Responsibilities

Enterprise Accounting, Reporting & Controllership

  • Lead CONMED’s global accounting and controllership function, including financial reporting, accounting operations, consolidation, close processes, and accounting governance.
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial results.
  • Establish and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and reporting disciplines that support business objectives, regulatory requirements, and enterprise growth.
  • Provide leadership on accounting matters related to business performance, acquisitions, restructurings, investments, operational initiatives, and enterprise transformation efforts.
  • Partner with executive leadership to evaluate financial implications of strategic decisions and ensure accounting considerations are appropriately understood and managed.

SEC Reporting, Technical Accounting & External Audit

  • Provide executive leadership for external reporting activities, including public company reporting, financial statement preparation, disclosure support, and related governance processes.
  • Oversee technical accounting matters, including interpretation and application of accounting standards, complex transactions, and accounting policy decisions.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Tax, Treasury, external auditors, and other stakeholders to support disclosure controls, audit requirements, and regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Lead the relationship with external auditors, including audit planning, issue resolution, management representation, and coordination across global finance teams.
  • Ensure accounting judgments, estimates, disclosures, and reporting matters are supported by sound technical analysis and appropriate documentation.

Internal Controls, SOX Compliance & Governance

  • Lead CONMED’s global internal controls and SOX compliance framework in partnership with Internal Audit, Legal, Finance, and business leaders.
  • Establish and maintain effective financial controls, accounting processes, and governance practices that support compliance, accuracy, and operational discipline.
  • Monitor control performance, identify risks and gaps, and drive corrective actions to strengthen CONMED’s control environment.
  • Support Audit Committee materials, controls updates, financial reporting matters, and other governance-related communications.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, compliance, and continuous improvement across accounting and finance processes.

Global Accounting Operations & Process Improvement

  • Oversee global accounting operations, including general ledger, consolidation, intercompany accounting, fixed assets, leases, revenue accounting, cost accounting, and related accounting processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting systems, close processes, reporting tools, reconciliations, controls, and analytical capabilities.
  • Partner with global Finance, IT, Tax, Treasury, Legal, and business teams to improve process efficiency, data quality, reporting accuracy, and scalability.
  • Support enterprise initiatives, acquisitions, system implementations, and organizational transformation efforts through strong accounting leadership and cross-functional partnership.
  • Ensure global accounting teams operate with clear ownership, disciplined execution, and consistent standards across regions and functions.

Executive & Board Decision Support

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CFO, Executive Leadership Team, Audit Committee, and business leaders on accounting, reporting, controls, technical accounting, and governance matters.
  • Develop executive-level reporting, audit updates, accounting analyses, controls updates, business reviews, and Board or Audit Committee materials.
  • Translate complex accounting, reporting, regulatory, and controls matters into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Maintain continuous communication with the CFO and senior leadership on critical accounting, reporting, control, audit, and compliance matters.

Leadership & Organization Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing global accounting and controllership organization.
  • Build organizational capability through succession planning, leadership development, talent management, and clear ownership of enterprise-level versus operational accounting activities.
  • Foster accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, controls discipline, continuous improvement, and a commitment to quality.
  • Ensure accounting team members receive appropriate coaching, development, training, and performance feedback.
  • Establish and monitor team performance goals, development objectives, and accountabilities aligned to enterprise priorities.

Job Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Experience operating within a publicly traded company environment
  • CPA required
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, financial reporting, technical accounting, external audit, or related financial disciplines.
  • 8+ years of people leadership experience, including management of managers, senior managers, and/or directors.
  • 5+ years of executive or senior finance leadership experience with responsibility for accounting operations, external reporting, technical accounting, internal controls, or SOX compliance.

Recommended Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
  • Experience in public accounting, including Big 4 or large national accounting firm external audit experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading global accounting operations, financial close, consolidation, external reporting, audit support, technical accounting, and SOX compliance processes.
  • Experience partnering with executive leadership, auditors, legal counsel, and finance leaders to provide guidance on accounting, reporting, controls, and governance matters.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, drive enterprise alignment, and lead through organizational complexity and change.
  • Demonstrated capability to build, lead, and develop high-performing accounting and finance organizations through multiple levels of management.
  • Experience serving as Corporate Controller, Assistant Controller, Divisional Controller, or equivalent senior accounting executive.
  • Experience supporting SEC filings, earnings processes, Audit Committee presentations, and public company governance requirements.
  • Experience leading technical accounting assessments involving acquisitions, divestitures, restructuring activities, revenue recognition, lease accounting, and other complex transactions.
  • Experience managing global accounting operations, consolidations, shared services, accounting policy, and internal controls.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, ERP implementations, finance transformations, or global business expansion.
  • Experience operating in a multinational environment with global accounting and reporting responsibilities.

jobs.title: Sr Principal Specialist Regulatory Affairs
jobs.excerpt: Position Overview: The Senior Regulatory Manager /Senior Principal Regulatory Specialist is a highly experienced individual contributor responsible for developing and executing regulatory strategies for innovative and complex medical device and combination product programs, with primary responsibility for US regulatory strategy and additional support for global market expansion.
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Senior Regulatory Manager /Senior Principal Regulatory Specialist is a highly experienced individual contributor responsible for developing and executing regulatory strategies for innovative and complex medical device and combination product programs, with primary responsibility for US regulatory strategy and additional support for global market expansion.

This role provides deep regulatory expertise across the product lifecycle and is directly engaged in regulatory strategy development, submission planning and authoring, evidence requirements, and health authority interactions. The position serves as a senior regulatory subject matter expert to cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment to complex or novel regulatory challenges and translating regulatory requirements and agency feedback into clear, actionable plans.

The role serves as a key interface with the US FDA and other regulatory authorities and provides technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to regulatory colleagues and cross-functional partners. While the role may manage one or two colleagues, this is mainly a senior individual contributor role with significant hands-on responsibility and influence through expertise rather than formal people management.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Personally develop and execute regulatory strategies for complex, innovative, and higher-risk medical devices and combination products, with particular emphasis on US regulatory pathways.
  • Lead the preparation, authoring, review, and submission of US FDA regulatory filings, including Pre-Submissions, 510(k)s, De Novo requests, and other applicable submission types, remaining directly engaged in the content and supporting evidence.
  • Provide regulatory expertise and hands-on support for global registrations, including EU MDR Technical Documentation and other international regulatory requirements as appropriate.
  • Apply deep knowledge of FDA regulations, guidance, and review practices to novel, higher-risk, or technologically complex products, exercising sound judgment where regulatory precedent or established pathways may be limited.
  • Translate product and clinical development plans into practical regulatory strategies, including regulatory pathways, evidence requirements, submission sequencing, key decision points, risks, and dependencies.
  • Serve as a senior regulatory advisor to cross-functional teams and leadership, providing clear recommendations on regulatory strategy, registration requirements, and regulatory implications for products in development and on the market.
  • Lead FDA meetings and written communications with a high degree of autonomy, including preparation of meeting materials, briefing packages, responses to agency questions, and follow-up communications.
  • Prepare cross-functional teams for health authority interactions and work directly with technical experts to ensure regulatory responses are scientifically sound, accurate, consistent, and appropriately scoped.
  • Interpret FDA and other health authority feedback and translate it into specific actions, evidence-generation requirements, decision points, and coordinated response plans.
  • Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Clinical, Medical, and other functions to evaluate regulatory risks, challenge assumptions constructively, and resolve complex regulatory and technical issues that could affect development, submission, approval, or continued market access.
  • Work effectively through ambiguity, using regulatory expertise and risk-based judgment to develop practical approaches where requirements, precedent, or agency expectations are evolving.
  • Author, review, and approve regulatory documentation supporting product registrations, regulatory submissions, and Quality Management System requirements.
  • Support compliance with applicable regulatory and quality requirements, including FDA QSR/QMSR, ISO requirements, MDSAP, EU MDR/CE marking requirements, and other worldwide regulatory requirements as appropriate.
  • Provide regulatory expertise in support of customer complaints, internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and training activities, as appropriate.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Regulatory Affairs colleagues and cross-functional partners, building regulatory capability without formal people-management accountability.
  • Maintain current knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, guidance, emerging expectations, and industry practices and assess their potential implications for development programs and marketed products.
  • Provide managerial oversight, resource and workload allocation for at least one Regulatory Affairs Specialist supporting the program, while remaining personally hands-on with strategy, submission authoring, review and agency interactions

Authority (if applicable):

- Decision maker for complex regulatory strategies and requirements for new product development and marketed products.

- Regulatory approval of required documentation to support product registration and lifecycle management.

Skills & Experience:

  • 10-15 years relevant regulatory affairs experience, applicable cross-functional experience in the life science industry may make up a portion of the relevant experience requirements
  • Deep experience dealing directly with US FDA, as well as European Notified Bodies and Competent Authorities
  • Deep experience in the oversight and authoring of a variety of US FDA submissions, including pre-submissions, De Novo, 510(k), etc, as well as oversight for EU MDR Technical Documentation, and interface with authorities during the review process
  • Strong working knowledge of FDA review practices for novel, higher-risk, or technologically complex devices, and demonstrated sound judgment where regulatory precedent is limited
  • Experience translatinghealth authority feedback and evolving regulatory expectations into clear workstreams, decision points, evidence requirements, and coordinated response plans
  • Ability to challenge technical functions constructively and translate regulatory concerns into clear evidence-generation plans
  • Work effectively through ambiguity to develop risk-based strategies and regulatory planning for decision-making
  • Experience reviewing product labelling, and advertising/promotional material for medical devices
  • Experience supporting change control and new product development projects
  • Knowledge of compliance with key international standards, such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and ISO 10993-1
  • Excellent communication skills with experience in communication externally to US FDA with limited oversight, and holistic regulatory communication strategies
  • Demonstrate strong organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize workload
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with a variety of functional partners including medical, scientific, manufacturing and commercial
  • Management or supervisory experience preferred

Qualifications/Education:

· A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a related science or engineering field is required.

· An applicable advanced degree is preferred

Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) is preferred


Dimensions:

1-2 direct reports

Principal Contacts & Purpose of Contact

  • Internal – Marketing, Operations, Regional Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Clinical, Business-2-Business team

· External - Competent Authorities, Notified Bodies, other international governmental agencies and customers

Travel Requirements

  • This role will involve hybrid working with occasional travel where needed for team meetings/ work events. NMT 25% of work time.
  • There may be some business-related travel associated with this role dependent on project and / or local market and UK/ US/ EU travel associated with this role because some team members are home based and face-to-face contact with line manager and peers may be required.
  • Attendance of relevant training and development events would be required.
  • Some destinations may involve overnight stay(s).

Languages

· Speaking: English

· Writing/Reading: English

Working Conditions

This position is remote based, with occasional travel to the office as required.

Special Factors

There may be rare instances whereby an employee may be required to work outside of non-core hours/days. This may be due to an unexpected event, crisis or project timeline pressure as may occur within the regulatory affairs industry.

jobs.description:
Job Description

This is a fully remote role and candidate must be willing to work 8:30 AM -5pm CST

A bit about this role:

Devoted Medical was founded on the belief that if we treat each member like we would our loved ones, we can meaningfully improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for some of America’s most vulnerable patient populations. The Complex Care Department is at the heart of this goal: we are a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team of physicians, nurse practitioners, case managers, social work care managers, community health workers, and outreach specialists united by our mission to build a better care delivery system for Devoted’s most complex members. Through a mixture of in-home and virtual interventions, we provide whole-person clinical, social and logistical support for patients with complex chronic conditions, frail elders, and patients at high risk of hospital admissions. Our Outreach Coordinators play the vital role of program ambassador, resourceful connector, and scheduling logistics maestro, working in close partnership with the rest of our multidisciplinary team to ensure we’re treating each patient as we would our own family.

Our Outreach Coordinators partner with a multidisciplinary care team of physicians, NPs, case managers, social workers, and community health workers to establish trusting treatment relationships across a panel of complex patients over a 6-12 month time frame, resulting in meaningful improvements in the panel’s clinical outcomes. Outreach Coordinators play the vital role of consistent program ambassador, resourceful connector, and scheduling logistics coordinator. You will provide caring, accurate guidance in the complex world of health care, primarily via outbound and inbound calls and SMS. You will actively listen to members, see opportunity in the unexpected, respond appropriately, and create a caring atmosphere for our members.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Conducting outreach via telephone and SMS to educate and inform members of available clinical programs or important screenings relevant to them (i.e. eye exams or cancer screenings) and to ensure patients remain connected to care throughout their time in the program, working in close coordination with the care team to coordinate care delivery for the right patients, in the right way, at the right time

  • Scheduling initial appointments, thoughtfully adjusting calendars to meet urgent care needs on a regular basis and also responsible to reschedule the visits for other roles on your team.

  • Providing inbound call support/call routing for patients with clinical or administrative questions

  • Communicating frequently with the care team members and leadership, including routine involvement in daily care team coordination huddles, patient rounds, etc.

  • Developing a solid understanding of our benefit offerings in order to investigate and resolve member questions

  • Documenting accurate information about member needs in our system

  • Supporting the team with daily tasks, including administrative work

  • Piloting new processes and workflows

  • Working hand-in-hand with other Devoted teams to address member needs

Required skills & experience:

  • You have a minimum of 3 years of healthcare experience in customer/patient-serving role, such as a Care Coordinator

  • Must be willing to work M-F 8:30am-5pm Central Standard Time (CST).

Desired skills & experience:

  • 1-2 years of call center experience is a plus!

  • Bilingual Spanish speakers and experience engaging across various cultures

  • Health insurance experience (Medicare Advantage a plus)

  • Have healthcare experience (scheduling, benefits, care coordination, medical terminology, and HIPPA regulations a plus) Availability to work variable shifts to support the needs of our members across multiple time zones

  • Proficient computer skills and ability to learn new systems

  • Google Suite Proficiency a big plus - including Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides

  • Have great communication, problem solving, analytical and documentation skills

  • Use effective time management and organization skills

  • Demonstrate evidence of ability to empathize with patients, relatives and colleagues with dignity and respect

Salary range: $25.00 - $30.00 hourly

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

Who are we and what do we do?

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

NMDP is looking for an Immunogenetic Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will liaise with external partners and use your skills to influence and provide recommendations to physicians regarding donor selection. The Immunogenetic Specialist provides immunogenetic consultation and search strategy support for patients needing stem cell transplantation. This role supports assigned U.S. regional transplant center partnerships by applying established donor selection practices, evaluating HLA and related immunogenetic information, preparing search strategy recommendations, and maintaining the quality and integrity of immunogenetic data. The role develops proficiency in Clinical HLA Services (CHS) workflows, transplant center support, source selection consultation, documentation standards, and internal escalation pathways. Performs quality assurance review of HLA typing data on donor and patient forms. Works on inter-departmental teams as assigned.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Search Strategy and Donor Selection Support
• Develops skills to evaluate immunogenetic characteristics of patients and provide donor and cord blood selection plans for HLA Search Strategy Advice and related consultative services.
• Summarizes donor selection approach and best potential options in written reports for transplant center clinicians and coordinators.
• Applies established donor selection frameworks, CHS guidance, and available tools when supporting patient search strategy.
• Regularly partners with senior CHS staff or other leaders on complex or higher-risk cases to build clinical judgment, strengthen decision-making skills, and ensure alignment with established CHS practices.

Transplant Center and Partner Support

  • Serves as a CHS resource to assigned transplant center coordinators, clinicians, and internal partners.
    • Builds understanding of assigned transplant center preferences, workflows, communication needs, and regional partnership expectations.
    • Supports clear and timely communication with transplant center partners and internal stakeholders.
    • Documents relevant transplant center preferences, decision rationale, and case-specific considerations to support continuity and coverage.
    • Attends transplant center clinical team meetings, case discussions, and educational sessions as assigned, providing support and developing understanding of transplant center practices and clinical decision-making.
    Quality, Data Integrity, and Compliance
    • Monitors and evaluates HLA typing information entered into the Registry.
    • Performs quality assurance review and editing of DNA-based and serologic HLA typing data on donor and patient forms.
    • Identifies and escalates typing discrepancies, ambiguities, documentation issues, and potential quality concerns.
    • Adheres to NMDP standards, policies, procedures, and confidentiality requirements.
    Technical and Operational Support
    • Manages and analyzes complex data using approved database tools, spreadsheets, and reports.
    • Assists with testing, validation, and feedback for system enhancements and workflow improvements.
    • Participates in quality control monitoring of HLA search strategy reviews, computerized tools, and matching algorithm outputs.
    • Contributes to assigned workgroups, process improvement activities, and team projects.
    Learning and Development
    • Participates in onboarding, training, and competency development activities.
    • Builds knowledge in immunogenetics, donor selection, transplant center consultation, and CHS operational processes.
    • Incorporates feedback from peers, senior CHS staff, and leaders to strengthen independent practice.

Knowledge of:

  • Molecular biology, immunology, genetics, histocompatibility, or related scientific principles.
    • Data privacy and confidentiality principles related to patient and donor information.

    Ability to:
    • Demonstrate professional oral and written communication.
    • Learn and apply technical, clinical, and operational guidance.
    • Demonstrate problem solving, organization, and attention to detail.
    • Use Microsoft Office and relevant business systems.
    • Recognize when to escalate questions, risks, or exceptions.

Education and/or Experience:

jobs.description:
Job Description

This role is fully remote and must be located within one of the contiguous 50 states. You must be able and willing to work 4-10 hour shifts per week with working hours of 8am-6pm MST/PST, but we will considering working hours on EST/CST.

A bit about this role:

The Digital Care Program and the Responsive Care Department are redefining how we connect with patients by delivering exceptional clinical care entirely through chat and other digital channels. Our mission is to meet patients where they are — online, in real time, and with the same compassion, expertise, and partnership they would expect in person.

As an Advanced Practice Provider (NP or PA) focused on Digital Care, you will be a cornerstone of this mission. You’ll provide holistic, empathetic care to patients across multiple geographies, leveraging your clinical expertise and keen attention to detail to ensure their needs are understood and addressed. Digital Care APPs are not just providers; they are trusted partners, guiding patients through symptom management, chronic disease care, medication review, and coordination across their broader healthcare teams within and outside of Devoted — all within a digital-first experience. This role requires the agility to respond to real-time patient demand, manage evolving digital workflows, and flex across Responsive Care programs while maintaining exceptional clinical quality, safety, and patient experience.

What Makes a Digital NP at Devoted Special:

  • You are unmatched in clinical expertise, yet every interaction is guided by empathy and partnership.

  • You anticipate patient needs, solve problems proactively, and go above and beyond at every step.

  • You treat every patient as a whole person, considering both clinical and personal priorities.

  • You are an expert in service, turning digital touchpoints into meaningful, human-centered care experiences.

Required skills and experience:

  • APP with three or more years working with experience in primary care, house calls, internal medicine, family medicine, geriatrics, palliative care and/or urgent care.

  • Ability to review AI-generated responses for clinical accuracy and safety.

Licensure and certification

  • For Nurse Practitioners: active and in-good-standing RN and APRN licenses.

  • For Physician Assistants: an active and in-good-standing Physician Assistant license.

  • Role licensure and certification in good standing is required and the ability to get licensed in requested states within 90 days of hire date, starting at offer letter signing. You will be required to get licensed in additional states as needed. We believe in making it easy for you to focus on patient care. Devoted Health will cover all costs and provide full administrative support for obtaining and maintaining licenses in all required states.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Prior virtual care or telehealth experience preferred, with passion for engaging patients digitally.

  • Experience working in real-time, queue-based, or high-volume telehealth clinical environments.

  • Experience collaborating with interdisciplinary care teams and coordinating care remotely.

  • Comfort managing complex or vulnerable patient populations in a digital-first setting.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment with flexibility and curiosity.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Deliver exceptional, empathetic clinical care through real-time and asynchronous chat and other responsive care channels, supporting both the digital patient population and evolving queue-based needs across Responsive Care Department and the broader organization.

  • Manage multiple concurrent and asynchronous patient conversations while maintaining clinical accuracy, timely documentation, and reliable follow-through.

  • Guide and oversee patients’ medical management using a holistic framework (including the 5M approach: Mind, Mobility, Medications, Multicomplexity, Matters Most).

  • Collaborate closely with patients’ primary care providers, specialists, and other teams such as pharmacy and specialty care to ensure continuity and comprehensiveness of care.

  • Support patients’ care coordination with their family members and caregivers when appropriate, ensuring alignment with the patient’s priorities and goals.

  • Provide thorough assessment, clinical guidance, and follow-up in response to patient-reported symptoms, medication questions, lab results, or new health concerns.

  • Recognize when a patient’s needs cannot be safely or effectively addressed through chat and facilitate escalation to telephone, video, in-person, urgent, or emergency care as appropriate.

  • Maintain ownership of patient needs through resolution or a clear, documented handoff.

  • Maintain meticulous, accurate, and timely digital documentation in the electronic health record (EHR) in compliance with legal, ethical, and telehealth regulations.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve patient experience and outcomes, leveraging digital workflows and proactive communication.

  • Contribute to the improvement of digital workflows, standardized responses, escalation pathways, and quality standards.

  • Occasionally support broader Devoted Medical service lines in line with program growth and team needs.

  • Provide flexible clinical coverage across Responsive Care Department queues and on-call services as patient demand and operational priorities evolve.

  • Adhere to all relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards, including patient privacy and telehealth regulations.

Salary Range:$120K-155K base range plus performance based bonus paid out quarterly or annually ($10K-$20K) for a total comp range of $130K-170K

Employer-sponsored health insurance and dental and vision plan with low or no premium

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

jobs.excerpt: About the team The Activation Specialist team at Zillow works with the brokerages, teams, and agents covered by our enterprise Showcase contracts, helping them get full value from the listing experience they've already invested in.
jobs.description:
About the team

The Activation Specialist team at Zillow works with the brokerages, teams, and agents covered by our enterprise Showcase contracts, helping them get full value from the listing experience they've already invested in. We are a high-energy, coachable team that values ownership, curiosity, persistence, and customer focus. We work hand in hand with Growth Account Executives and Customer Success to turn contracted value into real adoption — and real adoption into new growth. This team plays a critical role in Zillow's growth by driving consumption across our enterprise partners and building the pipeline and talent bench for our sales organization.

About the role

This is Zillow's Activation Specialist role for Showcase Enterprise — a high-activity outreach position focused on activating and driving consumption of our enterprise contracts. You will work a portfolio of enterprise accounts in your segment, prioritizing the busiest brokerages and teams, to activate unused seats and products and turn contracted value into everyday usage.

Much of your day will be spent talking with the calling teams and agents inside these accounts — people who often still need to be sold on the value of Showcase. You will run activation outreach, show agents how Showcase helps them win and market listings, and remove the blockers that keep them from using what their company has already purchased. Along the way, you will spot cross-sell and expansion opportunities and pass qualified opportunities to our Growth Account Executives (GAEs).


Success in this role requires a consumption mindset: you understand that a signed contract only creates value when people use it, and that strong activation is what makes renewals and expansions possible. This is an ideal role for an early-career seller who wants to build a foundation in SaaS sales. Top-performing Activation Specialists build a track record that positions them for promotion into a Growth Account Executive role as positions open.


You Will Get To

Drive Activation Across Enterprise Contracts

  • Work an assigned set of enterprise Showcase accounts, prioritizing the busiest brokerages and teams in your segment where unused contracted value is highest.
  • Activate unused seats and products by reaching agents, team leads, and calling teams through outbound calls, emails, and virtual sessions.
  • Use utilization data to identify which offices, teams, and agents are under-consuming, and build targeted outreach plans to close the gap.
  • Track each account's progress toward activation milestones and keep consumption moving month over month.

Run Activation Outreach & Sell the Value of Showcase

  • Sell the value of Showcase to agents who haven't yet bought in — connecting the product to winning listing appointments, marketing listings, and growing their business.
  • Run high-volume activation campaigns, group trainings, and office outreach that turn first-time users into repeat users.
  • Handle objections with confidence, using performance data, customer stories, and best practices to build belief in the product.
  • Educate agents on best practices so they get maximum value from their company's Showcase investment.

Source & Qualify Opportunities for Growth Account Executives

  • Spot cross-sell and expansion opportunities during activation conversations — new products, additional seats, new offices, or teams ready for a deeper partnership.
  • Qualify opportunities using structured discovery (HOME, BANT) to uncover business goals, decision makers, and timing.
  • Pass qualified opportunities to GAEs with clear, thorough handoff notes so they can move quickly to a sales conversation.
  • Partner with GAEs on account strategy, sharing what you hear in the field about activation, risks, and growth potential.

Partner with Customer Success

  • Work alongside Customer Success Managers (CSMs) on a shared activation approach, with clear ownership of outreach to agents and teams in your accounts.
  • Flag low-usage and at-risk accounts early so CSMs and GAEs can act before renewal.

The Director, Product Management will lead a team responsible for product strategy, roadmaps, and delivery of billing and payment capabilities across DIRECTV’s digital, AI-powered chat, and automated voice service and support channels - making it easier for customers to manage their service and enjoy the entertainment they love.

 

This leader will advance our vision of 100% self-service by delivering connected, personalized experiences that resolve customer needs across channels for all billing and payment related needs. Everything from viewing digital bills, making payments, updating payment types, recurring payment management, and guidance and self-service capabilities for all customer related billing inquiries will be managed by the candidate who takes on this dynamic role. Partnering with leaders across Customer Care, Technology, Finance, Billing, and Marketing, the Director and their team will translate customer insights and business priorities into a coordinated product roadmap, guide execution, and measure outcomes that improve customer experience, increase self-service adoption, and drive operational efficiency.

 

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and performance of billing and payment capabilities within DIRECTV’s AI-powered self-service experiences across web, virtual assistance, and automated voice channels.
  • Lead, develop, and recruit a high-performing team of product managers, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and opportunities for growth.
  • Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, and technology providers to deliver and scale AI agents that support thousands of customer conversations each day.
  • Guide the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of AI-powered customer journeys, using prompting, conversational design, and platform capabilities to deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for generative and agentic AI to resolve customer needs, complete service tasks, and provide seamless transitions to live support with relevant customer context.
  • Establish performance goals and use customer feedback, digital analytics, and conversation insights to improve self-service adoption, containment, resolution, customer satisfaction, and cost to serve.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, competitive insights, and operational performance into product strategies and prioritized investment opportunities.
  • Develop business cases, secure funding, and track results against expected customer and financial benefits.
  • Manage product roadmaps, balancing customer value, business impact, delivery capacity, dependencies, and operational risk.
  • Guide the development of clear epics, capabilities, and acceptance criteria that align delivery teams on expected outcomes.
  • Partner with Customer Experience, User Experience, Customer Care, and internal and external technology teams to deliver intuitive, accessible, and connected customer experiences.

  • Use analytics and customer insights to identify experience gaps and production issues, quantify their impact, and prioritize resolution.
  • Move effectively between strategy and execution, removing obstacles and providing hands-on support when needed to advance delivery and cross-functional alignment.
