At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

Data communications applications change at an exponential pace, and the Digital Data Networks Business Unit is at the heart of a continuously expanding connected life. Accordingly, we provide responsive, iterative, and fundamentally agile capabilities to support today's demands. Our customers are building the devices and the infrastructure that is redefining what information technology means. Our products push markets and meet the ever-changing needs of the evolving, more connected, data-driven world. We are enhancing the way we do business, focusing on the most important things and staying agile and responsive to the needs of a faster, more connected world.

Are you a self-starter and an influencer with a passion for evolving high-speed data communication technology? At TE Connectivity, you will find a culture that rewards such hands-on engineering spirit. We empower our engineers to collaborate and support our customers' next-generation high-speed data communication products. This is a great opportunity to join our team, which is seeking a like-minded person to build relationships with key technology contacts at customers to understand technology pain points and direction.

Job Requirements

As a Power Integrity Engineer within our Digital Data Networks Business Unit, you will play a key role in simulating, developing, implementing, and verifying the power integrity of our innovative power solution portfolio. Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, you will contribute to the design, validation, scaling, deployment, and support of cutting-edge data center power solutions.

We are seeking individuals who excel at turning ambiguous requirements into precise, highly constrained solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Signal Integrity (SI) and Power Integrity (PI) design, exceptional simulation and lab measurement skills, and proven experience in designing and manufacturing power products.

As the Power Integrity Engineer, a typical day may include:
• Design, validate, and characterize power conversion and delivery systems for large compute infrastructure
• Develop power distribution products, such as cables, connectors, and bus bars, for 800+V, 20+kA server racks and data center applications
• Create simulation models, plan and execute simulation suites
• Correlate simulation results with measured lab data to validate models.
• Work with vendors to specify, procure, and validate new designs
• Measure and characterize AC response, parasitics, and impedance of the power products.
• Identify and resolve electrical issues by performing hands-on testing, debugging, and root cause analysis.
• Prepare detailed documentation and reports to support product development and validation
• Drive high-value development projects that will require you to lead and interface with large groups
• Manage technical collaboration with customers and align internal development efforts to meet technical and functional requirements.

What your background should look like

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience.
• Generally requires 10 years of electrical engineering work experience and 5+ years of experience in power conversion and distribution
• Experience using electrical design tools and software packages such as Spice, Allegro, PowerDC, Ansys Q3D
• Knowledge of voltage converter architectures
• Familiarity with high-voltage, 3-phase electrical systems is a plus
• Comfortable using different instruments such as a network analyzer, oscilloscope, signal generator, scope, and other related test equipment to measure the eye diagram
• The geographically dispersed group requires that the candidate be self-motivating with the ability to take the initiative to accomplish tasks with limited direction
• Ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences
• Effectively able to build relationships with external customers and industry leaders as well as internally across all levels, disciplines, and geographies
• Ability to spend 25% of your time traveling

You'll build the data platform from the ground up and own it, with direct visibility to Finance leadership and a clear impact on how the firm closes its books.

jobs.description:
About e6data

e6datais a lakehouse compute engine that runs SQL, streaming and AI workloads directly on open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake and Apache Hudi) within the customer's own cloud. It deploys on AWS, GCP, Azure or on-premises, entirely inside the customer's security boundary, with no data movement required.

The platform is built for scale. It is designed to handle 100 million queries per day and more than 1,000 queries per second, with compute that scales in 1-vCPU increments.

The Role

Laminar is a real-time data streaming platform that handles continuous stream processing. Written natively in Rust, it offers a single, cohesive engine to ingest high-volume streams across varied sources, execute SQL-based data transformations, and serve analytics at scale. By automating the intricacies of distributed pipeline execution, Laminar enables engineering teams to concentrate entirely on business domain logic.

We're looking for a Senior Rust Systems Engineer to work on Laminar's core streaming engine. You'll build and optimize the systems that power real-time data pipelines processing millions of events per second. This is a high-impact role where your work will directly influence how enterprises handle mission-critical streaming workloads.

Key Responsibilities

Core Systems Development

  • Design, implement, and optimize the core streaming engine built on Apache DataFusion and Apache Arrow
  • Build high-performance, zero-copy data pipelines that minimize memory overhead and maximize throughput
  • Architect improvements across multiple layers of the ingestion stack—from source connectors to query execution

Distributed Systems Development

  • Design and implement distributed coordination mechanisms for managing streaming workloads across clusters
  • Build fault-tolerant systems with proper state management, checkpointing, and recovery strategies
  • Implement consensus protocols, leader election, and distributed configuration management
  • Handle data partitioning, rebalancing, and coordination across multiple nodes

Connector Ecosystem

  • Develop robust integrations with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pulsar, NATS, Kinesis, EventHub, etc.)
  • Build adapters for message formats and serialization protocols (Avro, Protobuf, JSON, etc.)
  • Ensure fault tolerance, exactly-once semantics, and backpressure handling across connectors

Performance & Reliability

  • Profile and optimize hot paths in the streaming engine using tools like perf, flamegraphs, and memory profilers
  • Design for failure: implement retry logic, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation
  • Build comprehensive observability into distributed systems—metrics, tracing, and structured logging

Customer Impact

  • Work directly with enterprise customers on proof-of-concepts and production deployments
  • Translate customer requirements into technical specifications and architectural decisions
  • Drive product direction based on real-world usage patterns and performance data

Requirements

Basic Qualifications (Must Have)

  • 10+ years of systems engineering experiencebuilding performance-critical infrastructure
  • Strong systems programming backgroundin Rust, C++, Go, or Java—with a demonstrated ability to write safe, efficient low-level code
  • 2+ years of production Rust experience: Deep understanding of ownership, lifetimes, async/await, and the ecosystem (tokio, DataFusion, Arrow, serde, etc.)
  • Distributed systems expertise: You've built or operated systems that scale horizontally, handle partitioning, and maintain consistency guarantees
  • Streaming systems knowledge: Deep familiarity with at least one streaming platform (Kafka, Flink, Pulsar, etc.) and understanding of streaming semantics (windowing, watermarks, checkpointing)
  • Observability mindset: You instrument code with metrics and traces as a first-class concern, not an afterthought.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Aerospace CNC Parts

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 - $155/hour

Engagement: Project-based, hourly tracked per task

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, with technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in aerospace or space hardware.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.
  6. Industry experience, not academic.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

jobs.title: Global Programs & Operations Officer - Intern
jobs.excerpt: IIRR is one of the world’s leading rural development NGOs.
jobs.description:
IIRR is one of the world’s leading rural development NGOs. Founded in 1960, IIRR’s programs have impacted more than 68 million rural lives across five continents. The organization’s programs address the health, education, and environmental conditions of rural communities and prioritize the delivery of sustainable and scalable solutions that empower people to improve their lives and livelihoods. IIRR maintains offices in Africa, Asia, and North America.

IIRR is looking for intelligent, strategic, and resourceful thinkers to support the organization’s global, regional, and country-level work. IIRR Interns have the opportunity to contribute to a wide range of organizational functions and projects, gaining practical experience in an international development organization while working with colleagues across a diverse global team.

Potential Areas of Support

Intern assignments will be tailored to organizational priorities as well as the intern’s skills, interests, and academic or professional goals. Depending on current needs, interns may support one or more of the following areas:

Fundraising & Development

  • Support research and preparation of grant proposals, concept notes, donor materials, and other fundraising documents.
  • Conduct research on prospective donors, funding opportunities, and relevant trends in international development.
  • Assist with organizing and maintaining information and materials related to fundraising and donor engagement.

Partnerships

  • Support research and outreach related to potential organizational, institutional, and strategic partners.
  • Assist with partnership development activities, background research, and preparation of partnership materials.
  • Support coordination and documentation of meetings, collaborations, and learning exchanges.

Research & Learning

  • Conduct literature reviews and research on topics relevant to IIRR’s programs and organizational priorities.
  • Support the identification and documentation of tools, approaches, and evidence related to measuring program outcomes and impact.
  • Assist with research, analysis, and preparation of reports, briefs, presentations, and other knowledge products.

Projects & Programs

  • Support project initiatives in IIRR’s focus areas: health, education, food systems, economic empowerment, and the environment.
  • Assist with project planning, implementation, monitoring, documentation, and reporting.
  • Support the development of new program concepts in collaboration with colleagues around the world.

Operations & Organizational Support

  • Provide research, administrative, analytical, and coordination support to global, regional, and country teams.
  • Assist with developing and organizing operational documents, systems, processes, and internal resources.
  • Support ad-hoc organizational initiatives and assignments as needed.

Advocacy & Communications

  • Support the development of communications materials, including website content, social media, newsletters, reports, presentations, and other publications.
  • Conduct research to support advocacy and public engagement on issues relevant to IIRR’s mission and areas of work.
  • Assist with documenting and communicating program results, organizational achievements, and stories of impact.

Interns may contribute to one or several of these areas during their placement. Because IIRR operates in a dynamic international environment, assignments may evolve over the course of the internship in response to organizational priorities and opportunities.

Internship Structure

This is an unpaid internship but is available for class credit. We offer two internship models:

  1. Full-time: 5 days (40 hours) per week for 3 months
  2. Part-time: 3–4 days (20 hours) per week for 6 months

This is a fully remote internship; however, it is not an asynchronous position. Interns are expected to maintain a consistent work schedule during regular New York/East Coast business hours and to be available and responsive during their agreed upon hours.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (completed prior to internship start date)
  • Well-organized, reliable, and self-motivated
  • Helpful and responsive, including when dealing with ad-hoc requests and providing support to colleagues
  • Resourceful, creative, and comfortable with problem-solving

  • Curiosity, creativity, and willingness to contribute new and bold ideas
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to meet deadlines and effectively manage multiple tasks
  • A willingness to learn from mistakes, adapt quickly, and incorporate feedback while respecting and valuing input from a global and diverse team
  • Ability and willingness to work in a dynamic environment where responsibilities may evolve from week to week
  • Intermediate experience with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google applications
  • Responsive to manager’s feedback and able to take direction while executing work independently with minimal oversight in a remote working environment
  • Passionate about making a positive difference

Application Instructions

Submit a resume/CV, cover letter, and contact information for three references. In your cover letter, please indicate whether you are seeking a full-time or part-time internship and identify the areas of work that are of greatest interest to you (e.g., fundraising/development, partnerships, research, projects/programs, operations, or advocacy/communications). Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

No calls, please. If you have not received a response from us in two weeks, you should assume that your application was not successful on this occasion.

jobs.excerpt: Ми створюємо екосистему продуктів для розвитку кар’єри, наш перший продукт ApplyMe — AI-платформа, яка автоматизує пошук роботи і допомагає людям швидше отримувати запрошення на співбесіди.
jobs.description:
Ми створюємо екосистему продуктів для розвитку кар’єри, наш перший продукт ApplyMe — AI-платформа, яка автоматизує пошук роботи і допомагає людям швидше отримувати запрошення на співбесіди.

Ми вже провалідували бізнес-модель, налагодили залучення платного трафіку та знайшли робочу юніт-економіку. Наша наступна велика ціль — масштабування у 2027 році.

Саме тому ми шукаємоSenior User Acquisition Manager, який(-а) візьме на себе відповідальність за цей напрям і допоможе вивести продукт на новий рівень.

Твоя задача — побудувати повноцінну growth-систему, а не просто запускати рекламні кампанії.

Якщо ти вже проходив(-ла) подібний скейл, розумієш воронку end-to-end і вже мислиш як Head of Acquisition, ця роль для тебе.

Чим ти будеш займатися

  • Відповідати за paid acquisition end-to-end: розробляти стратегію закупівлі трафіку, управляти бюджетами та відповідати за досягнення бізнес-KPI.

  • Масштабувати Meta Ads до $1M+ на місяць, утримуючи CAC та LTV у цільових межах.

  • Контролювати якість трекінгу та аналітики: Meta CAPI, server-side events, UTM, атрибуція та коректність даних для прийняття рішень.

  • Знаходити й усувати вузькі місця у воронці: ads → landing → onboarding → paywall → subscription

  • Розвивати систему тестування креативів: формувати гіпотези, аналізувати результати та масштабувати успішні концепти.

  • Формувати та пріоритизувати growth-експерименти: тестувати аудиторії, офери, підходи до закупівлі та воронки на основі потенційного впливу на бізнес-результат.

  • Автоматизувати управління рекламними кампаніями та звітність: розробляти автоправила (Birch), впроваджувати AI-інструменти (зокрема Claude) для оптимізації процесів.

  • Планувати бюджети та прогнозувати результати: будувати прогнози масштабування, аналізувати відхилення та коригувати стратегію.

  • Побудувати та реалізувати стратегію зниження залежності від одного каналу та гео.

Що для нас важливо

  • 3+ роки в User Acquisition / Performance Marketing / Growth Marketing.

  • Запуск нових напрямів росту з нуля (гео, аудиторії, воронки, канали), досвід у R&D-проєктах (B2C Subscription).

  • Практичний досвід масштабування бюджетів від 100-200К на місяць до $1 млн в Meta Ads.

  • Досвід роботи з Tier 1 ринками (США або подібні), розуміння конкуренції та CPM.

  • Досвід із web-підписочними продуктами: лендинги, квіз-флоу, paywall-структури, їхній вплив на конверсію і CAC.

  • Досвід швидких циклів експериментів і пріоритизації гіпотез за впливом.

Буде перевагою

  • Робота з кількома платними каналами одночасно.

  • Досвід менеджменту або менторства UA-спеціалістів.

Тобі буде з нами комфортно, якщо ти

  • Береш відповідальність за результат, самостійно знаходиш рішення та не потребуєш постійного контролю і не відпускаєш проблему, поки не знайдеш рішення.

  • Вмієш сказати "ні" нереалістичній цілі і запропонувати альтернативу з цифрами.

  • Тобі цікаво будувати систему і команду, а не лише крутити кампанії.

  • Любиш занурюватися в деталі воронок, креативів і поведінки користувачів.

  • Спокійно ухвалюєш рішення на неповних даних в інтенсивному середовищі, де важливі швидкість і результат.

Що ми пропонуємо

  • Реальний вплив: ти відповідаєш за ключовий напрям росту, що напряму впливає на revenue.

  • Чіткий шлях до Head of Acquisition разом із масштабуванням продукту та до розвитку в R&D.

  • Мінімум бюрократії: тестуєш, вирішуєш і швидко бачиш результат.

  • Продукт зі змістом: job-tech, який реально допомагає людям знаходити роботу.

  • Віддалений формат.

Не відповідаєш усім пунктам, але маєш сильний досвід скейлу в Meta? Все одно відгукуйся, ми хочемо з тобою поговорити.

Senior Product Manager — Payments

onPhase | Full-Time | Remote

Why This Role

onPhase is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the effort to build a best-in-class B2B vendor payments solution. The onPhase platform unifies finance and operations for mid-market organizations to unlock working capital and accelerate growth, and payments sit at the heart of that story.

You’ll work closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to set the strategy and see it through to execution. If you bring deep B2B payments expertise, stay curious about where the space is heading, and want to help shape an AI-led approach to building product, we want to talk to you.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape the product. Understand customer needs and drive the evolution of the product by translating business requirements into software product functionality.
  • Co-create with customers. Engage customers and internal stakeholders in the ideation and curation process.
  • Build the partner ecosystem. Identify and integrate with partners that help achieve our vision of a best-in-class vendor payments solution, and lead partner integration initiatives.
  • Own the backlog and roadmap. Create, groom, prioritize, and maintain the product requirements backlog, and manage product roadmaps and release schedules.

  • Run alpha and beta programs. Lead early-access programs with customers to validate new capabilities before they go wide.
  • Get releases out the door. Drive release readiness and cross-organizational awareness of product issues, and support the product collateral that trains our teams and customers.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years in a product management role at a technology company, getting into the weeds and being the go-to expert for the product
  • 3+ years at a payments or fintech company, with strong B2B payments expertise
  • An AI-forward posture: you use AI tools in your product management craft and have built AI capabilities into products
  • Experience with Agile methodologies
  • A growth mindset and intrinsic curiosity
  • A passion for dissecting challenges and coming up with elegant, practical solutions

  • Help define how we build product with an AI-led SDLC, from synthesis to go-to-market
  • Join a collaborative, cross-functional team that does serious work and has fun doing it

Ready to build the payments experience mid-market finance teams have been waiting for? Apply today to join onPhase as our next Senior Product Manager — Payments.

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels. Built in Node.js/TypeScript on the Temporal workflow platform, the solution manages durable workflow execution, long-running member journeys, and reliable action delivery through Transactional Outbox and Kafka-based event patterns. This role owns the critical path between decision generation, activation, delivery, and receipt processing, ensuring actions are executed correctly, consistently, and at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you write code, lead a small team of engineers and contractors, and are accountable end-to-end for the durability, correctness, observability, and timeliness of action delivery across the member journey.

Key Responsibilities


  • Pod delivery — Own end-to-end delivery for the orchestration pod: planning, execution, quality, and shipping on time.
  • Workflow orchestration — Design and build durable, long-running workflows on Temporal in Node.js/TypeScript that model the member action lifecycle, state transitions, scheduling, activation, and delivery outcomes.
  • Action delivery architecture — Own the end-to-end action delivery pipeline from decision publication through activation, delivery acknowledgment, and state reconciliation. Design and implement Transactional Outbox patterns, atomic persist-and-publish workflows, idempotency controls, retry/backoff mechanisms, dead-letter queue handling, and delivery receipt processing.
  • Activation integrations — Own the components that activate decisions to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and publish through Kafka output patterns to downstream channels. Define delivery contracts, activation guarantees, and receipt ingestion patterns that ensure reliable action execution.
  • Hands-on development — Contribute code alongside the team, including Temporal workflows and activities, Node.js services, Kafka producers and consumers, outbox processors, and integration services.
  • Technical decisions — Make the day-to-day architecture decisions for the pod, including workflow design, state machine modeling, retry and compensation strategies, idempotency, topic strategy, schema evolution, delivery guarantees, and API contracts.
  • Distributed systems reliability — Engineer for correctness in a highly asynchronous environment. Ensure exactly-once business intent through idempotent consumers, deduplication strategies, durable state management, safe retries, and graceful failure handling.
  • Observability and operations — Establish monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational visibility across workflow execution, event publication, activation processing, and delivery acknowledgment pipelines.
  • Team leadership — Manage and mentor engineers and contractors; run code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and keep the team unblocked and moving.
  • Cross-team coordination — Coordinate interfaces with decisioning, the Action Library, activation systems, and the platform team; surface dependencies, integration risks, and operational concerns early.


Use your skills to make an impact


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant area
  • 6+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years in a tech-lead or senior-lead capacity.
  • Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend experience building production services.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, with Temporal strongly preferred (or comparable technologies such as Cadence, Step Functions, or Airflow for durable workflows).
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing and implementing Kafka producer and consumer patterns in production environments.
  • Experience building reliable event delivery systems using Transactional Outbox, event-driven integration patterns, or comparable messaging architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small pod through delivery and be accountable for technical outcomes.
  • Experience operating cloud-native systems on Azure or equivalent cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Clear communicator who can represent the pod's architecture, delivery status, operational risks, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Production experience with Temporal at scale, including workflow versioning, long-running workflow management, and operational lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience implementing Transactional Outbox patterns, delivery acknowledgment workflows, dead-letter queue management, receipt reconciliation, and exactly-once processing semantics.
  • Experience integrating Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or comparable activation and engagement platforms.
  • Experience with Kafka ecosystem tooling, event schema governance, and large-scale event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with the wider NBA platform stack, including React/TypeScript, Java services, and Decision Intelligence systems.
  • Experience with Helm, Terraform, and Kubernetes-based deployment patterns.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with PHI handling, auditability, and compliance requirements.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. jobs.description:
Director I, AP Calculus Curriculum and Assessment

College Board – AP&I

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity department, which includes precalculus, calculus, statistics, computer science, cybersecurity, and networking is currently comprised of 22 people supporting 8 courses in the AP portfolio.


About the Opportunity

As the Director I, AP Calculus you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exams, the courses curricula, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Calculus teachers worldwide. You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP Calculus, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP Calculus across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities.

In this role, you will:

Assessment Development and Scoring (45-75%) 

  • Serve as an assessment leader for AP Calculus, with primary responsibility for assessment development for AP Calculus. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that requires only minimal adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders.  
  • Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents and leveraging generative AI to author and/or review assessment content, improving and/or making more efficient assessment processes and outputs. 
  • Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for AP Calculus through iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the AP Calculus Team, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate. 
  • Independently lead the development of assessment forms for AP Calculus, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications. 
  • Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Calculus Test Development Committee. You strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits. 
  • Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP Calculus as content development contributors and reviewers. Recruit educators for the AP Calculus Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program. 
  • Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP Calculus Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You plan all year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed.  

Assessment Quality and Process (10-15%)

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
  • Support assessment workstreams within the AP Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity department.
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development.
  • Contribute to initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on AP Calculus exams.
  • Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for AP Calculus exams, identifying areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for AP Calculus exams.

Course Development, Program Support, and Stakeholder Engagement (5-25%)

  • Refine and improve the AP Calculus Course Framework to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.
  • Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP Calculus designed to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams. 
  • Recruit educators for the AP Calculus Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
  • Serve as a recognized and trusted resource within the educator community by collaboration and engagement with the community to drive teacher satisfaction with AP Calculus and its exams.
  • Collaborate with the AP Professional learning team to support AP Calculus consultants and teachers.
  • Work with the AP Higher Education team to co-develop and implement plans to raise college and university awareness of AP Calculus courses and exams, including recruiting college faculty to participate in the AP Reading, co-leading the planning and execution of discipline-specific AP Faculty Colloquia events, and supporting Visiting and Virtual Fellows Programs. 

About You

  • A master's degree in mathematics or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
  • Expertise in Calculus with at least 5 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $96,000 - $135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.

The Scrum Master will support Agile delivery across the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP), working with the Platform, Integration, and Data Management Scrum teams.

This position is responsible for facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coordinating cross-team dependencies, removing impediments, managing sprint execution, and supporting Program Increment (PI) Planning within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.

The VALIP platform supports integration and data exchange across VA supply chain, inventory, financial, and clinical systems. The Scrum Master will collaborate with technical teams working with technologies including InterSystems IRIS for Health, Databricks, and Red Hat OpenShift.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTAassociates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Facilitate daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Support Agile delivery across the VALIP Platform, Integration, and Data Management Scrum teams.
  • Coordinate sprint planning, execution, and delivery commitments with Product Owners and technical teams.
  • Identify and manage dependencies across integrated systems, shared resources, and external teams.
  • Prepare teams for quarterly PI Planning, including capacity planning, feature readiness, dependencies, and risks.
  • Participate in Scrum of Scrums, Agile Release Train (ART) syncs, and other SAFe ceremonies.
  • Coordinate shared testing, architecture, cybersecurity, and configuration management resources.
  • Maintain Jira boards, sprint backlogs, user stories, story points, dashboards, and Agile reports.
  • Monitor team velocity, sprint predictability, cycle time, and carryover to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Identify, track, escalate, and resolve impediments affecting team productivity and delivery.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to maintain prioritized and refined backlogs.
  • Ensure backlog items are appropriately defined, estimated, and ready at least two sprints ahead.
  • Manage unplanned work through established intake and prioritization processes.
  • Coordinate with development, testing, security, and release management teams to support release readiness.
  • Ensure deliverables meet established definitions of done, security requirements, testing approvals, and change control processes.
  • Coach Scrum teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and SAFe methodologies.
  • Promote collaboration, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across assigned teams.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) certification.
  • Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing Agile teams through multiple sprint cycles.
  • Experience working within a SAFe Agile Release Train, including participation in at least one PI Planning event.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira boards, sprint planning, dashboards, filters, and Agile reporting.
  • Experience using Confluence or similar collaboration and documentation tools.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed or fully remote Agile teams.
  • Strong understanding of Scrum principles, Agile methodologies, backlog management, and sprint execution.

jobs.title: Head of Growth
jobs.excerpt: From the CEO Spikeball is something special.  Every founder thinks their company is special.
jobs.description:
From the CEO

Spikeball is something special. Every founder thinks their company is special. But most customers don’t get the logo tattooed, meet their spouse through it, or make lifelong friends and travel the world because of it. Spikeball’s do. I started it in 2007 with family and friends and a simple goal that’s now our mission: to bring people together. Nearly 20 years in, we’ve had some amazing accomplishments that I’m incredibly proud of. There’s a massive opportunity ahead of us, and capturing it will take real work. That’s why this role exists.

Here’s who I’m hoping you are:

  • When you miss, it bothers you. You’re competitive in a way that makes the team better, and a loss makes you hungrier for the next win.
  • You have an unusually high level of drive, and you don’t wait to be told what to do.
  • You bring teams together. Marketing and Sales have been separate for years, and we’re combining them. We need someone who can make that work.
  • You can build a growth strategy, stress-test it, make the call, and change course when it’s not working.
  • You’re a hands-on strategist. Sleeves will be rolled up and your hands will get dirty. If you’re the right person, that excites you.
  • You hold yourself to high standards. We’re a small, efficient, values-driven team, and we hold each other to high standards.
  • You want to talk with our customers and our community. Our brand was built on community, and you’ll build relationships on both the sales and marketing side and let what you learn guide the strategy.
  • You show up with ideas I hadn’t thought of, plus a plan to execute them.
  • Nights and weekends are yours. But like the best people on our team, you’ll glance at Basecamp and email now and then off hours to make sure no one’s waiting on you. You’ll also head to a few tournaments, club meetups, college campuses a year to spend time with and learn from the people who buy and play.

If that sounds like you, I’d love to talk.

— Chris Ruder, Founder & CEO

The opportunity

Spikeball has the brand awareness of a company roughly 20 times our size. Closing the gap between how well-known we are and how big we currently are is the opportunity. That’s what this role is for.

We created a new sport and built a passionate, global community around it. Our distribution is strong: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Dick’s Sporting Goods, Mercado Libre, Scheels, specialty retail, Spikeball.com, and partners across the EU, UK, and AUS/NZ.

We’re looking for a strategic builder who’s always looking for better tools and better ways of working. You’ll own all of Marketing and Sales (wholesale, Amazon, etc). You will build and lead a team that keeps testing new ideas while doubling down on what works, through AI, creators, reach/awareness/consideration efforts, wholesale account management, community, new products, new sales channels, and whatever comes next.

Few growth leaders get to start with a brand people already know and love. The foundation is here. The next chapter is yours to shape.

The role

Your first job: figure out what's constraining Spikeball's growth. Byron Sharp's work shows that brands grow by reaching more buyers, so where are we falling short? Is it awareness (marketing), availability (sales and distribution), or the reasons people buy and come back (product)? Once that decision is made, make that the lead driver, build a two-to-three-year growth strategy around it, and give the other two clear supporting roles. We'll revisit the call as the evidence comes in.

Find the answer

  • Build the evidence base in the first 60 days: channel economics, customer and category data, awareness versus penetration, Category Entry Points (CEPs), product-line performance, and new-market opportunities.
  • Judge each driver on the same criteria: size of prize, time to impact, margin, capability we have or can build, and risk.
  • Run fast, cheap tests where the data can't settle the question.

Build the strategy

  • Name the lead driver and the specific bet within it.
  • Define what each supporting driver does to serve the lead.
  • State what we'll stop doing and what evidence would change the call.
  • Translate the strategy into our EOS 3-Year Picture, 1-Year Plan, Rocks, team design, and budget.

Execute

  • Resource the lead driver first: people, budget, and partners.
  • Put the lead driver's measurables on the weekly scorecard and revisit the call at each quarterly session.
  • Keep supporting drivers in their supporting roles so they don't become competing priorities.

Scorecard

Success is measured by these outcomes. Near-term targets are set together in the first 30 days; the 12-month revenue target comes out of the growth strategy.

First 90 days

  • Deliver a growth diagnosis and strategy to the Leadership Team. It names one lead driver with evidence, defines the supporting role of the other two, and says what we'll stop doing.
  • Audit every vendor, agency, and seat in Marketing and Sales. Recommend keep, change, or cut for each.
  • Review holiday 2026 results across all sales channels, paid social, creators, and TikTok Shop, and fold the learnings into the strategy.
  • Launch the department scorecard and weekly L10.
  • Get the Marketing and Sales org design and hiring plan approved.

First 6 months

  • Make the key hires with limited budget. Every seat has a scorecard and a clear owner.
  • Run a measurable top-of-funnel and creator engine alongside bottom-funnel paid media, using incrementality tests to set the split and decide where paid media should land (Amazon, Retail, Spikeball.com, etc).
  • Work with fractional Wholesale Sales Director and Amazon Leader to build strategy around growing existing accounts, adding new channels and markets online and off.
  • Hit Q1 and Q2 2027 Rocks and have the Summer 2027 peak-season plan in place.
  • Launch the lead driver's first major initiative, with its measurables on the weekly scorecard.

First 12 months

  • Hit the revenue growth target set in the strategy.
  • Hold or improve contribution margin while growing.
  • Show measurable growth from the lead driver against its targets, or bring evidence to change the call.
  • Deliver the Summer 2027 season against plan.
  • Marketing and Sales runs without the Visionary CEO in day-to-day execution.

What this role is not

  • Not a CMO who manages agencies from a distance. You're in the data and the ad accounts, and you run tests yourself when needed.
  • Not a pure sales role. This role is approximately 80% marketing and 20% sales.
  • Not a ROAS optimizer. Bottom-funnel efficiency matters, but the job is identifying and growing demand and capturing it efficiently.
  • Not the brand owner. The Visionary CEO sets the brand vision, and the creative team brings it to life. You own turning the brand into revenue.
  • Not product development or operations. You bring evidence on which products to build and where to sell them. You don't run product design, supply chain, or fulfillment.
  • Not a big-budget, big-headcount role. Lean team, US and overseas talent, AI leverage.
  • Not a caretaker. This seat is for someone who wants to build what’s next, not maintain what exists. Sleeves will be rolled up and you’ll need to be ready to pivot when needed.

Who you are (Must-haves)

  • Has diagnosed the real constraint on a brand's growth, made the call on where to focus, and reallocated people and budget around it, with results to show for it.
  • Built a marketing or growth org from a handful of people into a full department, including hiring leaders.
  • Led a step-change in revenue at an omnichannel consumer products brand.
  • Shipped AI into production workflows (creative, analytics, customer service, or operations), not just pilots.
  • Has managed the creative function, including creative strategy, and can decide how it's best staffed: in-house, fractional, or agency.
  • Commercially and financially fluent: reads a P&L, knows contribution margin by channel, and manages to it and makes it part of the overall strategy.

Strong pluses

  • Amazon expertise and big-box wholesale experience.
  • EOS experience.
  • Launched new product lines or entered new markets, including international.

We'll ask for specific examples with numbers for every must-have.

Our core values:

  • Motivated.
  • Proactive.
  • Collaborative.
  • Challenge the Status Quo.
  • Disciplined.

We take our values seriously. We try to hire, fire and manage by these values. They’re not just hanging in frame in a hallway. We actually don’t have a hallway (we’re remote), but if we did, you wouldn’t find a framed poster of a soaring eagle with our values printed below.

Why work for Spikeball:

  • Autonomy. You are a driven, highly motivated person. You don’t need someone constantly peering over your shoulder. It’s up to you to determine how you will achieve your goals. We’ll support you as much as you want. We will get out of your way so you can do the brilliant things that we know you’re capable of.
  • Help bring people together. That's the mission of the company.
  • We’re a small team, so your efforts will directly impact the entire business.
  • Unlimited PTO plus 13 paid company holidays (work really really hard and relax often).
  • Paid time off for Birthdays (You were born.. life isn’t easy.. you deserve it!)
  • Medical and dental insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield, with multiple plan options. Marriages and domestic partnerships are covered equally.
  • 401(k) through Vanguard with a company match of up to 4% of salary. You’re eligible starting with your first paycheck.

jobs.description:
SurrealDB is building a bench of experienced Forward Deployed Engineers for future customer engagements, working inside enterprise customers' engineering teams to design, deploy and scale SurrealDB and SurrealDB Agent Memory in production. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as platform engineering, agentic AI, data engineering or application development, and be keen to broaden your skills across others. Few people have years of SurrealDB or agent memory experience, so we care more about solid engineering habits and how fast you learn than years on a CV. We train and certify every Forward Deployed Engineer before they go to a customer.
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly inside a customer's engineering team, turning architecture into running production systems and leaving their team able to own the platform. You will report to a SurrealDB engineering manager and work closely with our engineering and customer teams.
This role is for engineers based anywhere in the world, including those in the UK or US who are not available for our current engagement. We will contact members of the bench as suitable projects come up.

About the bench
  • Contract engagements, with length, hours and location requirements set for each project
  • Open to engineers globally, subject to location eligibility, which we will confirm early in the process
  • Joining the bench does not guarantee a contract, but you will be pre-approved and among the first we contact when a suitable project comes up
  • Engagements may involve customer-provided equipment, background checks and occasional on-site travel

What you'll be doing

On every engagement, you will:
  • Work hands-on alongside the customer's engineers, from architecture through to go-live
  • Own SurrealDB data modelling in SurrealQL across documents, graph relations and vectors, including query and index tuning
  • Build ingestion and migration pipelines from existing stores such as Cosmos DB, Postgres, MongoDB, vector databases or search services
  • Document architecture decisions, progress and risks for weekly status reporting
  • Contribute to customer architecture and security questionnaires with the SurrealDB team
  • Support knowledge transfer through pair programming, reviews, workshops, runbooks and reference material for future engagements
Depending on the engagement and your strengths, you may also focus on areas such as:
  • Platform and infrastructure: standing up SurrealDB and Agent Memory environments on the customer's cloud or SurrealDB Cloud, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, backup, upgrades and security reviews
  • Agentic AI: agent memory implementation, retrieval design, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails
  • Data engineering and migration: designing pipelines, migrating from existing databases and search services, and data quality at scale
  • Search and retrieval: vector, full-text and hybrid search, relevance tuning and performance optimisation
  • Application development: integrating SurrealDB into customer applications and services using our SDKs and APIs
  • Performance and reliability: load testing, query and index tuning, capacity planning and production readiness

About you

  • Proven experience delivering agentic AI systems, cloud data platforms, or both, in production
  • Experience in database work beyond basic CRUD: data modelling, indexes, query plans and migrations
  • Proven experience running services on at least one major cloud: AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Working knowledge of at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go or Rust
  • Ability to explain technical decisions clearly to customer engineers, architects, security teams and stakeholders
  • Comfortable working embedded in a customer or client engineering team
  • Open to contract engagements, with hours, length and location set for each project
You will also bring deep expertise in at least one specialist area, for example:
  • Platform engineering, with containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code (Terraform, OpenTofu or Pulumi)
  • Agentic AI, with agent memory, agent frameworks, retrieval (RAG) and evaluation workflows
  • Data engineering, with large-scale pipelines and database migrations
  • Search and retrieval, with vector, full-text or hybrid search systems
  • Backend or application development, building production services in Python, TypeScript, Go or Rust
Strong plus
  • Hands-on experience deploying or integrating an agent memory tool, such as Mem0, Graphiti or Zep, Letta, LangMem or Cognee (a personal or open-source project counts)
  • Familiarity with SurrealDB, PostgreSQL, Azure (AKS, Entra ID, Key Vault), observability stacks or regulated environments
  • Previous experience working as a contractor or consultant
  • Community contributors and SurrealDB Ambassadors are very welcome to apply
What you will learn
  • In-depth SurrealDB and SurrealDB Agent Memory, certified by our engineering team
  • How enterprise teams take data and AI systems from pilot to production
  • A pathway into future SurrealDB engagements and roles
We understand that each candidate brings a unique set of skills and experiences, and we encourage applicants to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed in the job description.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

If you are passionate about water and technology, Trinnex is the place for you! Trinnex is a visionary company that is transforming the way water resources are managed and protected. By combining cutting-edge digital technologies, such as sensor/IoT data, models, geospatial data, and AI/machine learning, we create innovative, smart, and scalable solutions that make a difference. Whether it's optimizing water supply and demand, detecting leaks and anomalies, or enhancing water quality and resilience, Trinnex delivers value and impact to public sector clients across the country.


Job Description

We are seeking an Asset Management Market Leader to lead the growth of our asset management consulting practice serving water and wastewater utilities. This individual will have commercial responsibility for expanding our asset management business, strengthening our market position, and helping clients develop practical, sustainable approaches to managing infrastructure assets.

The Market Leader will work closely with sales and marketing teams, client service leaders, technical discipline leaders, and project teams to identify opportunities, develop client solutions, support pursuits, and expand asset management services across existing and new clients.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in the water/wastewater industry, including substantial hands-on experience delivering asset management programs and projects. This role is intended for someone who combines technical credibility with strong client relationships, commercial instincts, and an interest in building and growing a business.

Key Responsibilities

Market Growth and Business Development

  • Refine and lead the execution of a strategy for growing Trinnex’s water and wastewater asset management discipline.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of asset management opportunities across existing and prospective clients.
  • Work closely with sales, marketing, and client service teams to identify client needs and position asset management services.
  • Develop client-specific pursuit strategies and support proposals, presentations, interviews, and other business development activities.
  • Build relationships with utility executives, engineering and operations leaders, and other key decisionmakers.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate asset management services into broader capital planning, engineering, operations, and utility advisory engagements.
  • Help establish clear market positioning and messaging around the firm's asset management capabilities.

Asset Management Leadership

  • Serve as a recognized internal and external leader in water and wastewater asset management.
  • Bring practical, hands-on experience developing and implementing asset management programs for utilities.
  • Help clients translate asset management principles into actionable programs, investment strategies, and business processes.
  • Provide senior-level guidance on areas such as: asset inventories and hierarchy development; condition and performance assessment; likelihood and consequence of failure; risk-based asset prioritization; lifecycle planning; maintenance and renewal strategies; capital investment prioritization; levels of service and performance measures; and asset management plans and implementation road maps.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists to integrate asset management practices with CMMS/EAM systems, GIS, operational data, capital planning, and financial planning.
  • Develop and implement innovative solutions to address clients’ utility management challenges, leveraging digital technologies and artificial intelligence to enhance asset inventory development, condition assessments, data quality, and day-to-day utility decision-making.

Collaboration and Practice Development

  • Work closely with technical discipline leaders to connect subject-matter expertise with market opportunities.
  • Collaborate across engineering, operations, digital, data, and utility advisory practices to develop integrated solutions for clients.
  • Help develop repeatable methodologies, tools, deliverables, and approaches that strengthen the firm's asset management offering.
  • Support development and mentoring of staff interested in building asset management capabilities.
  • Identify emerging client needs, industry trends, and service opportunities and translate them into new offerings.

Project and Client Leadership

  • Serve as a senior advisor and trusted partner to utility clients.
  • Lead or provide senior oversight for selected asset management engagements.
  • Help project teams maintain a strong connection between technical analysis and the operational, financial, and organizational decisions utilities need to make.
  • Maintain strong client relationships beyond individual projects and identify opportunities for follow-on work.

Skills & Abilities

  • Expert communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with demonstrated experience working directly with utility clients and senior leadership while effectively engaging technical teams and external stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute market growth strategies, identify business opportunities, and build strong client relationships.
  • Expert knowledge of water and wastewater utility asset management principles, practices, and implementation strategies, supported by demonstrated hands-on experience delivering asset management programs, assessments, plans, and implementation initiatives.
  • Excellent understanding of utility infrastructure, operations, asset lifecycle management, risk assessment, capital planning, and asset management technologies.
  • Strong business development skills, with demonstrated experience in client engagement, strategic pursuits, proposal development, client presentations, and market positioning.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership and ability to collaborate across technical disciplines, influence decisions, build consensus, and translate complex asset management concepts into innovative, practical client solutions.
  • Strong project leadership, organizational, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance technical delivery, client needs, and business growth objectives.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across teams, mentor staff, and develop integrated client solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10 years of related experience with at least 2 of those years in a supervisory or leadership capacity.

Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a college degree. Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 10–20 years of relevant professional experience, preferably focused on water and wastewater utilities.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science, business, planning, or a related field.
  • Experience developing or implementing asset management frameworks consistent with ISO 55000/55001 or Institute of Asset Management (IAM) principles.
  • Familiarity with enterprise asset management and computerized maintenance management systems used by water and wastewater utilities.
  • Experience integrating GIS, condition assessment, risk, maintenance, capital planning, and financial information into asset management programs.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Reliability Leader (CRL), Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP), IAM Certificate/Diploma, or similar relevant credentials.
  • Existing relationships within the water and wastewater utility market.
  • Knowledge of transportation, stormwater, electrical, or other related infrastructure service areas.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, AI-forward product leader to set the product vision and strategy for Gallery Systems, the trusted partner for the world's most respected museums, galleries, archives, universities, and private collections.

Job Description:

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced, AI-forward product leader to set the product vision and strategy for Gallery Systems, the trusted partner for the world's most respected museums, galleries, archives, universities, and private collections.


For 40+ years, Gallery Systems has been indispensable to the world's finest cultural institutions, enabling registrars, curators, conservators, and collections professionals to preserve, steward, and share the irreplaceable artifacts in their care. Through the TMS Suite (TMS Collections, eMuseum, and our conservation documentation and digital asset management solutions) and our Art Business products for galleries and the art market, we serve hundreds of institutions across the globe.


Job Details

The Opportunity:

The priority will be to define where Gallery Systems leads the collections management market and to build a modern product practice that gets us there. You will lead the product management team and own product vision, product portfolio strategy, and the roadmap. Collections professionals expect smarter, connected tools, and AI is opening new ways to catalogue, research, describe, and share collections. You will shape how Gallery Systems uses AI in its products, with the accuracy, provenance, and trust standards our customers depend on.


Our product team brings deep knowledge of museums and our customers' work. You will build rigorous product discovery, prioritization, specification, and outcome measurement around that knowledge, and grow the team's skills along the way. You will partner with the Director of Engineering to move Gallery Systems from AI-assisted to AI-directed development, owning the spec quality and standards that make it possible, and you will be fully accountable for the direction of our product portfolio.


A Day in the Life:

Leadership

  • Lead and develop product managers, with clear expectations, direct feedback, and individual growth plans
  • Create an open, curious environment where decisions rest on evidence and people feel ownership of outcomes
  • Set clear ownership: product managers own product outcomes, while development and services capacity is planned jointly with Engineering and Professional Services
  • Build a modern product practice, including discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, specification, and outcome measurement, with lightweight, consistent artifacts
  • Represent product on the leadership team and within the Volaris portfolio

Product Strategy

  • Define the product vision and portfolio strategy for the museum, cultural heritage, and art markets, grounded in market research, competitive analysis, and customer data
  • Make portfolio decisions about investment, platform transitions, retirement of legacy products, and integration of acquired products
  • Balance investment in new capabilities with maintenance to maximize new name growth and retention of existing customers
  • Build a business case for every major investment that shows its expected revenue impact, and own the portfolio's growth and retention targets
  • Own pricing and packaging recommendations, including for AI capabilities, in partnership with Sales and Finance
  • Reduce implementation cost and time to value for new customers through product design, automation, and AI

AI-Native Product Management

  • Use AI throughout product work, including research synthesis, customer insight analysis, rapid prototyping, spec writing, and competitive monitoring, and coach the team to do the same
  • Define spec standards and workflows that work for AI-delegated development, so AI agents and developers can build from them reliably
  • Champion the responsible integration of AI into our products, enhancing cataloguing, research, discovery, and metadata work while respecting the expertise of collections professionals
  • Set how we evaluate AI features for quality, accuracy, provenance, privacy, and responsible use
  • Track the fast-moving AI landscape and turn it into product opportunity

Roadmap & Delivery

  • Own the prioritized roadmap for all company products, tied to revenue, retention, and migration goals, kept current and visible across the company
  • Define product requirements for platform-level capabilities, such as reporting and identity and user management
  • Partner with the Director of Engineering on capacity, sequencing, and release dates
  • Treat security, accessibility (Section 508 and WCAG), FedRAMP, and ISO 27001 requirements as product requirements, in partnership with IT and Security
  • Define success metrics for every major initiative and report on adoption and customer impact after release
  • Ensure products ship fully documented, so Customer Care and Professional Services can implement and support them without depending on individual product managers

Customers & Market

  • Develop deep intelligence about the evolving needs of the cultural heritage and art business markets through regular customer interviews, usability testing, and analysis of support and sales data
  • Hold regular, structured customer conversations, and validate problems and solutions with customers before work is committed to the roadmap
  • Build relationships with customers, user groups, and partners, and represent Gallery Systems at industry events
  • Lead go-to-market for releases with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Care, including positioning, enablement, and release communications
  • Plan customer communications and release moves with Customer Success as customers transition to new platforms
  • Run one clear intake process for requests and insights from Sales, Customer Care, and Professional Services


What You Will Bring to the Table:

  • 10+ years in B2B software product management, including 5+ years leading product managers
  • Experience in a mature product organization and formal grounding in modern product practice, with the ability to teach it
  • A track record of building or rebuilding a product function and raising the skills of a team new to structured product management
  • Proven product strategy work, including market analysis, portfolio decisions, pricing and packaging, and roadmaps tied to business outcomes
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI in your own product work, and experience writing specs for AI-assisted or AI-delegated development
  • Experience defining and shipping AI features, including evaluation, quality standards, and responsible-use decisions
  • Experience leading products through a platform transition, such as desktop or on-premises to SaaS
  • Prior experience with collections management, digital asset management, museum, archive, library, or art market software is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer focused on model distillation to help us build smaller, faster, and more efficient models without sacrificing quality. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production—taking cutting-edge techniques and turning them into systems that scale.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership: you’ll design distillation pipelines, run large-scale experiments, and ship models used in production.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement knowledge distillation pipelines (teacher–student, self-distillation, multi-teacher, etc.)

  • Distill large foundation models into smaller, faster, and cheaper models for inference

  • Run and analyze large-scale training experiments to evaluate quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs

  • Collaborate with research to translate new distillation ideas into production-ready code

  • Optimize training and inference performance (memory, throughput, latency)

  • Contribute to internal tooling, evaluation frameworks, and experiment tracking

  • (Optional) Contribute back to open-source models, tooling, or research

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background in machine learning or deep learning

  • Hands-on experience with model distillation (LLMs or other neural networks)

  • Solid understanding of training dynamics, loss functions, and optimization

  • Experience with PyTorch (or JAX) and modern ML tooling

  • Comfort running experiments on multi-GPU or distributed setups

  • Ability to reason about model quality vs. performance tradeoffs

  • Pragmatic mindset: you care about shipping, not just papers

Nice to Have

  • Experience distilling LLMs or large sequence models

  • Experience with inference optimization (quantization, pruning, kernels, etc.)

  • Familiarity with evaluation for language models

  • Open-source contributions or research publications

  • Experience in early-stage or fast-moving startups

Why Join

  • Work on core model quality and cost efficiency—not side projects

  • High ownership and direct impact on product and roadmap

  • Small, senior team with strong research + engineering culture

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity

  • Remote-friendly, async-first environment

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

Responsibilities include implementing and maintaining Vault configurations, performing unit testing, supporting validation activities, and troubleshooting production issues, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how clinical teams work every day.

  • Strong clinical systems experience or a background in a regulated environment, along with a willingness to develop Veeva expertise.
  • The ability to learn quickly and work effectively under guidance from senior developers and technical leads.
  • A commitment to quality, with strong attention to detail in testing and documentation.
  • Comfort working within configuration, validation, release, and change-control standards.

Required Qualifications

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in application configuration, development, or clinical technology.
  • Basic understanding of Vault objects and fields, documents and metadata, lifecycles, workflows, roles and permissions, and reports and dashboards.
  • Ability to implement low-to-medium complexity Vault configuration changes with guidance.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle and change management processes, and a basic understanding of GxP, validated systems, and regulated application delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Veeva Vault, or strong clinical systems experience with a willingness to develop Veeva expertise.
