Final Interview: Client interview by phone or in person

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring an Enterprise Architect on behalf of the client, a state government agency, to support the state human services agency's Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) program. The Enterprise Architect helps the state build a modern, responsive, stable and secure infrastructure for IE&E program work, providing guidance, recommendations and technical expertise on enterprise architecture processes and practices across the application, technology and information architecture domains.

The engagement covers architecture leadership, governance and technical deliverables across four workstreams: Governance and Agile Integration, DataOps Modernization, Microsoft Stack Expansion, and Legacy Workflow Retirement. The Enterprise Architect is a member of the state's Enterprise Architecture Office, reports to the Director of Enterprise Architecture, and works with state enterprise architects and solution providers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop technology and architecture roadmaps and implementation plans, plus analysis and readiness plans for adopting new processes or technologies.
  • Produce enterprise reference and logical architecture diagrams (current and future state), integration architecture, system integration and data-flow diagrams, and architecture vision documentation for business partners.
  • Carry out architecture governance work and take part in the Enterprise Architecture Review Board or similar change control boards for architecture changes.
  • Prepare architecture gap analyses and document alternatives analyses when needed.
  • Advise the state on architecture changes to its integrated eligibility and enrollment systems, its comprehensive child welfare information system (CCWIS) and its customer communication and notification platforms.
  • Provide input to and review RFPs and contracts, support procurements by reviewing demonstrations and bid submissions, and support service level agreements with solution vendors and internal service providers across the human services agency's departments.
  • Define infrastructure, application, cloud-services and data-services non-functional requirements, and review design documents (DDI).
  • Where needed, deliver Governance and Agile Integration architecture (enterprise governance architecture, architecture decision frameworks, Agile-enterprise integration architecture), DataOps Modernization architecture (data ingestion, entity resolution, data quality, lineage, metadata and semantic layer) and Legacy Workflow Retirement architecture (legacy system inventory and assessment, transition-state, decommissioning and cutover/rollback architecture).
  • Prepare CMS certification artifacts when applicable, and provide data governance assistance on assigned projects.
  • Deliver a weekly status report and scrum to the Director of the Enterprise Architecture Office, and attend, and when appropriate lead, design sessions, steering committee meetings and project meetings.
  • Attend a monthly engagement meeting with the state's enterprise architecture staff, and other meetings when requested.
  • Work on state-provided tools: a state-issued computer, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Visio Professional and Azure DevOps.

Requirements

Required:

  • Experience working within an architecture framework such as TOGAF or FEAF.
  • Experience working within at least two architecture domains: business architecture, application architecture, information/data architecture and technology architecture.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work within a team, meet shifting deadlines and work within a set budget.
  • Current annual cybersecurity awareness and HIPAA training certificates (copies are submitted to the client with your resume), or the ability to complete both before submission; the client's annual compliance training must also be completed and kept current during the engagement.
  • Three professional references, submitted with the application, who can speak to your enterprise architecture work.
  • Available 35 to 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday between 7:45 AM and 4:30 PM Eastern Time, for the full 12-month term.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States; work cannot be performed from outside the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099).
  • Must pass a national criminal background check, sign the client's acceptable use and confidentiality terms, work only on client-provided systems, disclose any conflict of interest and any planned use of AI tools in the work, and not use AI meeting assistants in client meetings.

Preferred:

  • Enterprise architecture experience on state integrated eligibility and enrollment systems or other health and human services benefit systems.
  • Experience with child welfare information systems (CCWIS), customer communication and notification platforms, data warehouse or DataOps modernization, or Microsoft technology stack architecture.
  • TOGAF or a comparable architecture certification.
  • Prior work with a state central IT agency or enterprise architecture office.

How to Apply

Please send your resume, three professional references and copies of your certificates (TOGAF or other certifications listed on your resume, and your current HIPAA and cybersecurity awareness training certificates) to with "Enterprise Architect, IE&E" in the subject line. For each reference, include the name, title, organization, email address, phone number and the work the reference can speak to.

jobs.title: Director of Growth
jobs.excerpt: About Darkroom Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a senior growth marketer to own acquisition and lifecycle for Shadow, the most advanced marketing agent in the world, and Darkroom, our tech-enabled growth firm. Ad Age recently described us as “if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI.” Your job is to turn the attention we create into sign-ups, paying users and qualified leads. Shadow comes first.

This is a media and lifecycle role. You run paid acquisition, own the funnel from first click to paying user, and keep testing until the numbers move. Paid media and lifecycle sit under you. You work closely with our SEO and creator teams, the Director of Content, sales and the Shadow product team, and you run the work in Shadow from day one.

This is a New York-based role operating in the EST Time Zone, on-site at our NYC office, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you'll own

  1. Paid Acquisition: Meta, Google, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok, and new platforms. The budget split, audiences, bidding, and testing priorities.

  2. Creative Testing: A standing testing system for messages, use cases, audiences and formats. Brief the creative team, scale what works, and kill what doesn’t.

  3. Content Distribution: Turn our weekly long-form and short-form video content into paid distribution that brings people to Shadow.

  4. Sign-up & Activation: The Shadow sign-up and onboarding flow, with Product: activation milestones, in-app prompts, and the path to the first useful result. Landing pages and conversion tests.

  5. Lifecycle: Email and HubSpot. Onboarding, engagement, win-back, and upgrade for Shadow, and lead nurture for Darkroom.

  6. Darkroom Inbound: Qualified leads, cost per lead, and routing with sales so leads turn into meetings.

  7. Measurement: From spend to sign-up to paid to retention for Shadow, and from spend to lead to pipeline for Darkroom. Attribution, incrementality tests, clean CRM data, a weekly growth review, and a monthly report to leadership.

  8. Team: Lead the lifecycle manager and paid media specialists day-to-day, and work tightly with the SEO and creator team so everything feeds the same funnel.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  1. 4+ years in growth or performance marketing, with paid budgets you managed yourself. You have scaled acquisition on Meta and Google and at least one of LinkedIn, TikTok or YouTube, and you can show what happened to CAC, conversion and revenue.

  2. You have grown a self-serve product: a SaaS, subscription or app where people sign up, activate and pay without talking to sales. You have moved activation and retention, not only the top of the funnel, and you have run lifecycle yourself: onboarding, nurture, segmentation and re-engagement, ideally in HubSpot.

  3. You know our world. DTC, e-commerce, performance marketing, AI tooling. Shadow’s users are marketers, so you can tell a strong ad from a weak one and explain why. B2B lead generation for an agency or services business is a strong plus.

  4. You are AI forward and already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily for analysis and execution, and have shipped real work with them. We are a Claude-first company.

Hard disqualifiers

  1. Less than 4 years of experience in growth or performance marketing.

  2. Never managed paid budgets yourself, only through agencies.

  3. No experience growing a self-serve product (SaaS, subscription or app).

  4. No ownership of acquisition targets like CAC, conversion, sign-ups or qualified leads.

  5. Experience mainly in events, partnerships or brand marketing.

  6. No experience using AI tools.



What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We're looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect everyone to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity and ownership, and we support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work.

  • In person in NYC: You'll work from our New York office at 40 Wall St, side by side with the CEO.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances and retirement: A 401(k) with company match and profit-sharing opportunities.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave for new parents.

  • Growth: A direct path to running a line of the business.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $180,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Security Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Are you a cybersecurity professional with a passion for helping organizations build secure, compliant, and resilient environments?
jobs.description:
Are you a cybersecurity professional with a passion for helping organizations build secure, compliant, and resilient environments? Join our growing team as a Senior Cybersecurity Consultant and work directly with clients to design and implement solutions that align with regulatory requirements, modern cloud infrastructures, and real-world threat scenarios.

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Consultant with expertise in regulatory compliance, cloud security, vulnerability management, attack surface management, incident response, security awareness training, and virtual CISO (vCISO) services. In this role, you will work closely with clients to assess risk, strengthen cybersecurity programs, and align security initiatives with industry frameworks such as NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls. You will conduct security assessments and cloud environment reviews, run vulnerability and attack surface management programs, deliver clear security reporting, and help develop and implement scalable security policies and technical controls. You will also use AI tools to sharpen your own analysis and help clients adopt AI securely.

Consider your day-to-day responsibilities in this role:

  • Conduct comprehensive cyber risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and business impacts.

  • Lead cybersecurity assessments aligned with frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST 800-171, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.

  • Run vulnerability management programs for clients: configure and tune scanning, prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact (CVSS, EPSS, and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog), and work with client IT teams to drive remediation through closure.

  • Deliver attack surface management services, including external asset discovery, monitoring for exposed services and misconfigurations, dark web and credential exposure checks, and penetration test scoping and follow-up.

  • Evaluate and strengthen cloud security architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.

  • Develop and implement security policies, technical controls, and remediation strategies.

  • Develop and implement security awareness training programs and assist clients in creating a culture of security.

  • Provide vCISO services including cybersecurity strategy development, governance leadership, and executive-level risk reporting.

  • Produce client-ready security reporting, including assessment findings, recurring vulnerability and attack surface reports, Microsoft Secure Score reviews, incident reports, and executive briefings that turn technical risk into prioritized business decisions.

  • Design and facilitate incident response plans and tabletop exercises to ensure clients are prepared for real-world threats.

  • Use AI tools to speed up security analysis, alert and phishing triage, and report development, and advise clients on secure AI adoption, including AI risk assessments and governance aligned with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity consulting or advisory services.

  • Strong understanding of cyber risk management, regulatory compliance, and cloud security principles.

  • Experience performing cyber risk assessments and developing prioritized remediation plans.

  • Background in delivering vCISO services or leading security program initiatives.

  • Skilled in developing and testing incident response plans and running tabletop exercises.

  • Practical experience using AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude) in security work, plus working knowledge of AI security risks and governance frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Excellent communication and reporting skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive leadership and turn technical findings into clear, prioritized security reports.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, or similar) are required.

  • Experience with GRC or Cyber Risk Management tools is preferred.

What you should know about Resultant:

  • Rezzers are humble, hungry, and smart. We solve big problems, serve lots of clients, and are entirely committed to delivering transformative outcomes.
  • Rezzers are team players, deeply dedicated to the mission of the organization and to helping everyone around us be successful.
  • Resultant compensates well, rewarding performance that delivers positive outcomes for our clients and ensuring incentives are aligned to achieve our goals.
  • Resultant leaders work hard, serving as a shining example of what it means to be a great Rezzer. They are servant leaders, helping their team to be successful in all possible ways.
  • We have a great benefits package including unlimited vacation, significant 401k contributions, and several opportunities to develop yourself.
  • We pride ourselves in having the best talent in the industry and hope that you’re up for the challenge!

What our team members say about us…

  • “I love our true empathy and concern for our clients, it's very rare and appreciated. It is a pleasure to be a part of an organization like Resultant.”
  • “I learn something new every single day, and I feel like I'm a part of building an organization that has legs. I appreciate that I'm consistently humbled by the talent and caliber of our team.”
  • “The culture of the company is amazing, and the climate of my team is great. The benefits that employees are offered are better than competitors, and the one-on-one presence that my team lead gives is extremely beneficial to me.”

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We embrace AI across everything we do, and that includes how you prepare for this interview. Feel free to use AI tools to research the role, practice your responses, and put your best foot forward. What matters to us is getting to know the real you — how you think, how you communicate, and what you genuinely bring to the table. Our interviews are designed to go deeper than any polished answer, so come curious and come as yourself without the support of an AI tool during our conversation.

Resultant is a modern consulting firm with a radically different approach to solving problems.

We don’t solve problems for our clients. We solve problems with them.

Through outcomes driven by data analytics, technology solutions, digital transformation, and beyond, our team works with clients in both the public and private sectors to solve their most complex challenges. We start by learning as much as we can about who they are, how they work, and what they’re striving for so we can feel their problems as our own. Partnering with our clients means their desired outcomes are always top of mind, their challenges and strengths guiding our efforts. We build client-focused relationships before we build unique solutions that blaze past expectations.

Originally founded in Indianapolis as KSM Consulting in 2008, Resultant now employs more than 350 team members who operate from offices around the United States including Indianapolis, Fort Wayne and Odon, Indiana; Columbus, Ohio; Lansing, Michigan; Denver, Colorado; Dallas, Texas and Atlanta, Georgia.

We’re Resultant. Clients partner with us to see a difference. People join us to make one.

jobs.description:
About the role

As a Programme Manager at Infinite Lambda, you'll be a pivotal force behind the successful delivery of large-scale, complex client projects for our most important clients. You will be at the forefront of business transformation, holding ultimate accountability for project execution and owning the entire project lifecycle. You will ensure all projects and workstreams deliver tangible, measurable business value, on time and within budget, helping clients innovate and compete.

You are a key partner in our client relationships, working with our Account Managers to nurture long-term partnerships and spot new opportunities, contributing to the growth of our client accounts. You will use your positive and collaborative attitude to foster a culture of excellence, self-organisation, and high accountability across delivery streams. Your empathy and problem-solving skills will be essential as you guide your team to become more self-organised and accountable, celebrating successes along the way.

*NOTE: At Infinite Lambda, the role of Data Programme Manager is simply a local variation of the job title, internally the job title is Programme Manager.

  • Anticipated start date: Early January 2027

  • Interview process

    1. Intro call with TABP: 45 minutes

    2. Take-home technical assignment.

    3. Technical interview with Head of Programme Management: 60 minutes.

    4. Cultural interview with APAC General Manager: 45 minutes.

  • Location: Bulgaria and Hungary (Permanent contract), Slovakia & Romania (B2B contract)

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of client projects using Agile or Waterfall methodologies (depending on the best fit with the client), expertly tailoring your approach to the specific needs and phase of each project.

  • Develop and maintain clear scope and timelines, ensuring you can protect projects against scope creep and provide alternative solutions to recover as needed.

  • Gather, analyse, and document business requirements, working closely with clients and internal teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Facilitate stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions to elicit needs and uncover pain points, constraints, and opportunities.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, including test planning, UAT coordination, and defect triage, ensuring delivered solutions meet agreed acceptance criteria.

  • Conduct data analysis and profiling to validate requirements, support migration activities, and inform data model and reporting design.

  • Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, clarifying scope, managing ambiguity, and communicating trade offs.

  • Proactively develop and champion creative, non-standard solutions to execution challenges, ensuring optimal recovery and continuous improvement in delivery standards.

  • Establish and uphold stringent project standards and governance models to ensure predictable, high-quality execution across all workstreams.

  • Facilitate steering committees and provide clear, trusted updates to executive sponsors.

  • Work with teams from both Infinite Lambda and the client to deliver projects, earning their trust and getting 360-degree feedback on feasibility and plans.

  • Leverage your technical understanding to constructively challenge assumptions, guide recovery plans, and facilitate trade-off decisions between engineering quality and delivery speed, ensuring alignment with overall project goals.

  • Create and maintain essential documentation (such as RAID Logs, RACI matrices, business requirement documents, and Gantt charts) and lead ceremonies like standups, retrospectives, and client presentations.

  • Proactively identify risks and remove roadblocks, helping the team find the pathway to excellence that earns the admiration and respect of your clients.

  • Track progress and communicate updates to stakeholders regularly through reports and presentations. Conduct project reviews and identify areas for improvement.

  • Deliver structured, clear, and professional communication, tailoring your style to best suit each client's environment, this is pivotal to how our clients perceive Infinite Lambda.

  • Maintain a safe and congenial working environment for your team.

  • Support with client prospects - meetings, follow up and relationship management.

  • Liaise with our staffing team to ensure visibility on what will be needed to deliver projects.

  • Work with Account Manager(s) to provide constant and stable visibility on accounts.

  • Provide active coaching and mentorship to delivery teams, helping them adopt best practices, adhere to project standards, and elevate their own delivery capabilities.

Requirements

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience leading complex client projects, with a focus on data warehouse migration and/or AI.

  • Consulting background.

  • Proven background in leading and managing projects from start to finish.

  • Demonstrated business analysis experience, eliciting requirements, process mapping, and translating business needs into clear technical and functional specifications.

  • Extensive experience with agile methodologies and continuous improvement.

  • Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and data delivery principles (e.g., architectural patterns, tools, modern development practices) to effectively challenge, guide, and support technical leadership.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and people skills, able to articulate a compelling vision.

  • Experience working with fixed-cost projects as well as T&M.

  • Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the need of the client and depending on the client some travel is required.

Skills:

  • Proficiency in a variety of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello).

  • Strong business analysis toolkit: requirements gathering, process and workflow mapping, user story writing, and stakeholder workshops.

  • Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, and change management skills.

  • Ability to break down complex projects into manageable tasks and create work breakdown structures.

  • Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Familiarity and practical experience with modern methodologies and the ability to choose and adapt the most suitable ones for the project.

Mindset:

  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate the big picture while also managing the details.

  • A collaborative and positive approach to people and projects.

  • Willingness to take new directions and adapt to changing priorities.

Nice to have skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts.

  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Omni, Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI).

  • Proven experience leading data warehousing and analytics projects, preferably migrations.

Soft skills

  • Servant leadership mindset with the ability to manage, motivate, inspire and support others.

  • Outstanding communication skills.

  • A considerate, curious, positive, naturally collaborative and supportive approach to people.

  • Proactivity regarding risk, issues and planning.

  • Ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Natural problem-solving attitude, facilitation skills, and creative thinking.

  • Proficient in English; French language skills are preferred.

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

  • The benefits are plenty, with private health insurance, work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

jobs.description:
Precoro is an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for procurement centralization and automation. We help 1,000+ companies in 80+ countries cut manual work, control spend across all subsidiaries and make better purchasing decisions.

Our customer base is growing fast — and so is the cost of losing a customer. Today, every CSM evaluates customer risk in their own way, EBRs look different from one account to the next, and we don't have a shared answer to two simple questions: how much does this customer cost us, and how much value are they actually getting?

We're looking for a senior, hands-on Product Manager — Retention & Customer Value to own churn and customer value as a business metric. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success and Sales: you'll set the process, own the numbers, and make sure product decisions protect real revenue.

What makes this role exciting?

  • You own the metric, not just a backlog. Churn, GRR/NRR and time-to-value are yours. CS, Product and Sales are your levers.

  • Real money on the line. Every decision you make is tied to revenue: which customers we can save, what it takes, and what it's worth.

  • Building from zero. There's no customer scoring, standardized EBR or cost-to-serve model yet — you'll design them and make them stick.

  • Senior scope with room to grow. This is a business role with a direct path toward COO/CRO-level responsibility as the company scales.

What you'll do

Predict and prevent churn

  • Build a standardized customer scoring process — product fit and churn probability based on tracked metrics, activities and events, not individual CSM judgement.

  • Standardize customer health evaluation and set up a clear process for working with at-risk accounts.

  • Build a forecast that shows how much revenue is at risk, which actions will save how much, and what we'll lose regardless.

Make customer value measurable

  • Implement a customer ROI calculation that becomes the central point of every EBR.

  • Standardize EBRs: key questions, who we talk to on the customer side (incl. C-level), what we show and what we agree on — so Precoro sets the agenda, not the customer.

  • Shorten time-to-value, starting from onboarding and implementation.

Own the economics of each customer

  • Implement tracking of implementation cost and ongoing cost-to-serve per customer.

  • Make business decisions on it — e.g., setting limits on how much we invest in a single account.

Turn churn signals into product decisions

  • Collect all churn-affecting requests and product gaps, and drive a clear decision on each. "Won't do" becomes a tracked risk factor, not a silent no.

  • Deliver the product gaps that are business-justified and directly reduce churn risk.

Stay hands-on

  • Join customer calls, listen to EBRs, dig into the data. Processes only change when you understand what really happens on the ground.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS in a cross-team, cross-department role (Product, Customer Success, RevOps, Business Operations or similar). B2C experience alone won't be a fit.

  • Hands-on experience with ARR, churn, GRR/NRR, customer cost and unit economics — you can build the model yourself, not just read the dashboard.

  • A track record of business-critical decisions that affected revenue, with measurable results you can point to.

  • Experience changing processes across teams — especially where nobody wanted to own the problem — and making the change stick.

  • Solid understanding of how Customer Success and product development work, and how to make them speak the same language.

  • Strong critical thinking, structured communication and confidence talking to customers' C-level.

  • English at B2+ level.

Nice to have

  • Product management experience.

  • Background in iPaaS, payments infrastructure, fintech or service companies where cost-to-serve is tracked closely.

  • Experience setting up customer health scoring or EBR/QBR programs.

Why Precoro?

  • Trust and ownership: no micromanagement — we value initiative and independent decision-making.

  • Real influence: direct impact on company revenue and on how Product, CS and Sales work together.

  • Learning and development: reimbursement for professional courses, lectures and other learning opportunities.

  • Flexible working hours: we focus on results, not hours at the desk.

  • 26 days off annually

  • Health and well-being: medical insurance and unlimited sick leave without a medical certificate.

  • Pet-friendly office in Kyiv.

  • Supporting Ukraine: we assist the Armed Forces and contribute to projects that bring victory closer.

Our hiring process

  1. Recruiter interview (45 min)

  2. Interview with the hiring manager — Nataliia (60 min)

  3. Test task

  4. Final decision

Ready to turn customer value into a number everyone can act on? We'd love to hear from you

This project-based role focuses on turning detailed lesson outlines into clear, engaging slide decks and student handouts for four Psych/Soc lessons across two topic blocks: Research Methods & Social Psychology and Neuroscience & Cognition. The Curriculum Developer works independently and collaboratively with our curriculum and instructor teams to deliver high-quality, teachable materials that follow Jack Westin's template and style standards.

Research Methods & Social Psychology

    • RM.2 Stress, Identity & Society: mixed P/S topics taught through famous research experiments, with a close look at how those studies were designed

  • Manage by the numbers. Track performance against KPIs and make data-driven recommendations to optimize growth and profitability.

What you bring

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, Economics or Marketing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree,MBA or advanced scientific degree is preferred
  • 10 years of relevant experience, 12 years preferred

  • Strong financial acumen across forecasting, budgeting, pricing, margin management and business-case development
  • Exceptional interpersonal and influencing skills across cultures, disciplines and organizational levels

Job Description

About Responsive Care:

Responsive Care is a cornerstone of the company's care model, designed to meet members where they are — through digital-first, highly accessible, and thoughtfully coordinated care. Our Everyday Care APPs operate at the intersection of clinical excellence, innovation, and technology, ensuring members receive the right care at the right time, in the right way. We bridge the gap between chronic disease management and acute care needs, supporting members across various teams throughout the company.

A bit about this role:

This position represents an amazing opportunity for an Advanced Practice Provider ( NP or PA) with a big heart and entrepreneurial spirit who is passionate about chronic disease management.

EDC, an integral part of Responsive Care, is the company's centralized hub for ongoing clinical management — a model built on a collaborative, shared patient management relationship with our members' primary care providers. In this role, you will work alongside a cross-functional team to deliver innovative care across Digital and traditional platforms.

You will serve as a member of our ONE PCP team, as a prescriber of centralized prescription renewals and refills and also you will manage centralized results.

You will utilize and help improve our home-grown technology and electronic health information platform to carry out virtual visits as well as managing asynchronous prescription refills for patients.

Required skills and experience:

  • APP with three or more years working in outpatient clinical practice ideally with experience in management of hypertension, hyperlipidemia and primary and secondary prevention of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience concentrated in primary care or a subspecialty with heavy focus on hypertension and lipid management required (e.g. cardiology, nephrology, neurology, endocrinology, primary care, urgent care).

Licensure and certification

  • For Nurse Practitioners: active and in-good-standing RN and APRN licenses.

  • For Physician Assistants: an active and in-good-standing Physician Assistant license.

  • Role licensure and certification in good standing is required and the ability to get licensed in requested states within 90 days of hire date, starting at offer letter signing. You will be required to get licensed in additional states as needed. We believe in making it easy for you to focus on patient care. Devoted Health will cover all costs and provide full administrative support for obtaining and maintaining licenses in all required states.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Skilled APP with thorough understanding of cardiometabolic condition management including disease process, treatment modalities, medication management and lifestyle modification as it pertains to hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and primary care management of coronary artery disease and diabetes.

  • Comfortable working across Digital (live portal chat) and emerging AI-powered clinical tools (e.g., prescribing support and triage agents) as an active participant in testing, feedback, and iterative improvement — not just as an end user.

  • Virtual care experience is preferred along with a strong desire to continue practicing clinical nursing and performing virtual visits - you believe in the mission of bringing care to where the patient lives.

  • STARS/HEDIS measures, code clinical comorbidities, and identify clinical care gaps.

  • Experience with or strong interest in centralized results management, live digital/chat-based patient engagement, and AI-enabled clinical workflows is a plus.

  • Proficiency in English and Spanish preferred for this position.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Conduct focused and thorough assessments of patients with conditions that impact chronic health including hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease, and diabetes who are running out of medications. We expect that 40-60% of your clinical effort will be performing virtual visits.

  • Formulate accurate diagnoses and develop individualized treatment plans for patients with chronic medical conditions, including medication management, lifestyle modifications, and monitoring recommendations.

  • Manage a refill inbox for patients with chronic health conditions in accordance with established protocols and guidelines. We expect that 40-60% of your clinical effort will be spent managing a prescription refill queue.

  • Participate in centralized results management workflows, ensuring timely review, triage, and follow-up on lab and diagnostic results across the patient panel in accordance with established risk-tiering protocols.

  • Leverage Digital (live portal chat) and AI-assisted clinical tools — including agent-supported prescribing and inbox triage workflows — to improve efficiency, consistency, and safety in medication renewal, results management, and patient communication, while providing clinician feedback to help refine these tools as they evolve.

  • Identify and evaluate risk factors, comorbidities and possible contraindications for treatment.

  • Provide counseling on medication adherence, potential side effects.

  • Collaborate closely with a cross-functional care team — including PCPs, specialists, and other the company team members such as pharmacy, clinical nursing, and social work — as well as interfacing with family members and caregivers as needed to coordinate holistic care for the member, to ensure continuity of care and deliver a collaborative care plan.

  • Utilize our home grown electronic health information system for visits while also providing feedback on how to improve the interface.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient medical records, ensuring compliance with relevant legal and ethical guidelines.

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and ongoing professional development to stay current on best practices and advancements in cardiometabolic care.

  • Adhere to all relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards, including patient privacy and telehealth regulations.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Principal Software Development Engineer is a hands-on technical architect responsible for designing, building, and supporting complex ServiceNow data and integration solutions. The role ensures ServiceNow has trusted customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, configuration-item, install-base, and sold-product data required to support Enterprise and Public Sector customer-service and ticketing workflows.

This engineer translates business and architecture requirements into scalable ServiceNow data models, APIs, ingestion pipelines, and reusable integration patterns. The role works across ServiceNow, enterprise data platforms, API gateways, messaging platforms, databases, and cloud services, while providing technical leadership for data quality, integration reliability, security, and maintainability.

Location

This is a work from home position within the US.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, build, and maintain ServiceNow foundational data and integrations for customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, configuration-item, Install Base Item, and Sold Product data.
  • Govern ServiceNow CMDB- and CSDM-aligned data models, including CI classes and relationships, identification and reconciliation rules, source keys, normalization, deduplication, data quality, authoritative sources, source-to-target mappings, lineage, ownership, reconciliation, and sustainable target-state interfaces.
  • Build scalable inbound, outbound, and bi-directional integrations using Scripted REST APIs, REST Messages, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, Data Sources, Import Sets, Transform Maps, IRE APIs, JDBC, JSON, and scheduled or event-driven processing. Connect ServiceNow and external ServiceNow instances with Palantir Foundry, Data Hubs/Databricks, Apigee, Kafka, databases, inventory platforms, and other enterprise systems through secure, reusable patterns.
  • Use complex SQL across enterprise systems and data platforms to profile data, identify authoritative records and relationships, verify completeness and quality, find duplicates and gaps, and determine foundational data for ServiceNow. Review production data flows and large data sets for record counts, duplicates, completeness, mappings, performance, pagination, batching, timeouts, and incremental-load behavior.
  • Design and maintain ServiceNow eBonding and B2B integrations, including ticket or case synchronization, correlation identifiers, field and choice mappings, comments, attachments, priorities, authentication, customer onboarding, UAT, cutover, and production support. Develop secure API and connectivity patterns using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, client credentials, Application Registries, role-based service accounts, secrets management, firewall rules, and access governance.
  • Establish integration observability, persistent processing records, error handling, retries, replay and recovery, dashboards, runbooks, and support procedures. Lead root-cause analysis of complex issues across ServiceNow, APIs, MID Servers, data platforms, databases, authentication, networks, and upstream or downstream systems.
  • Provide technical leadership through architecture decisions, design and code reviews, production-readiness assessments, mentoring, stakeholder workshops, solution documentation, and hands-on delivery of the most complex work. Ensure development, test, and production solutions meet enterprise security, data governance, compliance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability standards.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 10+ years in software engineering, enterprise integration, data engineering, or solution architecture, including 7+ years delivering advanced ServiceNow development and integrations. Hands-on expertise in server-side JavaScript, Script Includes, Business Rules, scoped applications, RESTMessageV2, Scripted REST APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, Import Sets, Transform Maps, debugging, logging, and production support.
  • In-depth ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM expertise: CI modeling and relationships; Identification Rules; the Identification and Reconciliation Engine; reconciliation, deduplication, and data-quality governance. Experience modeling and integrating customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, inventory, Install Base Item, and Sold Product data for CSM, ITSM, and customer-facing workflows.
  • Integration expertise in REST, JSON, JDBC, pub/sub and queueing patterns, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, API gateways such as Apigee, Kafka, secrets management, and secure service-account design.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms and pipelines, including Palantir Foundry, Data Hubs, Databricks, SQL databases, ETL/ELT, source-to-target mapping, validation, reconciliation, and lineage.
  • Advanced SQL skills include complex joins, aggregations, common table expressions, window functions, data profiling, reconciliation, duplicate detection, and large-data-set analysis for ServiceNow foundational-data decisions.
  • Success developing resilient, high-volume integrations using pagination, throttling, batching, retries, resumability, observability, and performance optimization.
  • Experience delivering ServiceNow-to-ServiceNow or external-platform eBonding and customer onboarding, as well as field-mapping workshops, UAT, go-live, and production support.
  • Ability to assess architectural risks before implementation and build reusable frameworks rather than one-off integrations.
  • Strong production troubleshooting, technical documentation, mentoring, cross-functional leadership, and communication skills.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain applicable Public Trust suitability and authorized access for assigned GSA, USDA, USPS, DOI, or other Public Sector environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ServiceNow Customer Service Management, IT Service Management, Service Bridge or ShareLogic Unifi, and telecommunications customer or service data.
    Experience delivering ServiceNow data and integration solutions in FedRAMP-authorized or other regulated environments.

jobs.excerpt: Location:Remote – Washington, DC region preferred Application Closing Date: Open Until Filled Anticipated Start Date: January/February 2027 ABOUT US Pheasants Forever and Quail Forever make up the nation's largest nonprofit organization dedicated to upland habitat conservation.
jobs.description:
Location:Remote – Washington, DC region preferred
Application Closing Date: Open Until Filled
Anticipated Start Date: January/February 2027

ABOUT US
Pheasants Forever and Quail Forever make up the nation's largest nonprofit organization dedicated to upland habitat conservation. This community of more than 500,000 hunters and conservationists is dedicated to the protection of our uplands through habitat improvement, public access, education, and advocacy. A network of 754 local chapters spread across North America determine how 100 percent of their locally raised funds are spent—the only national conservation organization that operates through this grassroots structure. Since its creation in 1982, the organization has dedicated more than $1 billion to 580,000 habitat projects benefiting 31 million acres. Our Government Affairs team advances pragmatic, bipartisan policy solutions that support wildlife, strengthen rural communities, and improve hunting access and opportunity for sportsmen and sportswomen.

POSITION SUMMARY
Pheasants Forever and Quail Forever seek a motivated and detail-oriented Government Affairs Intern to join our team between January and May. This internship is ideal for a college, post-college, or graduate student in government affairs, public policy, law, environmental studies, natural resources, agriculture, or a related field who is looking to gain hands-on experience navigating both federal and state conservation policy.

The intern will support the organization’s advocacy on issues such as the federal farm bill, public lands management, state agency conservation funding, hunting regulations, and policy frameworks linked to nonprofit fundraising. This role may also support policy communications, member-driven grassroots engagement, and volunteer coordination. The position is remote and pays up to $20 per hour, depending on experience, with potential opportunities for in-person meetings and other activities if located in the Washington, DC area.

Responsibilities:
Policy & Legislative Research
  • Track and analyze federal and state legislation relevant to wildlife habitat, agricultural conservation, public lands management, hunting regulations, and related issues.
  • Prepare policy briefs, backgrounders, hearing summaries, and internal memos.
Advocacy & Communications
  • Draft policy-focused content, including blog posts, social media copy, talking points, and press releases.
  • Assist with the creation of action alerts, fact sheets, and materials for lawmakers, conservation partners, staff, and volunteers.
  • Help maintain clear, consistent messaging rooted in PF & QF’s mission and values.
Grassroots Engagement & Volunteer Support
  • Support coordination with volunteers and chapter leaders on advocacy campaigns.
  • Help manage communication lists, outreach tools, and volunteer participation tracking.
Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Work closely with conservation, development, and communications staff to align policy and fundraising priorities.
  • Support PF & QF’s annual Washington, DC fly-in (scheduled for May 2027), including assisting with scheduling and attending meetings with lawmakers, preparing materials and talking points, and managing event logistics.
  • Participate in internal strategy calls, briefings, and partner meetings as appropriate.
Qualifications and Experience:
  • A passion for Pheasants Forever and Quail Forever’s mission, as well as knowledge and appreciation of conservation, hunting, and the outdoors.
  • College, post-college, or graduate coursework or experience in public policy, government affairs, law, environmental/natural resources management, agriculture, or related fields. Familiarity with conservation, agriculture, wildlife, or rural community issues is a plus.
  • Strong research, writing, and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex policy issues into clear and engaging communications.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Word, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Comfort working with volunteers and grassroots networks.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and able to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Commitment to bipartisan, science-based conservation policy.
Compensation, Schedule, and Location:
  • Up to $20/hour, depending on experience.
  • Part-time schedule averaging 10–20 hours per week (flexible with academic commitments).
  • Remote; occasional in-person opportunities may be available if located near Washington, DC.
To Apply: Please combine your cover letter, resume and three references into a single Word document or PDF file before uploading to your application on our recruitment website at www.pheasantsforever.org/about-us/careers.

As an Automation QA Enginer at SkyCell, you'll shape how our team thinks about quality, working alongside developers and the design system team to catch problems early so everyone ships with confidence. Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

  • Shape the test strategy with the team and advise on quality at every stage, from requirements to release

  • Help write requirements and testable acceptance criteria, including for new UI components with the design system team

  • Build and maintain automation frameworks, test suites and shared libraries in Playwright, plus test data tools in JavaScript / Node.js

  • Test REST and GraphQL APIs (functional, contract and negative tests), covering authentication, error handling and data integrity. Set up contract testing (e.g., Pact) and check how services communicate through queues, webhooks and events

  • Test our shared UI component library for visual regression, accessibility and cross-browser behaviour. Write unit and integration tests (Storybook, Testing Library) and make sure new releases don't break the apps that use them

  • Track and share quality metrics (coverage, pass rate, flakiness, build time) and keep test documentation, including Gherkin test cases, up to date

  • Mentor teammates earlier in their careers and share QA best practices across the team

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks, ideally with Playwright and JavaScript / Node.js

  • Experience testing REST/GraphQL APIs, including OAuth/JWT authentication, contract testing and SQL checks on database side effects

  • Experience testing shared UI components with Testing Library, Storybook or Vitest/Jest

  • Experience keeping CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) reliable and tackling flaky tests

  • Clear communication, curiosity about root causes, and strong written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Visual regression and accessibility testing experience

  • Performance testing with k6, Artillery or JMeter

  • Experience mentoring others

If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience, we'd still like to hear from you.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

This position requires a dynamic leader who will proactively collaborate with business unit attorneys and business executives at the highest levels across the enterprise to drive innovation while adeptly managing risk within the highly regulated healthcare industry.

  • Innovate and Drive Change. Leverage deep knowledge and experience in cybersecurity, risk management and regulatory frameworks (including experience with HIPAA and NIST), and various emerging technology laws and regulations to deliver actionable, risk-based guidance to the enterprise.

  • Lead and execute. Ability to execute enterprise-level cybersecurity initiatives by addressing novel and complex legal issues, serving as a key leader on project teams, and ensuring accountability.
  • Integrate and Align Cybersecurity Strategies. Integrate and harmonize business unit cybersecurity priorities with the enterprise cybersecurity strategy to provide solution-oriented and risk-based guidance.

  • Monitor and Adapt to Evolving Laws. Stay abreast of evolving laws, regulations, and industry best practices to guide the enterprise through evolving requirements and external influencing strategies

  • 5+ years of specialized experience in cybersecurity, privacy, and/or technology law
  • Member of a U.S. state bar in good standing

Critical Skills

  • Experience advising both business and legal leaders on complex legal, regulatory, and policy questions in the areas of cybersecurity strategy and enablement, emerging technology law, and data governance.
  • In-depth expertise on HIPAA and other healthcare laws with an emphasis on cybersecurity and strategy. Detailed knowledge of global cybersecurity standards, frameworks, risk assessments, and certification processes including, for example, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, HIPAA Security Rule, HITRUST, CMMC, SOX cyber controls, SOC1 and SOC2.
  • Experience conducting privacy, cybersecurity, and technology-focused legal reviews of new or existing technology, services, and product offering with the ability to quickly learn (often self-teaching) technical concepts.
  • Advanced knowledge of trends and issues applicable to privacy, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and emerging technology arenas. This includes but is not limited to knowledge of such concepts as Incident Response, NIST CSF, and Security Risk Assessments.
  • Possess well-developed insights on emerging technology to include AI/machine learning, generative AI, and data privacy-enhancing technologies such as synthetic data, tokenization, and anonymization/de-identification.
  • Experience leading and/or supporting the development of strategic data governance frameworks and their associated rollouts across a complex enterprise with various and diverse sub-business organizations.
  • Ability to monitor and evaluate evolving laws, regulations, and industry best practices to help the enterprise navigate new requirements against both existing and anticipated business models.   • Capable of handling significant legal issues, disputes, or transactions at the highest level. Experience managing outside counsel, as necessary.

Additional Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience counseling major corporations in the healthcare industry on cybersecurity initiatives, with the ability to cultivate and maintain robust existing relationships with industry stakeholders.

G2i is recruiting a Senior Full Stack Developer for Moonberg, a Zug-based intelligence lab building proprietary market intelligence and infrastructure for decentralized markets.

As Biogen's Head of AI Cybersecurity Engineering, you will be the senior-most technical and strategic leader responsible for all Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning security engineering at Biogen. The Enterprise Sales Executive leads complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple client stakeholders, including Operations, Information Technology, Procurement, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, Business Continuity, and Finance. The successful candidate will build a strong national pipeline, develop relationships with executive-level decision makers, and position Mail-Gard as a trusted business continuity partner for critical customer communications.

This role requires disciplined prospecting and account planning, accurate forecasting, CRM rigor, and effective collaboration across IWCO’s commercial and operational teams.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.

The Director, Technology Governance and Compliance leads and matures Enlyte’s technology governance, risk management, and compliance practices, ensuring technology and AI initiatives meet regulatory, contractual, and internal policy requirements and that risks are identified, assessed, and managed consistently.

This role partners closely with the AI Center of Excellence, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Privacy, Internal Audit, business stakeholders, and corporate leadership. A significant portion of the work supports risk and compliance oversight of Enlyte’s AI initiatives, alongside broader technology audit support, control frameworks, selected policy governance, and regulatory readiness.

The ideal candidate brings strong executive presence, experience leading large technology portfolios or programs, comfort advising senior leaders on GRC matters, and a demonstrated ability to leverage AI in their own work to make governance processes more efficient and easier for stakeholders to follow. The role begins as a senior individual contributor.

Core Responsibilities:

AI Risk & Compliance

  • AI Risk Assessment: Lead risk and compliance review of AI use cases (e.g., RAIDIATE assessments), including risk classification, control requirements, and approval recommendations, in partnership with the AI Center of Excellence.
  • Responsible AI Controls: Translate responsible AI principles and emerging regulations (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act, state AI laws) into practical controls and evidence requirements.
  • AI Governance Committee Operations: Manage the operations of the AI Governance Committee, including coordination, preparing presenters, collecting and distributing materials, documenting decision records, and follow-up on risk treatment.
  • AI Vendor & Contract Risk: Assess security, privacy, and AI-specific terms and risks for third-party AI tools and vendors.

Technology Governance & Compliance

  • Audit Support: Assist with internal, external, and client technology audits, including evidence collection, coordination of findings responses, and remediation tracking.
  • Control Framework Oversight: Provide oversight to ensure control owners maintain and test technology controls mapped to applicable frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOX ITGC).
  • Policy Governance: Own the lifecycle of assigned technology and AI policies and standards, including reviews, exceptions, and attestations.
  • Risk Identification & Remediation: Identify and escalate technology and AI risks into the technology risk management program and drive remediation with accountable owners.
  • Regulatory & Client Obligations: Partner with Legal to track regulatory changes and client contractual requirements and translate them into controls and operating procedures.
  • GRC Reporting & Executive Engagement: Deliver risk posture, control health, audit status, and compliance metrics to corporate leadership and governance committees, presenting clear risk positions and recommendations.
  • AI-Enabled GRC: Leverage AI tools to modernize GRC work, automating evidence collection, accelerating assessments, drafting documentation, and simplifying intake, review, and approval for stakeholders.
  • Program Scaling: Build the operating model and tooling for a scalable governance and compliance function.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Professional Experience: 8+ years in technology risk, IT audit, compliance, or GRC roles, including 3+ years leading programs or engaging directly with senior leadership.
  • Portfolio & Program Leadership: Experience leading large technology portfolios or programs, including planning, prioritization, cross-functional execution, and executive reporting.
  • Matrixed Influence: Proven ability to drive alignment across business, technical, legal, compliance, privacy, security, and finance stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Regulated Industry Knowledge: Experience in insurance, healthcare, financial services, or another regulated industry preferred.
  • Team Scaling: Experience developing operating models, role definitions, or hiring plans for new organizational capabilities preferred


Technical Requirements

  • GRC Expertise: Hands-on experience supporting technology audits, testing controls, and managing risk registers and policy programs.
  • AI Risk Framework Fluency: Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act concepts, or similar models, and how AI risks differ from traditional technology risks.
  • AI/ML Lifecycle Understanding: Working knowledge of the AI/ML lifecycle sufficient to assess risk, human oversight, and monitoring controls (not a delivery or model-development role).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated use of AI tools in their own work to improve efficiency and the stakeholder experience.
  • GRC Tooling: Experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow IRM/GRC, OneTrust, or similar.
  • Certifications: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CIPP, or AIGP preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree preferred.

Executive Competencies

  • Executive Presence: Confident and credible with corporate leadership; able to present risk positions, navigate pushback, and influence decisions.
  • Risk Judgment: Ability to translate legal, regulatory, and responsible AI expectations into proportionate, practical controls.
  • Strategic Communication: Ability to synthesize complex risk and compliance matters into clear executive narratives.
  • AI-Forward Mindset: Uses AI to work smarter and to make governance easier for others, not just faster for themselves.
  • Enterprise Partnership: Collaborative partner to the AI Center of Excellence, Legal, and business units rather than a gatekeeper.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure, and personally executing foundational work before a larger team is in place.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Position Title

Audit Manager Sr.

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Senior Audit Manager is a critical leader within the Internal Audit Department engaging with key stakeholders across the enterprise while managing audit activities across the department. This role drives the development and execution of a comprehensive assurance plan for their area of responsibility and collaborates across the department to ensure the overall Audit Plan is achieved.

The Senior Audit Manager serves as the "Auditor in Charge" AIC responsible for ensuring an audit is completed in a timely fashion and high quality. Ensures that internal controls are in compliance with policies, procedures, and agency regulatory and legal guidelines, while providing oversight and leadership to multiple ongoing audits.  

Responsible for developing and maintaining positive relationships with auditees, coordinating with Flagstar Internal Audit leadership and staff; exercising professional auditor judgment, ensuring quality in compliance with regulatory and Institute of Internal Auditors professional guidance (the IPPF), and maintains objectivity and independence in forming audit conclusions and reports. This leader may directly manage a team and/or indirectly oversee the work of other teammembers.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Specifically responsible for the following for:

  • Determining scoping decisions, testing approaches, conclusions, and audit workpapers across the audit lifecycle (planning, fieldwork, reporting, issue validation).
  • Drafting Audit Opinions and Reports.
  • Drafting and reviewing MR(I)A workpapers.
  • Completing required training.
  • Completing Skills Assessments.
  • Mentoring new auditors.
  • Responsible for communicating with audit management and audit clients about the engagement. Leading the audit team to ensure field work and workpapers are completed in a timely manner.

  • Maintains relationship with the audit client and audit management to ensure clear communication. May attend steering committees, and working groups, as applicable/necessary.

QA & Data Validation Engineer

Optiveum is looking for a hands-on QA & Data Validation Engineer for a long-term, engaging project. The cooperation is based on a B2B contract directly with Optiveum.

The Client You will be working for a US-based technology company that builds a live consumer platform connecting communities through video, audio, text, and photos. Alongside this, they are developing an emerging AI business that helps brands understand public conversations through transcription, media analysis, topic and entity detection, and sentiment analysis.

The Role This is a hands-on quality role combining strong manual testing with data investigation. Your main focus will be the accuracy of the AI media-analysis product: its processing, enrichment and outputs. You will also do functional testing across the company's products, including the consumer platform. You will work closely with founders, product and engineering to find problems early, make useful checks repeatable, and support informed release decisions. We are looking for someone comfortable in a dynamic startup environment who can turn an unclear issue into evidence and a recommended next step.

What you will do

  • Test complete user journeys across mobile, web and APIs. Use exploratory and structured manual testing to uncover broken flows, edge cases, confusing states and regression risks.

  • Trace data from source media through processing and APIs to customer-facing results. Check completeness, accuracy, consistency, freshness and duplicates, and confirm records belong to the correct user or workspace.

  • Validate transcripts, extracted topics and entities, sentiment and other AI-assisted outputs against source material and agreed evaluation criteria. Separate clear defects from subjective judgments and record uncertainty.

  • Verify enrichment accuracy: confirm that added attributes and external data match the correct person, organization or source record. Investigate ambiguous matches, stale values, missing fields and conflicting sources.

  • Validate timestamps across the workflow (publication times, processing times, transcript and media offsets), including units, time zones, ordering and alignment with the original content.

  • Use SQL, API responses, logs and small scripts to investigate mismatches. Help engineering tell input issues, processing failures, model limitations and display defects apart.

  • Build and maintain reliable automated checks for repeatable functional and data risks, choosing the right layer: UI, API, integration or data.

  • Write actionable defect reports with expected vs. actual behavior, reproduction steps, affected records and evidence. Verify fixes and explain release risks clearly.

  • Develop reusable test data, reference examples and regression checks. Help define acceptance criteria early and decide what to test first when time is limited.

Expectations

  • Ideally 4–6 years of experience in software QA, including at least 2 years of hands-on data validation using SQL (comparing source and target data, investigating missing, duplicated or incorrect records).

  • Strong manual functional and exploratory testing experience on software used by real customers. You can build a focused test approach from incomplete requirements and explain which risks matter most.

  • Hands-on data validation skills. You can query records, compare source and destination data, check enrichment matches and timestamps, and investigate missing, duplicated or incorrect outputs.

  • Working familiarity with test automation or scripting, and an interest in developing it further. Experience debugging API tests, browser tests or validation scripts is valuable.

  • Comfort with APIs, JSON, browser developer tools, logs and basic software delivery workflows. You can read enough code to investigate a failure and work effectively with engineers.

  • Thoughtful use of AI to expand test ideas, generate synthetic data and draft checks. You verify AI-generated assertions against source evidence and know where human review is needed.

  • A curious, methodical approach, ownership and the ability to prioritize with limited time.

  • Ability to collaborate across time zones and communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in live conversations.

  • Nice to have: experience with media processing, consumer social or creator products, analytics, data pipelines or AI evaluation. Familiarity with Playwright, Cypress, pytest or API testing tools (equivalent practical experience counts).

What is offered

  • Salary: 25–28 USD net/h.

  • Contract: B2B directly with Optiveum.

  • Start: ASAP, long-term project.

  • Type of work: 100% Remote (Candidates must be based in Poland).

  • Working hours: Full-time, with dependable overlap for collaboration with the US East Coast team.

Recruitment Process Our recruitment process is straightforward and consists of two stages:

  1. A take-home assignment to showcase your testing approach and data investigation skills.

  2. A final interview with the CEO.
