jobs.description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, AI-forward software development leader to lead R&D at Gallery Systems, the trusted partner for the world's most respected museums, galleries, archives, universities, and private collections.

Job Description:

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced, AI-forward software development leader to lead R&D at Gallery Systems, the trusted partner for the world's most respected museums, galleries, archives, universities, and private collections.


For 40+ years, Gallery Systems has been indispensable to the world's finest cultural institutions, enabling registrars, curators, conservators, and collections professionals to preserve, steward, and share the irreplaceable artifacts in their care. Through the TMS Suite (TMS Collections, eMuseum, and our conservation documentation and digital asset management solutions) and our Art Business products for galleries and the art market, we serve hundreds of institutions across the globe.


Job Details


The Opportunity:

The priority will be to build a modern, AI-native software development organization that delivers reliable, high-quality products to the collections professionals we serve. You will lead the entire development team and own engineering strategy, architecture, delivery, quality, and the security of our code. Gallery Systems is committed to moving from AI-assisted to AI-directed development, where people set direction and AI agents generate code, execute tests, and perform deployments. You will lead that shift quickly and keep raising the bar from there.


You will modernize development practices, tooling, and culture. Keeping the needs of collections professionals at the center of every decision, you will be fully accountable for how Gallery Systems builds and delivers software.


A Day in the Life:

Leadership

  • Lead and develop developers, team leads, and managers across all product development teams
  • Create an open, curious environment where people take ownership, raise problems early, and keep learning
  • Design team structure, roles, and career paths for an AI-native organization, including how roles change as AI agents take on more of the work
  • Build structured upskilling so every developer becomes proficient in AI-assisted and AI-delegated development
  • Give clear expectations and direct feedback, and address performance issues promptly

AI-Native Software Development

  • Define how Gallery Systems builds software with AI, including spec-driven development, coding agents, AI-generated tests, AI-assisted code review, and automated deployment
  • Evaluate, select, and govern AI development tools, and track their cost and return
  • Set guardrails for human ownership, review, code provenance, intellectual property, and secure handling of customer data in AI workflows, keeping AI tools and agents within our FedRAMP and ISO 27001 compliance boundaries
  • Measure AI adoption and its effect on speed and quality, and report progress
  • Stay current with a fast-moving field and decide quickly which new practices to adopt

Delivery & Quality

  • Establish modern engineering practices, including source control discipline, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and documentation
  • Manage delivery with data, using DORA metrics, cycle time, and defect rates, with work traceable from request to release
  • Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews in partnership with our Hosting, Security, and Customer Care teams.
  • Deliver releases predictably, on committed dates
  • Deliver continuous, automated releases on a single supported version
  • Run secure development and change management that meet our FedRAMP and ISO 27001 obligations, and produce the evidence our audits require

Technical Direction

  • Own the architecture and technical strategy for the product portfolio, including the move from desktop and on-premises software to modern web-based, cloud-hosted platforms, including moving hosted customers to a containerized, multi-tenant cloud platform
  • Build security and scalability into the development lifecycle, partnering with IT/Security and Hosting
  • Manage technical debt deliberately and make the tradeoffs visible to leadership
  • Lead the technical side of AI capabilities in our products, including model selection, evaluation, monitoring, and cost management

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with the Director of Product Management to turn strategy into a realistic roadmap and match R&D capacity to priorities
  • Support Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Care with technical expertise for key customers, integrations, and escalations
  • Serve as the technical owner for major platform programs, including work with external implementation partners, and own acceptance of their deliverables
  • Represent R&D on the leadership team and, when needed, with customers, user groups, and the Volaris portfolio

Financial Management

  • Own the R&D budget, headcount plan, and tooling and vendor spend
  • Review R&D costs, capacity, and productivity with the General Manager and leadership team


What You Will Bring to the Table:

  • 10+ years in software development, including 5+ years leading development teams and experience leading managers or team leads
  • A track record of modernizing a software development organization, with measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and team capability
  • Hands-on, current experience with AI-native development, including coding agents and AI-assisted tools (such as Claude Code or Kiro), spec-driven or agentic workflows, and rolling them out across a team with clear governance
  • Deep knowledge of modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability, and incident management
  • Experience building and running B2B SaaS on a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), including containerized, multi-tenant architectures and PostgreSQL, including moving legacy desktop or on-premises products to the web
  • Experience delivering software in regulated or certified environments, such as FedRAMP, ISO 27001, or SOC 2
  • Experience building AI features into products, including evaluation and monitoring, and working with model APIs and gateways such as OpenRouter
  • Prior experience in museum, cultural heritage, archive, library, or other vertical software is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Key Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong technical leadership skills
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills, with the ability to bring long-tenured teams through significant change
  • Sound judgment on secure development, data privacy, and the risks specific to AI-generated code
  • Data-driven decision making, using delivery and quality metrics such as DORA
  • Strong communication skills, verbal and written, with developers, executives, and customers
  • Strong teamwork skills for cross-group cooperation
  • Ability to perform under pressure
  • Open-minded and curious, with an appetite for applying AI and new technologies to how we build software
  • Experience leading distributed teams across North American and European time zones


Travel:

  • Travel is required, approximately 10-15%
  • Must have required documents to travel within North America and globally

Gallery Systems has developed collections management solutions for the finest cultural institutions throughout the world for more than 40 years. We are dedicated to helping our clients constantly improve the way they manage and share their collections with their communities. Our solutions, services, and staff embody our core values of honesty, respect, collaboration, continuous improvement, and passion for helping the people who manage the world's cultural heritage.

We are a progressive company, full of talented, bright, and self-directed people. We offer a quiet, collaborative work environment where creativity, teamwork, and a commitment to excellence are highly valued. Some of the benefits we offer include vacation, comprehensive health coverage, dental coverage, vision coverage, company 401(k) plan, and a casual dress code.

If you're ready to work hard and take your career to the next level, we're excited to meet you.

Job Title: Regional Marketing Manager, I/II (East) – Migraine (Remote)

Job Location: Florham Park, NJ

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:


Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn,Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

This position will support Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, West Virginia, portions of Pennsylvania and Virginia, and Washington, D.C. The role may be hired at either Grade 18 or Grade 19, with the final grade determined by the candidate’s experience.

The Regional Marketing Manager (RMM) reports to the Associate Director, Migraine Marketing Customer Engagement and Regional Marketing Manager Team Lead. The Regional Marketing Manager is responsible for strategically engaging with key experts (EEs) in the Migraine space, building relationships and gathering insights to inform business decisions and improve patient care. The RMM is also responsible for pulling through the national marketing strategy at the regional level, supporting key programs like peer-to-peer education, and partners closely with their regions to drive business results. The RMM team is a key part of the HCP Marketing Team, and this role is ideal for an individual looking to grow their marketing skillset while regularly liaising with key experts as well as the salesforce.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain accountability for interactions and feedback with key EEs. Must be able to interact effectively with national and regional EEs and be able to confidently represent AbbVie’s interests while searching for solutions that ultimately improve patient care. Must identify emerging EEs, both physicians and mid-levels, to expand the AbbVie footprint in the Psychiatry space.
  • Responsible for engagement with EEs and attendance at the key medical congresses. Supports identification and coordination of Commercial leadership engagements at key conferences.
  • Provides in-depth insights based on assimilation of key stakeholder feedback.
  • Responsible for specific geographical areas of the country, understanding market drivers, competitive landscape, and provider dynamics. Translate local area business needs into local strategies while aligning to the national marketing plan. Supports the field with resource maximization, local congress identification and innovative regional speaker programs. Partners closely with salesforce leadership to identify and communicate opportunities and presents business plans to sales leadership 2x/year.
  • Continually evaluate and apply knowledge of the effectiveness and efficiency of key tactics. Effectively manage projects to deliver high-quality work in a timely fashion. Ensure that regulatory and compliance guidelines are followed.
  • May be responsible for leading key team workstreams such as team compliance lead, ad board support, insight dissemination to the IBT, national congress lead support, speaker budget lead etc.
  • Maintains understanding of disease and competitive marketplace.
  • Operates in compliance with all AbbVie internal policies (ethics, environmental health and safety, financial, human resources, and general business policies) and applicable external regulatory requirements.
  • Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Science or related field.
  • Advanced degree or previous sales/marketing experience required. MBA preferred.
  • Knowledge of applicable regulations and standards affecting Pharmaceutical Products.
  • Minimum 5 years of sales or marketing pharmaceutical experience including clinical liaison, sales training, marketing, Sr. Account Executive or District Manager experience.
  • Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements
  • Ability to travel adequately to cover territory, as well as overnight attendance at scheduled training events and sales meetings

Additional Information

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​
  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​
  • This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.​

jobs.title: Expert(e) Tracking & Attribution - Freelance
jobs.excerpt: Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language.
jobs.description:
Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Date de démarrage

  • ASAP - recrutement urgent

  • Disponibilité au plus tard en janvier 2027, pour accompagner le lancement de nos nouveaux canaux d'acquisition

🏡 Type de contrat

  • Freelance - mission d'environ 6 mois, durée affinée ensemble à l'issue de ton audit

  • Temps partiel : 2 à 3 jours par semaine (ajustable selon ta disponibilité et la roadmap)

  • Séniorité : Confirmé(e) à Senior

🌍 Localisation

  • 100% Remote (Europe)

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio qui opère une dizaine de produits SaaS par abonnement à grande échelle. L'acquisition payante est au cœur de notre croissance, et nous l'opérons sur un nombre de canaux qui ne cesse d'augmenter : Google, Microsoft, Meta, TikTok, OpenAI Ads aujourd'hui, puis Snapchat, Reddit et d'autres à partir de janvier 2027.

Notre tracking est déjà passé en server-side, via PostHog. Le nouveau défi, c'est l'attribution : chaque plateforme revendique la conversion, si bien que la somme des conversions côté plateformes dépasse les trials et le chiffre d'affaires réellement observés. Résultat : il est difficile de dire quel canal crée vraiment des abonné(e)s payant(e)s, et les algorithmes d'enchères optimisent sur des signaux incomplets.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) Expert(e) Tracking & Attribution pour devenir l'owner de notre couche de mesure, de bout en bout : que chaque euro investi sur nos ~10 produits et 6+ canaux soit mesuré, renvoyé proprement aux plateformes et lisible en un seul endroit. La mission suit trois temps : audit de l'existant, setup, puis documentation et transmission pour que nos équipes Acquisition et Tech soient pleinement autonomes après ton départ.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu seras rattaché(e) directement à Bastien BRICOUT, notre CMO, qui pilote la stratégie d'acquisition. Au quotidien, tu travailleras avec les media buyers en charge de chaque canal et de chaque produit, ainsi qu'avec l'équipe Tech & Produit pour les déploiements techniques (PostHog, intégrations côté produit). L'équipe est full remote, orientée data et performance, avec une culture de l'autonomie et du résultat.

📂 Tes responsabilités

Audit & roadmap

  • Auditer l'infrastructure de tracking existante sur l'ensemble des produits et des canaux

  • Identifier les écarts, doublons et points de fuite entre plateformes, PostHog et billing

  • Proposer une roadmap et une timeline priorisées (produits et canaux qui pèsent le plus en budget d'abord)

Plan de taggage & server-side

  • Définir une taxonomie d'événements commune à tous les produits (visit, signup, trial, paid, renewal, refund, churn)

  • Déployer et fiabiliser le server-side sur les canaux actuels (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, TikTok Events API) et préparer le socle pour les nouveaux canaux

  • Mettre en place les offline conversions et la remontée de la valeur de conversion, en appui de notre migration tCPA → tROAS

Attribution & incrementality

  • Construire un modèle d'attribution réconcilié entre PostHog, les plateformes ads et le billing (Stripe, Recurly)

  • Couvrir l'attribution des canaux affiliation et influence (codes promo, S2S)

  • Concevoir les premiers tests d'incrementality (geo-holdout, lift), puis un MMM léger quand le volume le permet

Consent, privacy & monitoring

  • Gérer Consent Mode v2, RGPD et ATT iOS, et modéliser la part de signal perdue par marché

  • Mettre en place des alertes de rupture de tracking et un audit mensuel des écarts

Documentation & transmission

  • Documenter l'ensemble du setup (taxonomie, architecture, runbooks, monitoring) pour que l'équipe puisse le maintenir, le reproduire sur un nouveau projet ou le faire évoluer

  • Expliquer aux media buyers ce que chaque changement de signal implique sur leurs stratégies d'enchères

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • Séniorité : Confirmé(e) à Senior

  • 5 ans minimum d'expérience en tracking / martech

  • Au moins une expérience en environnement abonnement (SaaS ou app) avec un parcours trial → paid

  • Idéalement, une expérience multi-produits ou en agence

Compétences techniques

  • Server-side tracking en production, indispensable : sGTM ou pipeline S2S custom, Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, TikTok Events API

  • JavaScript / TypeScript et SQL courants, à l'aise avec les API et les webhooks

  • Déduplication pixel / serveur, offline conversions, valeur de conversion et impact sur les stratégies d'enchères

  • Consent Mode v2, RGPD, ATT iOS : tu sais ce qui est perdu et comment le modéliser

  • Atouts appréciés : PostHog, tests d'incrementality (geo-holdout, lift), notions de MMM (Robyn, Meridian), postbacks et MMP mobile

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Profil d'ingénieur(e) marketing qui code et qui comprend le business : tu implémentes toi-même, puis tu expliques l'impact à des interlocuteur(rice)s non techniques

  • Pédagogie et clarté, notamment auprès des media buyers

  • Grande autonomie et aisance en full remote et en communication asynchrone

  • Rigueur et sens de la documentation : tu construis pour que le dispositif tienne sans toi

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

✅ Les avantages du poste

  • Une mission à fort impact sur un périmètre clair : poser les fondations de la mesure d'un groupe de ~10 produits SaaS par abonnement, avec un avant / après visible

  • Un rôle d'owner : tu définis l'architecture et la méthode, avec une vraie latitude sur tes choix

  • Un interlocuteur direct, le CMO, sans bureaucratie et avec des décisions rapides

  • Une stack moderne : PostHog, Stripe, Recurly, dashboard interne, et de nombreux canaux d'acquisition à structurer

👣 Les défis du poste

  • Un périmètre large pour un temps partiel (10 produits x 6+ canaux) : savoir prioriser fera toute la différence

  • Un héritage à harmoniser : des pixels et logiques de conversion hétérogènes à remettre à plat avant d'optimiser

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  • Étude de cas à préparer chez toi, puis à présenter à notre CMO Bastien et à un membre de l'équipe Acquisition ou Tech.

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche

Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante

Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Network Architect to join our Core Architecture team.

In this senior individual-contributor role, you will shape the architecture of global interconnection services and infrastructure. You will work closely with Principal Architects and partner with Product, Operations Engineering, and other technical teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and operationally effective solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop high-level architectures and detailed designs for global interconnection services and infrastructure.
  • Lead assigned initiatives from initial direction through design, validation, and operational handover.
  • Define how new capabilities will integrate with the existing global network and interconnection platform.
  • Work closely with Principal Architects to review technical direction, challenge assumptions, and align solutions with architectural principles.
  • Translate architectural concepts into implementable designs covering network connectivity, devices, protocols, configurations, dependencies, and bills of materials, supported by clear technical documentation.
  • Evaluate design options based on scalability, resilience, operational complexity, automation, cost, and business value.
  • Ensure network architectures support automation, repeatable implementation, testability, maintainability, and effective operations.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews for assigned initiatives, using validation results to refine proposed solutions.
  • Partner with Product teams to translate business requirements and customer use cases into network capabilities.
  • Work with Operations Engineering to ensure designs can be implemented and operated effectively on a global scale.
  • Provide architectural guidance on network hardware, network operating systems, protocols, and technology choices.
  • Contribute to architectural standards and reusable design approaches, identifying opportunities to simplify the network and address technical debt.
  • Provide architectural expertise during critical and complex network escalations.

Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in network architecture and design within complex, large-scale production environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of routing and switching across service providers, interconnection, or data-center networks.
  • Deep knowledge of IPv4/IPv6 networking, BGP, MPLS, and Segment-Routing, with strong knowledge of routing protocols such as IS-IS and OSPF.
  • Knowledge of MPLS services: EVPN (E-LINE, E-LAN), L3VPN
  • Knowledge of VXLAN, modern data-center network topologies, and Clos architectures, including when to apply them.
  • Experience designing solutions in complex, multi-vendor environments.
  • Understanding network automation, APIs, control systems, relevant software development, lifecycle practices, and maintainable, production-ready solutions.
  • Ability to assess solutions from a system-level perspective, considering hardware, software, automation, and operational dependencies.
  • Ability to influence technical decisions through expertise, evidence, and clear reasoning.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex designs and trade-offs clearly.
  • Confidence to express a technical opinion while remaining open to evidence, challenges, and alternative approaches.
  • Experience with proofs of concept, simulations, staging environments, or lab-based validation.

Education and Professional Background

  • A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline is beneficial but not required.
  • Equivalent practical expertise in network architecture, design, engineering, or operations is equally relevant.
  • Advanced network hardware vendor certifications (e.g. JNCIE, CCIE, etc.) are beneficial but not required.

Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.

This position is responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, documenting system interfaces and data flows, developing user stories and acceptance criteria, and supporting testing and validation activities within an Agile environment.

The VALIP platform supports integration and data exchange across VA supply chain, inventory, financial, and clinical systems. The Business Analyst will collaborate with technical teams working with technologies including InterSystems IRIS for Health, Databricks, and Red Hat OpenShift.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

  • Support testing activities by developing test scenarios, validating requirements, and coordinating test data preparation.

  • Document testing results, track issues, and coordinate stakeholder approvals and sign-off.

  • Prepare release notes, requirements documentation, status reports, and briefing materials for VA stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate requirements documentation and support knowledge transfer across technical and business teams.

  • Minimum three years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Requirements Analyst supporting software development projects.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and technical requirements.
  • Experience developing requirements for system integrations, data migrations, interfaces, or enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications within an Agile development environment.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to independently query, analyze, and profile data.
  • Experience documenting data mappings, business rules, process flows, and system integration requirements.
  • Experience working directly with government stakeholders or enterprise business users to gather and validate requirements.
  • Experience using Jira or similar Agile backlog management tools.
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and software development lifecycles.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, testers, Product Owners, and customer stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) programs, particularly supply chain, logistics, asset management, or financial systems.
  • Experience with enterprise item master data, master data management, or data governance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards, including HL7, FHIR, and EDI.
  • Experience documenting or analyzing REST APIs and enterprise system integrations.
  • Experience with InterSystems IRIS for Health, HealthShare, Databricks, or similar integration and data platforms.
  • Experience supporting data migration, data quality, and enterprise data integration initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Interface Control Documents (ICDs), data mapping specifications, and system integration testing.
  • Experience supporting user acceptance testing (UAT), requirements traceability, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) or Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) certification.
  • Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.

Location:

Pay Range:

  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

jobs.description:
Basics

Type: Independent Contractor
Schedule: Flex-Time (5-15 hours/week)
Education: Any
Work Experience: 2+ Years
Location: Remote

Motu Novu seeks a remote food blogger and ghost writer who is fluent in American English to research and write well-sourced short-form articles on food and beverage as an independent contractor. Topics include food history and folklore, food and beverage product reviews, and reviews of kitchen tools, accessories, and appliances. The role is flex-time and may grow into a full-time position with an expanded role within the firm, depending on interest and performance. Optional occasional travel to Europe and the USA.

What You Do

  • Pitch article ideas and work with the firm’s research team to research new topics.

  • Write, edit, and copy-edit short-form articles on food and beverage, food history and folklore, and related topics.

  • Write reviews of food and beverage products, kitchen tools, accessories, and appliances.

  • Check facts and thoroughly verify cited sources, especially for history and folklore content.

  • Prepare articles for publication: writing headlines, meta descriptions, basic SEO, and image suggestions.

  • Publish articles under a shared pseudonym used by the firm’s team of writers.

  • Moderate comments and engage with readers.

  • Help the firm’s marketing team promote published articles.

What You Need

  • Impeccable command of written American English, with a clear and engaging voice.

  • Ability to write in an established house voice and follow a style guide.

  • Ability to keep information strictly confidential, including the firm’s authorship of ghost-written work.

  • A portfolio of published writing on food and beverage or related topics.

  • Strong research skills and comfort with pursuing and/or auditing primary and secondary sources.

  • Bona-fide setup to work as an independent contractor.

  • Legally authorized to work in the USA. Physical presence within the USA is not required.

  • Successful completion of a background check.

  • Optional: hands-on cooking, baking, or beverage experience, culinary training, or a food-industry background.

  • Optional: knowledge of Italian-American heritage, culture, and traditions.

What You Get

  • Base Compensation: $25-40/hour, depending on qualifications and experience.

  • Benefits: Discretionary yearly performance bonus.

  • Growth Opportunities: Opportunity to work on a wide range of assignments to fully develop your career. Optionally, opportunity to travel to Europe and to the USA.

  • Relocation: If interested, an opportunity to relocate to Cody, Wyoming, USA after at least 3 years of successful collaboration.

jobs.title: Online Data Analyst - Spanish speakers in United States
jobs.excerpt: Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way.
jobs.description:
Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of The United States geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

You may work on a variety of tasks, including:

  • Review and verify map, business, address, and location information

  • Research information using online maps, search engines, directories, and reliable sources

  • Compare information from different sources and determine which result is most accurate

  • Evaluate English & Spanish language search results and information

  • Follow detailed project guidelines when making decisions

  • Work across different task types such as Maps, Search/Relevance, Audio, etc.

  • Provide accurate evaluations that help improve digital products and AI systems

Training materials, guidelines, and examples are provided.

Requirements:

  • Professional fluency in English & Spanish (native or near-native proficiency required)

  • Have lived in The United States for the last 5 consecutive years

  • In-depth regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of The United States

  • Willingness to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to understand and apply project guidelines 

  • Willingness to participate regularly each week when work is available

  • Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

The Voice and Hosted Cloud Connect Product Architect, working within TNS’s Communications market and under the Global Network Planning umbrella, will work to support the design and deployment related to LTE and 5G Roaming, and IMS/VoLTE services involving both signaling and user plane traffic. This position needs SME knowledge of voice interconnects via legacy- and VoIP-modeled systems; integration and testing support; SS7, SIP, ENUM, REST, and Diameter protocols; and cross-functional work experience.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead or supporting architect for TNS voice, VoIP, Hosted Cloud Connect, cloud communications, and carrier voice products.
  • Establish and maintain end-to-end architecture for Hosted Cloud Connect and associated voice services, including application, signaling, media, routing, security, monitoring, provisioning, billing, and operational-support components.
  • Translate Product roadmaps, customer requirements, commercial opportunities, and operational needs into documented technical architectures, implementation plans, product requirements, and engineering deliverables.

  • Define voice service call flows, application interactions, routing logic, resiliency models, failover behavior, capacity requirements, security controls, and service-quality requirements.

  • Support the investigation and resolution of complex production issues involving SIP call flows, call routing, media, interoperability, voice applications, SBCs, service platforms, and carrier interconnections.
  • Ensure new and modified voice products meet development, security, operational, monitoring, capacity, support, and commercial-readiness requirements before production deployment.
  • Identify architectural risks, platform dependencies, technical debt, scalability limitations, concentration-of-knowledge risks, and opportunities for simplification or automation.

    • Product Architecture Design Documents
    • High-level and detailed solution diagrams
    • SIP call-flow and service-interaction diagrams
    • Platform integration and dependency models
    • Make-versus-buy analyses
    • Technical and operational impact assessments
    • Capacity and scalability models
    • Resiliency and failover scenarios
    • Monitoring and event-management requirements
    • Development, QA, and test-environment requirements
    • Security and compliance requirements
    • Test strategies and test-result assessments
    • Deployment, migration, and operational-readiness plans
    • Product lifecycle and platform-retirement recommendations

    • Softswitches and call-control platforms
    • Telephony application servers
    • Media resource functions and media gateways
    • Call recording platforms
    • Softphone and unified communications applications
    • Network call-screening or call-protection services
    • Carrier voice interconnection
    • Voice routing and least-cost routing
    • Toll-free, DID, and telephone-number management
    • STIR/SHAKEN and call-authentication services
    • Voice provisioning, billing, monitoring, and service-assurance systems
  • Strong working knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP, RTCP, DNS, ENUM, REST APIs, TLS, TCP/IP, and voice codecs.
  • Working knowledge of SS7, ISUP, TCAP, SCCP, Diameter, IMS, and PSTN gateways, sufficient to support integrations with legacy and mobile-network environments.
  • Experience designing highly available, geographically resilient, secure, and scalable carrier-grade voice solutions.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple competing priorities, and provide architectural leadership in a dynamic product and customer environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and architecture-design tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or an equivalent diagramming platform.

jobs.excerpt: THE COMPANY Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions.
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Digital Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design and verification of digital and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet solutions, including PCS (Physical Coding Sublayer) logic and custom high-speed interfaces such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe. Working alongside experienced digital and analog engineers, you will write RTL, build testbenches and behavioural models, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in digital design who want to learn fast through hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • RTL-to-GDSII Ownership: Own the physical implementation of digital blocks from RTL handoff to sign-off: synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock-tree synthesis, routing, optimisation and ECOs.
  • Floorplanning & Power Delivery: Define floorplans, power grids and macro/pin placement. Make the key area, congestion and power-distribution trade-offs, including for blocks that interface with sensitive analog circuits.
  • Timing Closure & Constraints: Write and validate SDC constraints, and drive STA and timing closure across corners and modes for high-speed designs. This includes multi-clock, CDC-heavy and high-frequency datapaths between PCS, DSP and analog front-ends.
  • Mixed-Signal Integration: Integrate hard analog and custom-layout macros (e.g. SerDes TX/RX, PLLs, ADC/DAC) with digital logic. Manage abstracts, pin and bump planning, shielding, isolation and top-level assembly together with the analog and layout teams.
  • Sign-off: Make sure blocks are ready for tape-out through IR-drop and EM analysis, physical verification (DRC/LVS/antenna/ERC), logic equivalence checking, parasitic extraction and final sign-off STA.
  • Low-Power & DFT: Implement UPF power intent where needed, and work with DFT to integrate scan, BIST and test structures without compromising PPA.
  • Flows & Automation: Build and improve our implementation flows and scripts (TCL, Python, shell). This includes AI-assisted tools that parse, compare and flag regressions across timing, congestion and power reports between runs.
  • Feedback to Design: Feed physical implementation insights back to RTL and architecture teams early, so designs are built to close.
  • Collaboration & Mentoring: Work with foundry, EDA and IP partners. Lead design reviews, document your work clearly and mentor less experienced engineers.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years of hands-on ASIC physical design experience, with multiple successful tape-outs
  • Strong experience across the full back-end flow: synthesis, floorplanning, CTS, place and route, STA, timing closure and physical verification
  • Strong command of SDC constraints and static timing analysis methodology, including multi-mode multi-corner (MMMC) analysis and OCV/AOCV/POCV
  • Hands-on experience with Cadence and/or Synopsys implementation and sign-off tools (e.g. Genus, Innovus, Tempus, Voltus, Quantus, Pegasus, or Fusion Compiler, PrimeTime, and Calibre)
  • Experience on advanced FinFET nodes (16/12/7/5nm or below)
  • Solid understanding of CMOS, RC parasitic extraction, IR drop/EM and the main physical design formats (LEF/DEF, Liberty, SPEF, GDS/OASIS, UPF)
  • Strong scripting skills in TCL and Python/shell, and comfort working in a Linux environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a hands-on debugging mindset

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.
Nice-to-have:
  • Experience implementing digital blocks for high-speed SerDes, UCIe, Ethernet or PCIe PHYs
  • Mixed-signal integration experience: working with analog/custom layout teams, hard macro integration, noise isolation and top-level chip assembly
  • Chiplet or multi-die experience, including bump planning, die-to-die interfaces and advanced packaging constraints (e.g. CoWoS, InFO, EMIB, organic substrates)
  • Experience with low-power implementation (multiple power domains, power gating, level shifters, isolation)
  • Experience defining or improving implementation methodologies and reference flows
  • Experience working directly with foundries, EDA vendors and third-party IP providers
  • Using AI tools in your engineering work, with a healthy scepticism wherever sign-off is on the line

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English, able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star: We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely: We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact: Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn't disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work: We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we'll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real digital and mixed-signal IP used in customer silicon, from your first months
  • Mentorship from day one – a dedicated manager and experienced engineers who will review your work and help you grow
  • Competitive, transparent compensation – adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – structured onboarding, AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview (90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min) – values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps – we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.

jobs.description:
EverPro - Director of Implementation, Service Fusion

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. Through EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell, we provide end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications for the Home and Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our company, culture, and values at evercommerce.com/about-us/careers.

About the Role

The EverPro Home Improvement solution group is seeking a Director of Implementation to lead the Service Fusion implementation team of Implementation Specialists and Onboarding Managers. You will own the new customer journey from signed contract to go-live on our field service management platform, partnering with our data team on data migration and integrations and reporting to the leader of our Implementation organization.


Your mandate is to make onboarding significantly faster, more scalable, and more digital, so customers reach value sooner and stay longer. You will also evolve the team's approach to helping customers rethink and improve how they run their business rather than simply teaching them which buttons to click — and make onboarding a continuation of the sales relationship rather than a handoff away from it.


What you'll do

  • Speed to Go-Live: Own go-lives and time to live for Service Fusion. Set and deliver an aggressive reduction target, and connect faster onboarding to lower early-life churn.
  • Scaled and AI-Assisted Onboarding: Lead build vs. buy decisions on self-serve and AI-assisted onboarding, backed by pilot data. Design tiered paths: assisted onboarding for higher-value accounts, scaled digital journeys for the rest.
  • Payments Activation: Make payments attach a standard stage of implementation, partnering with Sales and Payments to raise attach rates and shorten time-to-first-payment.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the team, and partner with Talent Acquisition to manage capacity against new customer bookings.
  • Process, Metrics and Handoffs: Build implementation playbooks and stage-gate reporting in CRM and onboarding platforms. Own clean handoffs from Sales and to Customer Success, including an escalation path for blocked accounts.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work with Product, Engineering, Payments, the data team, Customer Success, and Support so every customer launches with accurate configuration, clean data, working integrations, and trained users.
  • Remote-First Delivery Model: Build and continuously refine a scalable, primarily virtual delivery model suited to a small business pros.
  • Escalation Management: Serve as an executive point of escalation for at-risk implementations, working cross-functionally to get stalled implementations back on track.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in implementation, onboarding, or professional services in B2B SaaS, including 5+ years managing people (ideally managers)
  • A track record leading high-volume SMB launches, with measurable reductions in time to live or time-to-value
  • Experience designing tiered onboarding and deploying self-serve, digital, or AI-assisted onboarding tools, including build vs. buy decisions backed by pilot data
  • A data-driven operator who has built onboarding stage-gates and reporting in CRM and onboarding platforms (for example,)
  • A strong coach who creates clear paths for growth
  • A clear communicator who resets expectations, handles escalations, and influences across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with field service management software or SMB trades businesses (plumbing, HVAC, electrical)
  • Experience with embedded payments or fintech activation during onboarding
  • Familiarity with onboarding/CS tooling (e.g., Planhat, Salesforce and GuideCX or similar)
  • MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus

Where: US Remote

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you're close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits

  • Flexibility to work where and how you want within your country of employment: in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

jobs.description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

The BIM Specialist supports an owner-side Record Drawing Update (RDU) program for a global data center portfolio. You will keep facility drawings and BIM models current and usable throughout the life of each facility, helping operations, engineering, and project teams work from a reliable record set.

This is a hands-on role focused on reviewing model handovers, incorporating completed retrofit and field changes, and maintaining quality-controlled records—not primarily creating design models or managing a Revit family library. You will serve as the RDU contact for assigned campuses while also completing planned work across other campuses as part of a shared team.

You will love this job if…

  • You enjoy solving drawing and model problems, not just producing new content.
  • You take work from intake through review and delivery.
  • You ask clear questions, investigate missing information, and know when to escalate.
  • You like helping people use reliable information and improving how the team works.

What you’ll do…

  • Maintain facility records. Update Revit models and CAD drawings using completed project deliverables, reviewed redlines, and confirmed field information. Work may include architectural, MEP, security, life-safety, and connectivity changes within the assigned scope.
  • Incorporate retrofit changes. Bring completed retrofit and technology-modification updates into the current maintained record set. Check source revisions and overlapping project scopes so newer work is not overwritten by older inputs.
  • Review model handovers. Document deficiencies, follow up on review comments, and assess readiness for turnover under the program’s procedures.
  • Check model and drawing quality. Review file integrity, links, worksets, coordinates, phasing, naming, sheets, schedules, and model health against applicable BIM requirements.
  • Manage native-file handover and maintenance. Migrate, cloud-share, relink, and upgrade models through approved workflows.
  • Own campus relationships. Represent RDU at project and closeout kickoffs, explain deliverable expectations, review incoming requests, and coordinate with Stakeholders.
  • Support drawing and model requests. Provide current record copies, transmittals, and required exports to internal teams and project partners. Help resolve missing native files, broken links, and format issues.
  • Improve repeatable work. Contribute to BIM standards, checklists, workflow documentation, and onboarding. Create or modify families and templates when needed for record updates, and help test automation or AI-assisted tools with human quality checks.

You should have…

  • 3-5 years of hands-on BIM experience in AEC, construction, facilities, or an owner-side environment.
  • Advanced Revit skills, including linked models, worksharing, sheets, schedules, parameters, families, and troubleshooting.
  • Working proficiency in AutoCAD and PDF review/comparison tools such as Bluebeam.
  • Experience updating models from redlines and reviewing record or as-built deliverables.
  • Ability to read architectural and MEP drawings and understand how changes affect related models, sheets, and schedules.
  • Experience with cloud-based model collaboration and document workflows, preferably Autodesk Forma.
  • Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to manage several tasks across a distributed team.

    • Preferred qualifications

    • Data center or other mission-critical facility experience.
    • Experience with project closeout, record-model migration, connectivity documentation, or owner-side facility information management.
    • Willingness to learn Dynamo, pyRevit, Python, Revit APIs, or AI-assisted automation.
    • Experience training others or writing practical BIM guidance

    Characteristics of an ideal candidate

    • Responsive; we take pride in reacting quickly and positively to clients and teammates, internal and external
    • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
    • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
    • Empowered; you take ownership, drive the work rather than waiting to be assigned it, and bring solutions instead of problems
    • Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and helps raise our high-performance bar
    • Even-tempered; stays steady under pressure and thrives when things move fast
    • Coachable; recognizes strengths and weaknesses and is open to guidance
    • Authentic; likes to have fun and be yourself at work

    What's in it for you

    • Remote-first, genuinely. Flexible arrangements and a team that has worked this way since 2015.
    • Large owners, serious programs. Data centers, transportation, government and public infrastructure, commercial real estate, education, healthcare, manufacturing, power and energy, water and wastewater.
    • More of the lifecycle than most roles allow. As part of Accenture Construct, you’ll see how the systems you build connect to strategy, engineering, delivery, and operations.
    • The whole of Accenture behind you. Specialists in engineering, advisory, digital, data, and AI, with the tools and capabilities of the wider firm at your fingertips.
    • More paths than one lane. Move across sectors, geographies, and capabilities as your career develops, backed by development and certification support.
    • Benefits that matter: competitive compensation, health insurance, flexible PTO, and our Philanthropic Matching Gift Program. And more…

    About Avicado

    Owners of the biggest capital programs in the world run them across systems that don’t talk to each other. The information exists; getting a connected view of it is the problem. That’s the work at Avicado.

    Founded in 2015, Avicado is a digital-native construction technology consultancy. We help owners of complex capital programs connect their systems, strengthen project controls, and get more out of their data. In October 2026, we joined Accenture Construct, Accenture’s global capital projects business, expanding our ability to support capital programs from strategy through handover. Our expertise helps power the digital transformation behind these programs.

    We partner with leading enterprise organizations across industries, including data centers, higher education, healthcare, and real estate development, to create seamless interoperability across their teams, processes, and technologies. As we enter this exciting new chapter, we’re looking for talented individuals who want to help shape the future of construction technology.

    We believe diverse perspectives, collaboration, and continuous learning are essential to delivering meaningful results. We value an environment where individuals are respected, encouraged to contribute their ideas, and empowered to grow professionally.

    As part of Accenture Construct, we’re excited about the opportunities ahead to expand our impact, collaborate across teams, and continue delivering innovative solutions for our clients. We offer competitive benefits and opportunities for professional growth, with specific offerings varying by role and location.

    Our commitment to creating a remarkable workplace has been recognized through our Great Place to Work certification, three consecutive years on Inc.’s Best Workplaces list, and the AYA Award, honoring allies who promote equality and positive change for women in technology.

    If you’re a self-motivated professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, collaborating with talented teams, and making an impact on some of the world’s largest capital programs, we’d love to hear from you!

You own features end to end - from why a clinic needs them, through design and build, to checking in production that they worked. AI coding agents are a normal part of every step of your work.

Tech environment:C# / .NET 8.0, Azure Services (Azure SQL, AI Search, Service Bus, App Insights, Data Factory), Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, MassTransit, React with TypeScript, plus growing use of Python for AI tooling and experimentation.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Design, build and run full-stack features in the Sales domain: .NET services, event-driven integrations and React front end.

  • Work with the Product Owner and QA from discovery onwards. Shape the spec and agree acceptance criteria before code is written.

  • Find the gaps in a spec before you build. Close the small ones yourself and bring only business questions to the Product Owner.

  • Use AI tools across the whole lifecycle: planning, design, build, testing, review and maintenance. Keep the human judgement on correctness, security and data protection.

  • Own quality: unit and integration tests, code review, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, observability) as part of the design.

  • Follow features into production: watch telemetry and usage, support releases, investigate incidents and close the loop with the product team.

  • Contribute to architecture discussions and decision records with the Tech Lead and architects and help pay down tech debt in the sales flows.

  • Make the team better at AI: mentor engineers and share the instructions, checks and small tools that work.

  • Product Mindset

    As AI takes on more of the typing, the value of an engineer moves to judgement: knowing what to build, why, and what good looks like for the user. In this role you:

    • Start every feature with the business question: who in the clinic uses it, and what problem it solves for them.

    • Push back with alternatives when a request is expensive and a simpler solution gives most of the value.

    • Explain technical trade-offs in business terms to Product Owners, delivery and customer-facing colleagues.

    • Look at usage, support tickets and customer feedback after release, and feed what you learn into the next iteration.

IF YOU ARE

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and running production systems. We value practical experience and demonstrated capabilities over years alone.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and modern .NET, including:

    • ASP.NET Core and Web APIs.

    • Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.

    • Clean Architecture and maintainable application design.

  • Solid frontend development experience using React and TypeScript, particularly for complex business applications.

  • Practical experience designing and developing microservices architectures.

  • Understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using:

    • Azure Service Bus.

    • MassTransit.

    • Similar messaging and event-processing technologies.

  • Strong SQL database experience, including relational data modelling and transactional business data.

  • Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, and security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday development, such as:

    • Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, including examples of reviewing AI-generated code, identifying mistakes, and understanding when AI should not be used.

    • Strong product mindset, with examples of contributing to feature definition, understanding business needs, and influencing technical and product decisions.

    • Good command of English (B2 or above), both written and spoken.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Python for AI tooling, evaluations and prototypes.

  • Features built on LLM APIs: prompting, tool use, and measuring the quality of the results.

  • Experience in regulated domains (medical devices, healthcare, finance) or with sensitive personal data.

  • AKS / Kubernetes.

  • You have built or improved developer tooling, CI/CD or AI agent setups that other engineers use.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

  • Join the Best Team Ever:Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

  • Initial Interview: If your background fits the role, we’ll invite you for an interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

  • Technical Interview:Depending on the position, you may complete a technical assessment or test task.

  • Final Decision:After all steps, we’ll get back to you with the result and next steps.

jobs.description:
Presently we're recruiting Product Testers (from home) in several US
cities to expand our private network of In-Home Usage Testers (IHUT) to
fulfill upcoming contracts with national and international companies. We
guarantee 15-20 hours per week with an hourly pay of between $25/hr.
and $45/hr., depending on the In-Home Usage Test project. No experience

required.

Hope services is a products survey company that specializes in
product testing and product development work. We design and conduct
In-Home Usage Testing (IHUT) locally and nationally to provide actual
user feedback to consumers and market research firms to evaluate
products, packaging, related product instructions and more.

We leverage our network of private panels (In-Home Usage Testers) to
provide product testers to companies for evaluating the in-home
experience with a wide variety of products to ensure proper product

certification and greater market access.

Please note that although this job can be done from home 95% of the
time, very occasionally In-Home Product Testers may be asked to visit
the client's office, laboratory, store, warehouse or factory for
training or meetings (visits are local and scheduled at no more than 20
minutes drive from the In-Home Usage Tester address). These optional

visits are also paid by the hour.

During your application process, we will determine your consumer
profile and establish what products would be suitable for you to test
according to your demographics, lifestyle, consumer behavior, skills,
hobbies and ability. Research questionnaires are used to identify and
target certain types of consumers, to ensure the right participants are
engaged and to achieve the representative sample needed. Job candidates
for In-Home Usage Testing are also screened to meet the client’s needs
for the project to ensure that the product is one that they qualify to
test and that they have a balance of demographics and attitudes.

Participation in these product testing and consumer panels is always
free, secure and private. In-Home Usage Testing is a quick, easy and fun
way to make extra cash by telling big brands what you think about their
upcoming products and services in the American market.

Main Duties

Sign and return non-disclosure agreements before the product to be
tested is shipped. Individuals who complete the required documents will

have the products sent to their homes.

Once the product is received for In-Home Usage Test (IHUT), the
Product Tester must take care of the product being tested and use it

responsibly.

Read and strictly follow the In-Home Usage Test Daily Schedule
provided with each product testing project. In-Home Usage Test Daily
Schedules may include tasks to do such as: unpacking, reading
instructions, journal entries, online or mobile feedback, usage of
product for certain amount of time, writing reviews, taking pictures,

etc.

Properly document In-Home Usage Test as instructed in the In-Home
Usage Test Daily Schedule. Types of documentation commonly used for
In-Home Usage Tests are snapshots, audio recordings, videos and Product

Journals.

Attend Skype meetings or conference call meetings with Account
Managers, Brand Managers, Research Managers, Product Managers or small
business owners to offer ongoing product usage feedback. These short
virtual meetings may take place 2-3 times per week and are paid by the

hour also.

Some In-Home Usage Tests projects may require participants to use
MFour’s Mobile In-Home Use Test Technology (cutting edge smartphone
technology to capture Point-of-Emotion® insights to gain unparalleled

depth of responses).

Paid Product Testing is done from home 95% of the time, but very
occasionally paid Product Testers may be asked to visit the client's
office, laboratory, store, warehouse or factory for training or
meetings. These visits are paid by the hour also.

Write reviews as requested in the In-Home Usage Test Daily Schedule for each project.

Review requirements can vary, however, the standard requirement is a
written review, photos of the reviewer with the product and a video

review.

Requirements

Great ability to follow precise instructions

Be open to write short reviews, record audio or short video (doesn't have to be perfect), no experience needed

Great attention to detail and curious spirit

Be able to work 15-20 hours per week and commit to a certain routine

Have access to a computer and a reliable internet connection

Have access to a digital camera or cellphone that takes pictures

Be honest and reliable

Good communication skills is an asset

No Experience Required

High School Diploma

18 years or older

A paid Product Tester position is perfect for those looking for an
entry level opportunity or for seasonal work, temporary work or
part-time work. The hours are completely flexible and no previous
experience is necessary. Our paid Product Testers come from all
backgrounds and industries ranging from customer service and sales to
administrative assistant. If you are a manager, receptionist, warehouse
or factory worker, driver, medical assistant, nurse, cleaner, college
student, messenger, maid, teacher, retail associate, salesperson,
secretary, server, janitor, cashier, contract worker or intern who is
looking for a flexible part time or seasonal job, you should try paid
Product Testing to supplement your income. Also if you have been
involved in accounting, clerical jobs, marketing, management, security
or data entry jobs you may qualify for a paid product tester position.

Benefits

Very competitive salary

Weekly pay

Work around your schedule

Learn about an exciting industry

Telecommute (you can work from home, work or school)

Most of the time you can keep the product tested

An incredible team comprised of motivated and talented individuals.

About Navista:


We believe in the power of community oncology to support patients through their cancer journeys. As an oncology practice alliance comprised of more than 40 sites, Navista provides the support community practices need to fuel their growth—while maintaining their independence.


What Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) contributes to Cardinal Health:

Practice Operations Management oversees the business and administrative operations of a medical practice.

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) is responsible for managing the financial lifecycle of patient accounts and ensuring timely and accurate payment for services provided. The RCM team focuses on a series of clinical and administrative processes that healthcare providers utilize to capture, bill, and collect patient service revenue in a manner that is compliant with payer rules and requirements. The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient intake and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero. This team also encompasses a payer administration function that ensures we are successfully operationalizing payer rules and requirements as well as facilitating payer relations and escalation efforts.


The Supervisor, Revenue Cycle Management, is responsible for overseeing patient-facing revenue cycle operations, including patient AR escalations, patient refunds, financial assistance billing, vendor performance management, and patient collection processes. This role serves as a liaison between internal revenue cycle teams, third-party vendors, and patients to ensure timely resolution of account issues, accurate account balances, regulatory compliance, and an exceptional patient financial experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Review and identify opportunities for improvement on Power BI.
  • Oversee daily patient accounts receivable activities and ensure timely resolution of outstanding patient balances.
  • Manage and prioritize complex patient account escalations requiring advanced review and resolution.
  • Monitor patient AR inventory, aging trends, and account resolution timelines.
  • Develop workflows to improve account accuracy and reduce preventable patient balance issues.
  • Review complex patient disputes involving insurance payments, adjustments, estimates, financial assistance, billing errors, statements, and collections.
  • Partner with Patient Financial Services, billing teams, operational leaders, and payers to resolve account concerns.
  • Identify recurring root causes of patient escalations and implement corrective action plans.
  • Track and report escalation trends, resolution outcomes, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party assistance vendors to ensure timely application and posting of approved assistance.
  • Monitor accounts requiring financial assistance review and ensure appropriate follow-up.

  • Supervise patient refund workflows and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor refund aging and turnaround times.

  • Conduct routine business reviews and collaborate with vendors to improve operational outcomes.

  • Analyze patient AR, refund, escalation, collections, and financial assistance data to identify trends and opportunities.

  • Present findings and recommendations to management and executive leadership.
  • Utilize reporting tools, including Power BI and other business intelligence platforms, to drive operational improvements.
  • Maintain billing staff PTO requests and ensure proper staffing and department coverage.
  • Handle other duties and projects assigned.

  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred

jobs.description:
On behalf of UKRI we are looking for anIdentity & Collaboration Architect(Inside IR35) for an initial 4 month contract. Remote working with occasional office travel.

The Identity & Collaboration Architect will lead the architecture and design of a large-scale Microsoft 365 consolidation programme involving the migration of multiple Microsoft 365 tenancies, mail domains and identity platforms into a single strategic environment.

The role is accountable for developing the future-state architecture for identity, authentication, directory services, email namespace, collaboration services and associated governance models. The architect will work across technical, operational and business stakeholders to establish a coherent, sustainable target operating model that balances organisational requirements with Microsoft's strategic cloud architecture.

A key aspect of the role is the development of target-state identity and namespace strategies, including the transition from multiple independentlymanaged directories and Microsoft 365 tenancies to a consolidated identity platform centred on Microsoft Entra ID.

As an Identity & Collaboration Architect your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Develop target-state identity architecture for a multi-organisational Microsoft 365 environment.
  • Define authoritative sources for identity information and attribute ownership.
  • Establish identity lifecycle architecture covering joiners, movers and leavers.
  • Define future-state email namespace strategy.
  • Develop mail domain architecture covering multiple existing SMTP domains.
  • Analyse impacts of domain consolidation, retention and rationalisation.
  • Support definition of future-state architecture for Microsoft 365 services and ancillary solutions
  • Support tenant consolidation strategy and migration planning.
  • Design core platform services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
  • Develop architectural principles and standards.
  • Establish decision frameworks for identity and namespace management.
  • Lead discovery activities across multiple organisations.
  • Analyse current-state identity, directory and messaging environments.
  • Engage senior stakeholders across IT, security, HR and business functions.
  • Facilitate workshops to define identity, namespace and governance requirements.

Essential:
