Job Description:

CSI is seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to lead complex, high-visibility initiatives supporting the integration of Qolo’s payments technology and capabilities across CSI. This full-time role will coordinate cross-functional integration efforts and help ensure projects move successfully from initial planning through implementation and delivery.

In this role, you will build and manage project plans, coordinate dependencies, identify and address risks, communicate project status, and follow through on open items. You will work closely with product, engineering, technology, operations, and business stakeholders to maintain alignment and drive integration initiatives forward.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical project management experience within a complex environment.

Previous experience in payments, banking, financial technology, or another regulated industry is preferred but not required for candidates who demonstrate relevant technical project experience and the ability to learn the payments domain.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the planning and execution of technical projects supporting the Qolo–CSI integration.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate integration activities across product, engineering, operations, business, and other internal teams.
  • Monitor project progress and provide clear, consistent status updates to stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies early and drive appropriate mitigation and resolution plans.
  • Follow up on outstanding decisions, action items, and deliverables to keep projects moving forward.
  • Facilitate project meetings, document key decisions, and ensure stakeholders understand responsibilities and next steps.
  • Manage changing priorities and project scope while maintaining alignment with broader integration objectives.
  • Support project governance, status reporting, escalation, and change-management activities.
  • Partner with technical and product teams to understand integration requirements and translate them into actionable project plans.
  • Help coordinate testing, implementation, launch, and operational-readiness activities.
  • Use project data, reporting, and AI-enabled tools to improve visibility, communication, and delivery efficiency.
  • Promote effective Agile project-management practices and continuous process improvement.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Significant experience managing complex technical projects or programs from planning through implementation.
  • Demonstrated ability to create project plans, track milestones, manage risks, report status, and follow up on open items.
  • Experience coordinating work across technical, product, business, and operational teams.
  • Strong understanding of project-management methodologies, including Agile and traditional delivery approaches.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, integrations, dependencies, and project impacts without needing to serve as the technical architect.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating project status, risks, and decisions to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and drive progress within a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Aha!, or comparable project and portfolio management tools.
  • Practical understanding of how AI tools can support project planning, research, documentation, communication, and productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting projects within payments, banking, financial technology, or another regulated industry.
  • Knowledge of payment platforms, payment processing, card-based payments, or financial-services integrations.
  • Experience supporting platform integrations, mergers and acquisitions, technology modernization, or other large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with APIs, cloud-based platforms, system integrations, testing, release planning, or production implementation.
  • Experience using tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Claude, Glean, or comparable platforms. Prior experience with CSI’s specific tools is not required.
  • Project Management Professional, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, or similar project-management or Agile certification.

What Success Looks Like

  • Qolo–CSI integration projects have clear plans, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Project risks, dependencies, and decisions are identified and communicated before they negatively affect delivery.
  • Technical and business stakeholders remain informed, aligned, and accountable throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Open items receive consistent follow-up, and projects continue moving forward despite changing priorities.
  • Project reporting gives leadership an accurate and actionable view of progress, risks, and next steps.

Key responsibilities

Lead the global OSA and DB2 organization

  • Represent OSA and DB2 in CCS leadership, architecture, planning, staffing, and incident forums.

Own reliability and operational readiness

  • Provide technical leadership for the availability, stability, security, performance, and operability of CCS mainframe environments.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for major incidents, MIMs, triage, post-up-system validation, release readiness, IPLs, and failover activities.
  • Establish standards for health checks, online-region accessibility, transaction health, queue processing, DB2 availability, monitoring, alerting, change readiness, and incident handoffs.
  • Use operational data to identify trends, prevent recurring incidents, and improve capacity and performance.
  • Ensure critical operational knowledge is documented, current, and transferable across locations.


Lead OSA and mainframe systems engineering

  • Guide work across z/OS, CICS, TCP/IP, OSA-Express, online regions, z/OSMF, Zowe, zMFA, certificates, and related platform services.
  • Oversee technical validation for z/OS, CICS, middleware, security, certificate, and platform upgrades.
  • Provide direction on CPU and storage utilization, subsystem behavior, transaction response, connectivity, queue processing, and production troubleshooting.
  • Lead or support IPL, disaster recovery, failover, online-region validation, and application/platform dependency management.

Lead DB2 for z/OS engineering

  • Guide DB2 system and application DBA work across availability, configuration, utilities, security, performance, capacity, recovery, and release support.
  • Lead DB2 subsystem and function-level upgrades, maintenance, migrations, reorgs, backup/recovery planning, and production validation.
  • Oversee SQL performance analysis, access-path reviews, CPU optimization, locking/contention analysis, SQL-code investigation, and DB2 monitoring.
  • Ensure DB2 decisions align with CCS application behavior, release changes, security requirements, and production operations.
  • Promote secure and standardized database change practices, including DDL/JCL generation, RACF integration, certificate/TLS dependencies, and auditability.

Manage service-provider and vendor partnerships

  • Provide technical direction, coaching, and clear expectations to external mainframe service providers and technology vendors.
  • Coordinate major operating-system and database upgrades, maintenance, access and security changes, tool enablement, incidents, problem resolution, disaster recovery, capacity, and modernization initiatives.
  • Review technical plans, challenge assumptions, manage dependencies, and ensure partner deliverables meet CCS reliability, security, and change-management standards.
  • Maintain effective escalation paths and clear communication between internal teams, service providers, vendors, and business stakeholders.

Champion the mainframe and modernization

  • Champion the mainframe as a strategic, reliable, secure, and evolving platform for CCS.
  • Be a forward thinker who modernizes tools, processes, engineering practices, and operational models without compromising production stability.
  • Advance automation for health checks, validation, performance measurement, incident diagnostics, and routine operational work.
  • Promote the use of Zowe, z/OSMF, REXX, Python, SQL, REST APIs, dashboards, and modern mainframe engineering practices.
  • Partner with development and DevOps teams on source control, CI/CD, observability, automated validation, and controlled release practices.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 15+ years of experience in enterprise mainframe technology, including substantial IBM z/OS experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or managing technical teams, including coaching, performance management, succession planning, and delivery accountability.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in at least one of the following:

o z/OS system programming, CICS, TCP/IP, OSA-Express, online systems, middleware, or mainframe platform engineering

o IBM Db2 for z/OS system DBA, application DBA, database performance, database security, or database operations

  • Working knowledge of the complementary discipline. An OSA leader must understand DB2 dependencies; a DB2 leader must understand z/OS and online-system dependencies.
  • Experience supporting business-critical production systems through formal change, incident, problem-management, release, and on-call processes.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and external service providers.
  • Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and executive-communication skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions during high-severity incidents with calm, clarity, and accountability.

Preferred qualifications


  • Experience leading both z/OS systems programming and DB2 for z/OS teams.
  • Experience with CICS Transaction Server, TCP/IP, OSA-Express, z/OSMF, Zowe, zMFA, RACF, TLS certificates, and online-region management.
  • Experience with DB2 utilities, SQL performance, query optimization, subsystem parameters, locking, reorgs, backup/recovery, and function-level upgrades.
  • Familiarity with RMF, SMF, OMEGAMON, DB2 Query Monitor, DB2 Administration Foundation, Sysview, Strobe/iStrobe, or comparable diagnostic tools.
  • Strong skills in JCL, REXX, SQL, Assembler, scripting, or automation; Python and REST API experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, automated health checks, dashboards, or mainframe CI/CD.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, failover testing, IPL planning, platfo

rm upgrades, resilience engineering, and operational readiness.

  • ITIL, SRE, or comparable operational-excellence experience.

Leadership profile

  • Technically credible without micromanaging
  • A champion for the mainframe and a forward thinker on modernization
  • Clear in ownership, priorities, communication, and decision-making
  • Able to influence engineering, operations, product, security, and vendor organizations

· Strong customer and operational focus

  • Committed to mentoring and growing scarce mainframe skills
  • Focused on prevention, automation, documentation, and measurable improvement
  • Inclusive and effective across geographies and career levels

Location and working model

  • Location: India, Hyderabad or Bangalore based on candidate availability and organizational fit.
  • Team scope: Approximately 10–12 engineers across India and the United States.
  • Working model: Global collaboration with planned time-zone overlap and occasional participation in critical incidents, releases, IPLs, and maintenance windows.

jobs.excerpt: Overview Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc.  (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues.
jobs.description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Space and Intelligence Division provides professional services to the US Space Force, Combatant Commands, Intelligence Community, and NASA. Our work includes enterprise architectural assessments, systems engineering and integration, test, planning and execution, cost estimating and analysis, acquisition support, and cybersecurity. We are trusted partners developing approaches and concepts to meet emerging high priority needs, assessing cutting-edge technologies, and supporting capabilities for our National Defense. Come join the fastest growing Division at Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc.!

The Space Systems Group (SSG), part of SPA’s Space and Intelligence Division, provides timely and objective assessments and recommendations integrating technical, operational, programmatic, policy and business analysis. We focus on our key clients in the Space community including the US Space Force’s Space Systems Command (USSF/SSC), one of the three designated Field Commands under USSF. We work tirelessly to provide integrated solutions based on information and communications throughout the chain of command. We provide clear and consistent analysis and recommendations which are aligned to strategic and leadership goals while balancing the ability to execute on time and on budget within the technical communities. Come join an organization responsible for being a key enabler of Spacepower!


Responsibilities

SPA has a need for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to design, implement, operate, and optimize modern data platforms supporting mission-critical enterprise applications and services.

The ideal candidate combines the foundational expertise of a Database Administrator (DBA) with the engineering capabilities of a cloud-native platform specialist and the architectural understanding of modern distributed data systems.

This position extends well beyond traditional database administration or SQL-centric data engineering. The successful candidate will have practical experience across relational and non-relational databases, managed cloud database services, event-driven architectures, streaming platforms, data processing frameworks, and analytical data systems. The engineer will work closely with platform engineering, software development, cybersecurity, and systems architecture teams to deliver scalable, secure, highly available, and operationally sustainable data capabilities across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

Database Engineering and Administration

  • Design, deploy, configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise relational and non-relational database systems.
  • Provide advanced database administration expertise, including performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, replication, backup and recovery, and capacity planning.
  • Engineer high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including clustering, automated failover, point-in-time recovery, and cross-region replication.
  • Support database lifecycle management, including version upgrades, schema migrations, patching, and operational automation.
  • Establish database security standards covering encryption, access controls, auditing, credential management, and data protection.
  • Troubleshoot complex database performance, availability, and consistency issues across distributed environments.

Cloud-Native and Managed Data Services

  • Architect, deploy, and operate data services within Kubernetes and cloud-native environments.
  • Implement and manage database platforms using Kubernetes operators, Helm, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Engineer solutions using managed cloud database offerings such as Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Amazon RDS/Aurora, or equivalent services.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs between self-managed, Kubernetes-hosted, and cloud-managed database offerings based on operational complexity, performance, resilience, security, and cost.
  • Implement automation for provisioning, scaling, configuration management, observability, backup, and recovery.
  • Integrate data services with enterprise identity, secrets management, networking, and security platforms.

Distributed Data and Streaming Engineering

  • Design and implement distributed, event-driven data architectures supporting asynchronous messaging, event ingestion, and near-real-time processing.
  • Engineer and maintain streaming and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka, NATS, or equivalent technologies.
  • Develop and maintain data ingestion, transformation, routing, and integration pipelines across heterogeneous systems.
  • Apply distributed systems concepts including message delivery semantics, ordering, replay, idempotency, partitioning, and fault tolerance.
  • Implement schema governance, serialization, and data contract management using technologies such as Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, and schema registries.
  • Design reliable data movement and replication strategies across clusters, regions, and environments.

Data Processing, Analytics, and Storage

  • Design and support batch and streaming data processing solutions using frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flink, or equivalent technologies.
  • Work with data lakes, lakehouse architectures, object storage, analytical databases, and distributed query engines.
  • Engineer data ingestion and transformation workflows supporting structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
  • Support analytical and operational workloads with appropriate data modeling, partitioning, indexing, lifecycle management, and storage optimization.
  • Evaluate and integrate technologies such as Trino, ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or equivalent solutions.
  • Implement data quality, validation, lineage, metadata management, and governance capabilities.

Platform Reliability, Security, and Automation

  • Develop infrastructure automation and GitOps workflows using Terraform, OpenTofu, Ansible, Argo CD, or equivalent technologies.
  • Build production-ready data platforms with appropriate monitoring, alerting, logging, and performance telemetry.
  • Establish service-level objectives, resilience requirements, recovery objectives, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement data protection, encryption, identity integration, and compliance controls.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical evaluations, incident resolution, and root cause analysis.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • US Citizenship + Secret clearance at date of application
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience
  • 7+ years of relevant experience in database administration, data engineering, platform engineering, or distributed data systems
  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise administering and optimizing production relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL, including replication, backup/recovery, performance tuning, and high availability
  • Working knowledge of non-relational data stores, including document, key-value, or other NoSQL database technologies
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud provider, preferably Microsoft Azure, including managed database services
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and cloud-native deployment patterns
  • Practical experience with event streaming or distributed messaging technologies, preferably Apache Kafka or NATS
  • Experience building or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, data integration workflows, or distributed data processing systems
  • Working knowledge of data lakes, analytical storage architectures, and modern data processing technologies
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, or Java
  • Experience with automation, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and version-controlled infrastructure configurations
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, networking, security, storage, and fault tolerance
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex production issues spanning application, database, infrastructure, and network layers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, or other Azure-native data services
  • Experience operating PostgreSQL on Kubernetes using CloudNativePG, Crunchy Postgres, or similar operators
  • Expertise in PostgreSQL clustering technologies such as Patroni, etcd-based coordination, or equivalent high-availability solutions

Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

About WhiteMatter

WhiteMatter is the first agent-native company that secures and operationalizes the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle. Foundation models are non-deterministic, so protecting agents only at runtime leaves every decision to the last millisecond and every alert to the security team. WhiteMatter treats AI as a deployment problem first: every agent is assessed, governed against policy, and deployed from an approved blueprint before it reaches production; every action it takes is decided before it executes; and every outcome is proven after it runs. Founded by security veterans and deployed across, WhiteMatter is headquartered in Austin, Texas. Make every agent matter.

Why Join Us

We are building the infrastructure that makes safe, autonomous AI a reality for the enterprise. Joining our team means tackling unsolved engineering and security challenges at the absolute cutting edge of agentic AI. We operate with high velocity, value ownership, and are backed by top-tier investors. If you want to shape how the world's most advanced AI systems are governed and deployed, we want you on board.

About the Role

The Sales Engineer is the technical authority and narrative driver in customer engagements. This role is responsible for translating complex AI, Identity, and Data Protection challenges into defensible, real-world solutions—while helping customers understand not just how something works, but why it matters. This role blends deep hands-on technical expertise with storytelling, big-picture (“paint the picture”) thinking, and collaborative problem solving. You will work with prospects to obtain the technical win by designing a viable technical solution with an amazing product that can be applied to various scenarios. You will operate across AI security, LLMs, AI agents, MCP, DLP, and Identity, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to close deals and influence product direction.

○ CISOs and VP’s

○ Security leaders

○ Architects

○ Engineers

○ Business stakeholders

○ LLM and AI agent workflows (human + non-human identities)

Workshops & Collaborative Problem Solving
